articleTitle: Research on Recommendation Method of Chinese Traditional Children's Books and Videos Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the recommendation accuracy of Chinese traditional children's books and videos, a recommendation method based on graph convolutional neural network is proposed. In order to improve the extraction quality of node representation information and embedding representation information, the attention mechanism is integrated into the graph convolutional neural network to improve the recommendation effect. Parameter experiment shows that when the vector dimension is 64 and the reinforcement coefficient is 0.6, the proposed graph convolutional neural network recommendation model introducing attention mechanism has the best recommendation effect. In addition, simulation results show that compared with the current mainstream NGCF multi-layer propagation graph convolutional neural network recommendation method, the recall and Ndcg index of the proposed recommendation method based on graph convolutional neural network and attention mechanism are increased by 9.48% and 2.09%, respectively. Compared with the graph convolution recommendation algorithm without the introduction of attention mechanism GCNR and the graph convolution recommendation algorithm of dot product attention mechanism GCA-NR-SA, the recall rate and Ndcg index are increase by 8.16%, 1.93%, 4.37% and 0.96% respectively. The recommendation results of the proposed model are more accurate, which indicates that the model is worthy to be used in the recommendation task of Chinese traditional children's book video.

articleTitle: Comparison of Musical Heritage Databases and Analysis of Key Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The design ideas and the key digital technologies are different in music cultural heritage database. Through text analysis algorithm, image analysis algorithm, color recognition and image search system, the basic music heritage resources can be deeply analyzed and mined, so as to form a database with music cultural heritage value mining as the core.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Review Data Mining Based on Differential Evolution Particle Swarm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to realize the accurate mining of e-commerce review data, a clustering method based on adaptive clustering center ranking and differential evolution optimization particle swarm algorithm is proposed. In order to improve the compactness and accuracy of clustering results, the adaptive clustering center vector ranking method is introduced to sort clustering centers by similarity. Then, differential evolution is utilized to improve the particle swarm algorithm, so as to improve the accuracy of traditional clustering. The results show that when the population size is 30 and K value is 5, the clustering results of the proposed improved differential evolution particle swarm optimization algorithm are the best. The average F value of the proposed algorithm is 0.163, 0.644, 2.449 and 1.532 higher than that of the current methods with better clustering results such as unimproved DEPSO algorithm, GAI-PSO algorithm, IDE-SOM algorithm and ST-CNN algorithm, respectively. The improvement effect is obvious, and the clustering performance is better. The proposed IDEPSO method is adopted to perform clustering analysis on the reviews of e-commerce stores, which shows that buyers pay more attention to the overall design, material quality, comfort, price and logistics. This proves that the clustering of e-commerce reviews can guide the improvement of e-commerce operations, which has certain practical value and is worth promoting.

articleTitle: Optimal Adhesion Control Method for Railway Trains Based on Reset Control Sliding Mode Extremum Seeking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To ensure the safety and stability of railway train operations, this paper proposes an optimal adhesion control method that combines reset control and sliding mode extremum seeking algorithm. This method utilizes the adhesion stable zone between the wheel and the track as a constraint, actively avoiding wheel spinning and sliding by automatically searching and tracking the optimal creep speed, thereby maximizing the adhesion between the wheel and the track. Considering the issue of steady-state oscillation in traditional sliding mode extreme-seeking algorithms, the method proposed in this paper effectively reduces the steady-state oscillation during the control process. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method ensures the anti-skid and anti-spin capabilities of the train while achieving optimal utilization of wheel adhesion.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Translation Based on Data Enhancement Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of English-Chinese machine translation, a machine translation model based on data enhancement technology is proposed. First of all, the data is enhanced by part-of-speech substitution, and then the model is trained by the method based on iterative back translation, so as to solve the performance of English-Chinese translation model under some small-scale corpus. The results show that the Bleu values of the translation model based on data enhancement technology of the proposed part-of-speech substitution is increased by 1.92, 4.01 and 4.64, respectively, compared with the baseline model using the original parallel corpus, such as Base, SwitchOut and SCA, and the translation quality is improved. In the manual evaluation of translation accuracy and fluency, compared with the translation models based on Base, SwitchOut, SCA and other technologies, the evaluation value of the translation model based on data enhancement technology of the proposed parts-of-speech substitution is increased by 0.08, 0.15 and 0.07 respectively, and its evaluation result is better, which is more in line with the actual translation requirements. Based on the model training method of iterative back translation, the model performance is further enhanced with the increase of iterative back translation times. When the number of iterative back translation reaches two times, the Bleu value reaches the highest, and the Bleu value of the English-Chinese model and Chinese-English model is 1.85 and 3.73 higher than that of the Base English-Chinese and Chinese-English baseline models, respectively. In the systematic demonstration, the proposed model has good translation effect, has certain practicability, and is worthy of further study.

articleTitle: Ensemble Network for Alzheimer’s Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a common progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by a gradual decline in patients’ behavior, memory, and cognition. However, due to the complexity and low quality of medical images, a single neural network may not fully leverage the relevant features within the images. To address this issue, this paper proposes a multi-network ensemble architecture aiming to improve diagnostic accuracy. In the proposed approach, we employ three different neural networks to process a medical image. Each network has a unique structure and feature extraction capability to better capture relevant information in the images, and their outputs are fused via a fusion layer to obtain the final consensus output. Additionally, we utilize cross-entropy as the loss function to measure the discrepancy between the integrated output and the ground truth, and optimize the network parameters through backpropagation. After the end-to-end training, the resulting model is capable of providing accurate diagnostic results. Experimental results demonstrate that this method can better capture relevant features in medical images, thereby enhancing diagnostic accuracy. It shows potential in the diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease, providing physicians with a reliable auxiliary tool.

articleTitle: Improved 6D Pose Estimation Network Based on the ES6D
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: According to the discontinuity of the threedimensional rotation representation and the singleness of pose estimation method in the ES6D pose estimation network, this paper designs a dual decoder to replace the decoder in the original ES6D. First, this paper make lightweight improvements to ES6D's decoder as an explicit decoder, and use six-dimensional(6D) rotation coefficients to replace quaternions to represent three-dimensional(3D) rotations. Then, this paper designs an implicit decoder with a different working mechanism to assist the training of the supervised explicit encoder. Finally, this paper performs fine-grained learning by freezing the parameters of decoders to enhance pose consistency. Experiments show that the parameters and calculations of the improved decoder in the inference stage are reduced by 33.2% and 33.4% respectively, the inference speed is increased by 20.4%, and the accuracy on the mainstream data sets LineMOD and YCB-Video is increased by 1.0% and 0.6% respectively, and the convergence speed is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Construction of Ideological and Political Employment Demand Prediction Model Based on IGA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To help students majoring in ideology and politic to achieve better employment, an ideological and political employment demand prediction model based on an improved BP neural network is proposed. Among them, the improved genetic algorithm (IGA) is used to optimize the parameters of traditional BP neural network, so as to further improve the accuracy of employment demand prediction. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional BP neural network and the BP neural network optimized by traditional genetic algorithm, IGA-BP neural network has better prediction accuracy. When using the constructed prediction model to carry out ideological and political employment demand prediction, the error of the prediction results is relatively low, and it is always kept within 2%. Therefore, the ideological and political employment demand prediction mode based on IGA-BP neural network has good prediction performance, which can provide more abundant guidance data for graduates, and has high credibility.

articleTitle: Fusing Transformer and FCN for Polyp Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Colonoscopy is a medical examination method used to identify colon polyps and plays a crucial role in preventing the occurrence of serious colon abnormalities. This is because colonoscopy enables the direct visualization of the affected area, enhancing its significance in healthcare. However, manually segmenting polyps in colonoscopy images is very difficult, so it is important to achieve accurate polyp segmentation using deep learning techniques. The polyp images in different colonoscopies have complex diversity, and existing deep learning models are prone to overfitting and cannot handle unexposed polyp images, Therefore, enhancing the models’ generalization capability is crucial.In addressing this issue, we introduce a novel model for polyp segmentation. Our model adopts a 4-layer pyramid structure, and the encoder combines Transformer and FCN, where FCN can better extract features containing local information, while Transformer can extract global features better through its self-attention mechanism. By combining FCN and Transformer, the encoder of the model can extract both local features and global features at multiple scales to better understand the image content and improve the generalization ability of the model. In addition, our model uses a PLD decoder. Our model excels in the field of image segmentation, demonstrating outstanding generalization performance that surpasses that of currently available models.

articleTitle: Research on the Implementation Path of the National Credit Bank for Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This article utilizes the characteristics of the consortium blockchain and proposes a solution of "blockchain+application" based on the study of the construction of existing credit banks. On preserving the existing academic performance management systems of various universities, credit banking systems of various provinces and cities, national credit bank information platform for vocational education, and 1+X certificate management system, this paper use plug-in methods to read and transfer credit data from various existing systems to alliance chains. Each super node will publish it after consensus, and each super node will save a copy of the latest school credit data ledger. Then, use the SDK/API to recognize, accumulate, and convert learning outcomes, as well as achieve the function of credit banking.

articleTitle: Generating Secure Fingerprint Templates via Random Dropout and Local Bin-Wise Max out Hashing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Cancelable biometrics is an effective measure to combat malicious attacks. Existing methods generally suffer from redundant feature magnitude or deteriorated accuracy, which may limit the usage of biometric data. In this paper, we propose a secure fingerprint template generation scheme to transform the unprotected fingerprint feature into a compact (only 64bytes) and cancelable fingerprint binary codes via random dropout and local bin-wise max out hashing. This representation enables efficient matching, and high security and can also combined with advanced encryption schemes (e.g., fuzzy commitment). Extensive experiments conducted on FVC2002 and FVC2004 fingerprint datasets coupled with comprehensive theoretical analyses attested that the proposed method offers high matching accuracy and strong anti-attack resilience. Besides, the requirements of revocability, unlinkability, and non-invertibility are also well guaranteed.

articleTitle: Construction of a Text Feature Extraction Model Based on Improved SVM for Chinese Elements of Japanese Literature
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: China and Japan have close ties with each other in various aspects such as economy, politics and culture. Japanese literary works are rich in Chinese cultural elements. It is important to extract texts containing Chinese elements from a large number of Japanese literary works to promote the common development of Chinese and Japanese cultures. Accordingly, the study constructs a Word2Vec-based word vector generation model to extract features of Chinese elements in Japanese literary works, and then constructs an improved support vector machine based text feature classification model to classify the extracted Chinese element features. The experimental results show that when the text vector dimension is 300, the F1 values of TF-IDF-Word2Vec and AVG-Word2Vec are 0.914 and 0.899, respectively, and the F1 value of TF-IDF-Word2Vec method is 0.015 higher than that of AVG-Word2Vec, with significantly better performance than that of AVG-Word2Vec Word2Vec word embedding weighting method. This indicates that the word vector weighting model proposed in the study can extract text features and perform classification relatively accurately. The study provides support for the analysis of Chinese elements in Japanese literary works to promote cultural exchange.

articleTitle: Classroom Evaluation and Impact in Sino-Foreign Cooperative Education Through the Integration of WOA and Multimodal Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Improving the quality of education has always been one of the focuses in the field of education, especially in the Chinese-foreign cooperative classroom, how to accurately evaluate the quality of teaching to improve the effect of education becomes particularly important. The study proposes a teaching quality evaluation method for Chinese-foreign cooperative schools based on multi-modal information fusion, comprehensively considering students' cognitive attention, learning emotion and course acceptance and other multidimensional information. It introduces the weight allocation method of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy method combined with whale algorithm to solve the problems in teaching and improve the quality of teaching through the evaluation of teaching quality. Finally, the feasibility of the method is verified. The experimental results show that the model can effectively process multidimensional information for students, for example, the attention coefficient of student 1 rises gradually at the beginning of the class, but decreases in the middle and late stages of the class, and ends up at 0.32, the emotion coefficient reaches up to 0.92, and the answering rate and the answering rate of correctness are both higher, 100% and 90%, respectively. Student 2's attention coefficient fluctuated, eventually reaching 0.73, and the mood coefficient was relatively stable, ranging from 0.52 to 0.78, with an answer rate of 95% and a correct answer rate of 80%. In the comparison experiment, the difference between the results of multi-modal information fusion and the real classroom teaching quality is as low as 0.02 score and as high as 0.04 score, while the difference between the single-dimension evaluation model and the real classroom teaching quality is as high as 0.22 score. On the whole, the evaluation method of teaching quality based on multi-modal information fusion has high accuracy in Chinese-foreign cooperative education, and is of great significance to the evaluation of teaching quality.

articleTitle: PerDetect: A Personalized Arrhythmia Detection System Based on Unsupervised Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease has become a common cause of death. Arrhythmia is a common cardiovascular disease. Cardiovascular disease has become a common cause of death. Arrhythmia is a common cardiovascular disease. Deep learning has been widely used in arrhythmia detection. However, the application of unsupervised learning to arrhythmia detection is not extensive. This paper proposes a personalized arrhythmia detection system PerDetect based on an unsupervised autoencoder. The system trains a separate BiLSTM-based autoencoder BiAE for each patient for arrhythmia detection. BiAE only needs to use the patient’s normal heartbeat for training, which effectively avoids the problem of data imbalance. We carried out experiments on MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database. Experiments show that the system only needs a small amount of ECG training data (within five minutes) to achieve good performance. The ACC of our method on MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database is 97%.

articleTitle: Research on Femoral Prosthesis Location in Single Ankle Knee Arthroplasty Based on Harris Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of prosthesis implantation in total knee replacement surgery, a femoral prosthesis location method for unicompartmental knee arthroplasty based on Harris algorithm is proposed. The method first converts the knee joint or femur model image into point cloud data based on the PCL point cloud library. Then, the method uses Harris-3D algorithm to extract the feature points of the surgical site. Finally, SAC-IA+ICP combination registration method is utilized to register the feature points, so as to achieve the implantation of a femoral prosthesis for knee joint single ankle surgery. The test results show that the proposed method can accurately locate the position of femoral prosthesis in unicompartmental knee arthroplasty, and the location error is controlled less than 2mm, which effectively improves the location accuracy of the femoral prosthesis in unicompartmental knee arthroplasty, meets the requirements of surgical accuracy, and is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Design and Research of College English Grammar Correction Model Based on Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes an English grammar error correction model based on improved Transformer model to further improve the error correction effect in college English language teaching. Among them, Transformer model is used as the basic semantic information extraction method, and the replication mechanism is introduced to further improve the error correction effect of the model. The experimental results show that compared with other error correction models, the proposed error correction model has better error correction performance, with precision (P), recall (R), and F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>-score of 68.69%, 33.59%, and 55.54%, respectively. Compared with the pre-training model corresponding to other types of pseudo-parallel corpus generation methods, the pre-training model corresponding to the pseudo-parallel corpus generation method has the best performance on three evaluation indicators. In summary, the English grammar error correction model constructed in this paper has good error correction performance, which can be applied in college foreign language teaching, further improve the learning effect of learning, and has certain feasibility.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Power Line Transmission Corridor Objects Based on UVA Lidar Point Cloud Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The point cloud data in the power line corridor is huge, and the key basic technology for automatic inspection of power lines and pylons is the filtering and storage of point cloud data, as well as the extraction, rendering, and reconstruction of power lines, Pylons, obstacles, vegetation and buildings. Ruizhuo Zhang and Bisheng Yang proposed a method only for extracting powerlines and pylons from point cloud data. In this article, based on the geomorphic characteristics of Jinhua area in Zhejiang Province, firstly, the filtering, modifiable octree storage, 3D modeling, algorithm for the extraction of powerlines, pylons, builds, rivers, and high and low vegetation is given. Secondly, a method combining Modified Nested octree (MNO) storage, levels of detail (LOD) technology, and random ray removal based on Halton sequences are proposed to render point cloud images. In the rendered image, you can also measure the length of powerline, point coordinates, angles, and block area and perimeter. The method was tested through three experiments, and the results showed that the rendering speed was fast, the effect was smooth, and the rendered point cloud data capacity was only limited by hardware GPU memory.

articleTitle: Implementation of Intelligent Grasping of Intelligent Robot Based on Graph Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To solve the problem of low accuracy of traditional robots in perceiving and grasping objects, a GA-PointNet++intelligent grasping robot based on graph attention mechanism and deep learning network architecture is designed. Firstly, binocular vision was utilized to collect the point cloud information of the target objects. Then, the 3D perception algorithm was used to process 3D reconstruction information, and the processing results were transmitted to the intelligent robot. Finally, GA-PointNet++ network model was used to locate and grasp the 3D reconstruction information. The results show that the average classification accuracy and overall accuracy of the proposed model are 88.8% and 91.3%, respectively, which are higher than those of the traditional VoxNet network, PointNet network and PointNet++ network models. Moreover, the grasping success rate of the intelligent robot based on GA-PointNet++ network model is up to 96.7%, and the grasping accuracy is significantly improved. Therefore, the model can effectively improve the grasping accuracy of intelligent robots, and its grasping effect is remarkable.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of Deep Learning-Based Grammar Error Correction in College English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In traditional English teaching, students are extremely dependent on the teacher, which makes it difficult for students to get appropriate guidance after leaving the classroom, resulting in lower learning efficiency. To address the above problems, the study proposes an English grammar error correction model based on the adaptive moment estimation-Transformer model. The experimental results show that the average precision rate, average recall rate and average F0.5 value of this model in different corpora are about 65.3%, 36.0% and 0.543 respectively at the lowest level, which are higher than that of the multilayer convolutional encoder-decoder model and the deep contextual categorization model; in the correction of different types of grammatical errors, only prepositional errors have a lower recall rate, which is about 0.089, and the rest of the indicators are higher than that of the the other two models. The above results show that the English grammar error correction model based on adaptive moment estimation-Transformer model performs better for English grammar error correction.

articleTitle: Research on Image Classification Algorithm Based on CSNet
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a convolutional neural network (CSNet) based on channel separation and re-fusion for the problem of parameter redundancy with the single convolution core of traditional convolutional neural network and the large stack of network structures. First, to solve the problems of single feature extraction and insufficient feature extraction caused by using a single convolution kernel to extract features, as well as the problem of large parameters commonly encountered in traditional convolution neural networks, based on the separation of convolution structures, a feature extraction method based on convolutional structure separation was proposed, which reduces the number of parameters and can extract increasingly rich features. Secondly, by introducing dense residual structure, the network can ensure better feature fusion under low parameters, maximize the utilization of features, improve the generalization ability of the network, speed up network training, and avoid the problem of gradient disappearance during training. Then, the attention separation mechanism is introduced to enable the network to focus on the key and important information among the numerous information without introducing parameters, so as to strengthen the network's attention to features and its ability to extract features. Finally, taking MINIST, CIRFA10, CIFAR100, and Mini ImageNet-100 datasets as experimental objects, the experimental results show that the CSNet network can guarantee high performance while ensuring low parameter quantities. The Top1 accuracy on the test sets of the four datasets is 99.42%, 90.88%, 69.19%, and 68.68% respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Graduation Destination Prediction Algorithm Based on Students’ Learning Behavior Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the popularization of higher education, colleges and universities and educational institutions are increasingly concerned about students' performance and development during the learning process, and hope to improve graduation and employment rates through effective prediction methods. The study first preprocesses the data, then uses the clustering algorithm to study the correlation between the graduation trend of the graduating cohort and the students' competency indicators, and selects the best model from multiple classification algorithms through cross-validation, and predicts students' future graduation destinations with Micro-F1 and Macro-F1 values. The experimental results show that the key points of graduation direction are student's professional ability>student's behavioral regularity in school>student's family economic condition>student's personal interest, and the accurate prediction rate is 70.7%, which is significantly higher than the 44.8% accuracy of random guessing, indicating that the data mining algorithms can more accurately predict the future graduation direction of the students, and it is expected that they provide useful references for the colleges and universities to provide scientific decision-making and personalized counseling for the students. It is expected to provide a useful reference for colleges and universities to provide scientific decision-making and personalized counseling for students.

articleTitle: Lifelong SLAM Based on Environmental Semantic and Depth Information in Dynamic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithm is robust enough when used on static scenes. However, it is less robust when used in dynamic scenes where objects move for an extended period in indoor scenes. In order to address the mentioned issues, this paper proposes an indoor dynamic scene localization and map construction algorithm that combines environmental semantic with depth information. Based on the ORB-SLAM2 framework: First, we perform semantic segmentation on keyframes to obtain the mask, then we combine the mask and optical flow algorithm to estimate the motion properties of environmental objects and remove dynamic features. Second, keyframe pose, semantic label, and depth information are combined to identify scene loop. Finally, we filter the keyframes twice and construct a static semantic map. We conducted experiments in a dynamic simulation environment and TUM dataset. The result shows that the proposed algorithm can maintain high localization and loop detection accuracy in dynamic scenes, and the static semantic map can reliably describe the scene, reflecting better lifelong localization robustness.

articleTitle: A Mixed-Integer Programming Approach for Complete Coverage Task Allocation of Heterogeneous Robots with Startup Time Cost
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of complete coverage task allocation for a heterogeneous robot team operating in a mapped workarea like an indoor building. The robots in the team have varying execution speeds, and the startup cost of robots’ traversing from the depot to its nearest allocated regions is also considered. We present a new allocation approach utilizing Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) to tackle the heterogeneity and startup requirements. The solution of this approach is featured threefold: balanced task allocation; connectivity of the allocated regions to facilitate a safe robot execution without interference to other robots; disjoint task allocation. We present a case study showcasing the practicability of this approach in the robotic complete coverage scenario. And we further studied the performance of our approach in mapped workareas for different numbers of heterogeneous robots and demonstrated its effectiveness. Notably, this approach can successfully optimally allocate instances with a combinatorial space of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">100</sup> within a reasonable time.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Recommendation System for Learning Methods Based on Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The current mainstream machine learning algorithmic recommender systems suffer from the problems of difficulty in training at low feature counts, probabilistic operations, and inaccurate recommendation results derived in data sparse environments. To address these problems, this study builds a learning path recommendation model based on Bayesian networks that can use Bayesian network models to characterize the relationship between knowledge points, diagnose learners' mastery of a certain knowledge point by monitoring learners' learning behaviors and learners' tests, and adjust the learning content scheduling scheme according to learners' differences. The experimental results show that the overall hit rate, normalized loss gain, and coverage rate of the Bayesian network-based learning path recommendation model are higher than those of other algorithmic models, with the overall hit rate above 61%, the normalized loss gain of 39.3%, and the coverage rate of 41.8%, and the Bayesian networkbased learning recommender system is still able to give personalized recommendations when the learner profile information is small. The results of this research have some value in the field of recommender system development and can be used as a technical reference.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Chemical Mechanical Polishing of Hard and Brittle Materials Based on Adaptive Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to explore the relationship between the surface quality of hard and brittle materials and the parameters of chemical mechanical polishing process, and then realize the purpose of improving the surface quality and processing speed of hard and brittle materials, this paper proposes a modeling method based on adaptive neural network to construct the surface roughness model and material removal rate model, respectively, and then conducts training and testing on them. The test results show that the maximum error of the hard and brittle material roughness model is 12.7%, the MAPE value is 5.22%, and the R2 value is 0.9984. The maximum error of the hard and brittle material removal rate model is 14.1%, the MAPE value is 5.31%, and the R2 value is 0.9896. Both models have good generalization ability and regression ability. Furthermore, both models have high prediction accuracy and can recognize the data in the test set more accurately.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization and Visualization of Biostatistical Method Based on Improved Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes an image recognition method of biological cancer cells based on improved Unet model to assist doctors in carrying out more accurate disease diagnosis. Among them, Unet model is taken as the basic image recognition method, and the recognition performance of the model is further improved by adding attention module and residual module. The experimental results show that compared with other image recognition methods, the designed Unet model based on mixed attention mechanism and residual module has higher recognition accuracy, and the recognized images are more close to the real image, with MPA, Miou, and Dice of 0.86, 0.73, and 0.85, respectively. Therefore, the designed image recognition method of biological cancer cells based on improved Unet model has high recognition accuracy, can be applied to actual diagnosis and treatment scenarios, and can assist doctors in conducting more accurate disease diagnosis, which has high feasibility.

articleTitle: Automated Renal Tumor Segmentation with V-Net and Morphological Post-Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning-based segmentation framework is proposed to segment the renal tumors in computed tomography (CT) images. In particular, to overcome the challenges of complex kidney structures and the diversity of tumors, the segmentation is regarded as a two-stage task in a coarse-to-fine manner, where the V-Net architecture is employed as the segmentation model, which introduces the residual connections to facilitate the gradient flow so as to sufficiently extract the features in regions of interests. Moreover, by applying the morphological post-processing optimization techniques, the segmented results are further refined to improve the accuracy. Experiments show the superiority of the proposed framework, which obtains the average accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of 99.937%, 86.886%, and 99.964%, respectively, suggesting the valuable significance in preoperative analysis and clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Management System of Surveying and Mapping Archives Based on Improved FA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a task assignment method of surveying and mapping archives management system based on improved adaptive firefly algorithm optimized ant colony algorithm to further improve the level of enterprise data management. Among them, the ant colony algorithm is used as the basic task assignment algorithm in the surveying and mapping archives management system, and the improved firefly algorithm is utilized to optimize it, thereby further optimizing the task assignment scheme of the system. The experimental simulation results show that compared with the standard ant colony algorithm, the designed ant colony algorithm improved based on the adaptive firefly algorithm has stronger convergence ability, and the optimized path length obtained is shortened by more than 5 units. Compared with the task assignment scheme before optimization, the optimized task assignment scheme is more reasonable, which avoids the extreme situation of task assignment and achieves the balanced assignment of tasks. Therefore, using the optimized task allocation scheme to perform task assignment of the surveying and mapping archives management system can achieve more reasonable task assignment, thus achieving better system management, with high feasibility.

articleTitle: A Semi-Supervised Clustering-Based Approach for Sensing and Classifying Unknown Attacks in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To solve the problem of perceiving and classifying unknown attacks in power systems, the study proposes a method for perceiving and classifying unknown attacks in power systems based on semi-supervised clustering. The method first uses a hybrid algorithm of improved genetic algorithm (GA) and improved multi-grain cascade forest (GC-forest) power network system unknown attack for perception and detection, then increases the number of training data by marking extension algorithm, provides specific information of detected attack or event using the idea of semi-supervised clustering, and finally filters the clustered unknown attack or event using similarity metric method . The analysis of the performance results testing showed that the perceptual detection of unknown attacks by the improved GC-Forest and the improved Genetic Algorithm (GA) had a check-all rate, precision and accuracy of 97.1% and 96.9%, 98.9% and 98.6%, 99.0% and 98.7%, respectively, and the average computing time was 3.12s and 3.68, respectively. for the classification of unknown attack types, the semi-supervised clustering-based (SSL) classification method has 100%, 95% and 95% classification accuracy for normal, non-power network attacks and power network attacks, respectively, while the adaptive classification method has 100%, 92%-98% and 90%-95%, respectively. Taken together, these data illustrate that the research can efficiently and accurately sense and classify unknown attacks on power systems and provide some reference value for fault sensing and classification in other areas.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Image Processing System Based on FPGA and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of large amount of moving image data and difficulty in transmission, a moving image processing system based on FPGA and neural network is proposed. The hardware composition of the system is studied and the key modules such as FPGA module and storage module in the system are analyzed and designed, and an FPGA-based neural network realization method is proposed. Experimental results show that this method can achieve reliable compression of moving images. The compression effect is related to the number of neurons in the hidden layer. The more the number of neurons, the higher the signal-to-noise ratio of the compressed image.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of VR Teaching Resource Library for Animation Major in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the utilization efficiency of VR teaching resources for animation major in higher vocational colleges and perfect the resource library, a personalized teaching resource recommendation algorithm for big data background is proposed, and a personalized teaching resource recommendation list is generated by predicting students' interest. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of the personalized teaching resource recommendation algorithm proposed in this paper is 12.17%, the average recall rate is 25.88%, and the average F1 value is 12.35%, which are significantly higher than those of the traditional user-based collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm and item-based collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm. In addition, as the number of recommended resources increases, the F1 value of the proposed algorithm increases continuously and stably. It can be seen that the personalized teaching resource recommendation algorithm designed in this paper has the best recommendation effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Improved SSD Algorithm in the Intelligent Recognition Model of Anime Characters
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to apply object detection techniques with better detection performance to anime character detection, an improved Single Shot MulmtiBox Detector (SSD) algorithm is proposed. Based on the basic SSD algorithm, the research introduces a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) upsampling module in feature layer prediction, and replaces the VGGNet network structure in the basic algorithm with ResNet network structure as the front-end network structure. And introduce weight parameters to adjust the proportion balance in the samples, optimize the training strategy of the algorithm, and obtain the final improved SSD algorithm, further improving the detection accuracy and speed of the algorithm. The study compared the performance of the improved SSD algorithm with other algorithms on the COCO dataset and the anime character dataset. The results showed that the improved SSD algorithm achieved an average accuracy (mAP) of 0.78, a positioning error of 0.04, a recall rate of 0.87, and a processing speed of 18 FPS on the COCO dataset, all of which were the best among the algorithms. The algorithm achieved a detection AP value of 0.82 for character 30. The average detection time of the improved SSD algorithm is 32ms, and the MAP reaches 0.74, which is the highest among all algorithms. At the same time, experiments were conducted on the value of the weight parameter. When the weight parameter value was 1, the detection mAP value remained stable at 0.77, achieving the best detection effect. The results show that the improved SSD algorithm proposed in the study has superior detection performance, and has further improved detection accuracy and speed, providing a certain experimental basis for the detection research of anime characters.

articleTitle: Construction of Macroeconomic Data Analysis Model Based on Improved BP Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the analysis accuracy of China's macroeconomic data, a prediction model based on LSTM+BP combined neural network is proposed. By combining the LSTM long short term neural network that can save the long-time sequence data and automatically match the optimal time interval with the BP neural network that completes the weight allocation and update of the neural network through error back propagation, the learning ability of the model on the historical energy dimension data is improved, and the prediction performance of the model is finally improved. The experimental results show that the on the training set, fitting results of the proposed combined model are consistent with the real curve, and the error is always within 0.7, so the fitting effect is better. It can be seen from the verification on the prediction set that the prediction results of the proposed combined model in the past three years are close to the real results. Compared with single neural network models such as LSTM, BP and WNN, the average error of MPAE error is reduced by 5.09%, 3.8% and 0.04% respectively, which proves that the proposed model has better prediction performance and generalization, and is more suitable for the analysis and research of China's macroeconomic data.

articleTitle: AugReID: Transformer-Based Augmentation Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Person re-identification (ReID) is a crucial component of computer vision that has garnered increased attention in recent years, primarily due to its importance in applications such as video surveillance. However, existing research predominantly focuses on ReID performance in ideal dataset environments, often overlooking the challenges associated with implementing ReID algorithms in real-world deployment scenarios. In these real-world situations, variations in light intensity and resolution between edge-end cameras can considerably hinder the accurate interpretation of person characteristics. To address these challenges, we propose an augmentation strategy to simulate interference in real-world deployment scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce a noise fusion model structure, AugReID, designed to account for the impact of illumination, resolution, and other factors on the ReID task. Extensive experiments on holistic ReID datasets demonstrate our model’s effectiveness. Additionally, our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods on the Occluded ReID task, which contains more noise-related elements and closely resembles real deployment environments.

articleTitle: Lithium Battery SOH Estimation Based on EMD-BIGRU Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The Battery Management System (BMS) plays a critical role in ensuring the performance and safety of electric vehicles. Accurately estimating the state of health (SOH) of lithium batteries is an important part of the BMS. This paper proposes a model that combines empirical mode decomposition (EMD) and bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BIGRU) neural networks to estimate the SOH of lithium batteries. First, analyze the incremental capacity analysis (ICA) curve of the lithium battery under the state of constant current charging and extract the peak value, and select 5 parameters such as the constant current charging time as the SOH estimations characteristic parameters. Next, principal component analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the feature parameters to a 3-dimensional dataset. Then, the lithium battery SOH signal is decomposed using EMD to obtain Res and IMF components. Finally, BIGRU is used to estimate the high and low-frequency signals, and the signals are integrated to obtain the SOH estimations result. After experiments, the MAE and RMSE of the lithium battery SOH estimations model proposed in this paper reached 1.44 % and 1.52%, respectively, basically realizing the accurate estimations of SOH.

articleTitle: Implementation of Few-Shot Image Recognition Technology Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the recognition effect of few-shot images, a few-shot image recognition method based on prototype enhancement and attention mechanism is proposed. Among them, the few-shot image recognition algorithm based on prototype network is taken as the basic algorithm, attention mechanism is taken as the feature extraction method, and the prototype network is enhanced and improved, so as to further improve the recognition accuracy. The experimental results show that compared with other few-shot image recognition algorithms, the designed recognition method based on prototype enhancement and attention mechanism can maintain high recognition accuracy while keeping the network structure light. On the data set Mini-ImageNet, the recognition accuracy of the designed method for 1-shot task and 5-shot task is 65.31% and 74.16%, respectively. On the data set CUB-200, the recognition accuracy of the model for 1-shot task and 5-shot task reaches 75.88% and 86.26%, respectively. In summary, the designed few-shot image recognition method based on prototype enhancement and attention mechanism can effectively improve the recognition effect of few-shot images, can be applied in practical engineering scenarios, and has high feasibility.

articleTitle: Communication Network Management Data Mining Based on RPA and Parallel BP Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to ensure the security of information transmission of enterprise Intranet and solve the problem of low accuracy of the traffic recognition method matched by traditional features, an recognition method based on improved BP and Spark cluster is proposed, and the method is applied to the traffic recognition of KDD99 data set and Robotic Process automation (RPA) traffic monitoring platform. The results show that compared with Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithm and Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm, the improved BP algorithm has higher recognition accuracy, accuracy, detection rate and false detection rate are 10.5%, 5.4% and 12.3%, 6.2%, respectively, and it shows good recognition performance. In the Spark cluster environment, the average training time and testing time of the improved Back Propagation (BP) neural network are 771.4s and 639.991s less than those of the improved BP model in single machine, respectively, showing that the recognition time is greatly shortened, and it has a good recognition rate. With the increase of cluster nodes, the training time of the improved BP model is always kept at a low level. It is concluded that the improved BP based on SPARK cluster+improved BP can be used to recognize abnormal traffic of Intranet transmission.

articleTitle: Co-Association Matrix Refining for Clustering Ensemble via Symmetric Non-Negative Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Clustering ensemble is an important problem in unsupervised learning. A consensus result can be obtained by integrating different base clusterings, which can often improve the robustness and stability of a single clustering method. Many clustering ensemble methods apply the co-association matrix to do the ensemble. However, since the base clustering results are imperfect, the co-association matrix constructed from the clustering results are also unreliable. To address this issue, we present an approach based on a refined co-association matrix. We find the unreliable values in the initial co-association matrix and refine them with a symmetric non-negative matrix factorization method. We can get the ultimate result from the refined matrix. At last, the experiments on benchmark data sets show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Control System of Warehouse AGV Car Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of huge control system and inaccurate navigation and positioning of warehouse Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) car, this paper designs a control system of warehouse AGV car based on Programmable Logic Controller (PLC). The system takes PLC as the control core, realizes the navigation of AGV car by visual guidance, and realizes accurate positioning by identifying Quick Response (QR) code; The autonomous obstacle avoidance of AGV vehicle is realized by lidar, and the AGV vehicle will make corresponding adjustments when the identified data is transmitted to the main control system. The test results show that the system can realize the control of AGV car, and has high accuracy and safety, which provides a reference for the design and application of the control system of AGV car.

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Driving Decision-Making Technology Based on IRF-SAC Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Unmanned driving decision-making is an important field of unmanned vehicle research. Traditional unmanned driving decision-making technology cannot deal with complex road conditions. Therefore, a driving intention-risk composite field (Driving Intention & Risk Field, IRF) decision-making scheme is proposed based on the artificial field situation. Based on the attributes of destinations, vehicles, and road boundaries, they are modeled individually and consolidated in IRF as potential fields. Moreover, the developed IRF model collaborates with the Soft Actor Critic (SAC) maximum entropy model to establish an IRF-SAC unmanned driving decision-making inspection platform. This platform aids in the completion of the unmanned driving decision-making analysis. The high-speed and cross-road scenarios are used to test the effect of the model. During the high-speed scenario decision-making, the IRF-SAC model's accuracy has increased by 32.6% and 30.6% compared to the decision-making state machine model and the rapid expansion random tree model, respectively. In the intersection scene, the decision-making of the IRF-SAC model is more adaptable, leading to better timeliness. The research content has the potential to bring about new advancements and progress in the development and implementation of unmanned driving technology.

articleTitle: Research on Education Data Association Rule Mining Based on Optimized Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the university teaching quality, a Apriori algorithm based on difference lifting degree is proposed to mine association rules for college students' curriculum program data. Among them, Apriori algorithm is used as the basic data association rule mining algorithm, and it is improved by introducing a difference-based lifting degree, so as to further enhance the association rule mining effect. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional Apriori algorithm, the Apriori algorithm based on difference lifting degree can further screen the mined association rules, and the number of association rules obtained is more refined. When the improved Apriori algorithm is applied to the mining of grade data association rules for students majoring in information, the accurate association rules between course grades can be mined. In summary, the improved Apriori algorithm designed has good effect when applied to student grade data mining, which can obtain association rules between grade data and help students better grasp their own learning situation. At the same time, it can also help teachers conduct more targeted adjustments on teaching calculations and further improve teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Emission Prediction of Mountain Road Construction Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: A carbon emission prediction model based on improved seagull optimization algorithm optimized BP neural network (iSOA-BP) is proposed to effectively reduce carbon emissions during mountain road construction. Among them, BP neural network is used as the basic prediction model, and the improved seagull optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of BP network, so as to further improve the prediction accuracy. The results show that compared with other classical swarm optimization algorithms, the seagull optimization algorithm based on nonlinear inertia weight can help the parameters to decay in a nonlinear path, and has a faster convergence rate. Compared with other classic prediction algorithms, the proposed prediction model based on iSOA-BP has higher prediction accuracy, and the MAE, RMSE, and MAPE of the proposed model is 0.2298, 0.5103, and 0.1203, respectively. In summary, the prediction model of iSOA-BP can improve the accuracy of carbon emission prediction, thereby providing an accurate carbon emission decision-making basis for mountain road construction.

articleTitle: Computational Results Comparison of Discrete Time-Varying Nonlinear Optimization: A Recurrent Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new discrete-time neural network model to solve the discrete time-varying nonlinear optimization (DTNO) problems, and the truncation error of this model is raised to the fourth order for improving the calculative accuracy. Above all, the continuous time-varying nonlinear optimization (CTNO) problem is converted into the continuoustime Zhang neural network (ZNN) model through the ZNN design formula. Subsequently, a new discrete-time Zhang neural network (DTZNN) model is proposed rooted in the fundamental principles of general four-step discretization formula (FDF). Note that the proposed DTZNN model has a residual error with fourth-order pattern. During this process, in order to further investigate the impact of parameters for the truncation error, the optimal range of parameter is determined through comparative experiments. The final numerical experimental results indicate that the DTZNN model has the expected truncation error. When the values of parameter are confined within a specified range and remain relatively small, the calculative accuracy can further be improved.

articleTitle: Noise Figure Calibration Technology Based on Cold Source Method and Its Engineering Application
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the development of the field of high-end precision device testing and measurement, noise figure, as an important parameter characterizing two-port networks, has also received increasing attention from researchers. The noise performance of microwave electronic systems can have a significant impact on their measurement results, so calibrating the noise figure is a necessary function of high-performance measurement instruments. This paper proposes a noise figure calibration technique based on the cold source method, relying on the domestic vector network analyzer platform. The method proposed in this article only requires the addition of a noise source calibration step and measurement on the basis of the standard S-parameter calibration process, without any other complex operations, to calculate and correct the noise figure of the vector network itself. Finally, this article validated the calibration of noise figure using a domestic network analyzer as a platform, introduced the overall calibration process, and compared the actual measurement values of the amplifier obtained with the device specifications.

articleTitle: Research on Platform Construction and Path Planning of UAV Inspection Pylons
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: At present, the inspection of power lines mainly relies on drones and cameras to inspect the lines. Through image analysis, certain faults in power lines and Pylon can be detected, but the inspection of power lines has not yet been fully intelligent, mainly reflected in the automatic determination of cruising route, automatic avoidance of obstacles, and automatic detection of Pylons' faults. This article proposes to obtain all possible cruising routes by constructing Voronoi diagrams, the least expensive planar scanning method for Voronoi graph was used for construction all possible paths, the time and spatial complexity of the algorithm are O (nlogn) and O (n) memory. Determine the inspection path with the goal of minimum inspection time, avoid obstacles, and inspect all inspection points. And an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) automatic inspection platform for power lines in Jinhua area, Zhejiang Province was constructed, Base on this platform, a case study was presented using actual inspention point coordinates and obstacles as data, the results indicates that not only does the cruising route avoid obstacles, the flight route around obstacles is also relatively smooth, but the cruising path is the shortest.

articleTitle: Research on English Automatic Recognition System Based on OCR Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To realize accurate recognition of English text of pictures, a handwritten English text recognition system based on OCR technology is proposed. Among them, Tesseract is used as the recognition framework, CNN+LSTM neural network model is used as the text information extraction model, and the collected English text images are preprocessed to further improve the effect of text recognition. The experimental results show that the designed handwritten English text recognition system can carry out accurate text recognition with high integrity. Compared with CNN neural network alone, CNN+LSTM can extract text with higher precision. The above results show that the designed English text recognition system has excellent performance and can be applied to practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on the External Output Strategy of Traditional Cultural Children's Books Based on Multi-feature Integration and Collaborative Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the recommendation effect of traditional culture children's books, this paper proposes an improved multi-feature fusion recommendation model, namely RNN-BPNN-MF-CF-CM (RBMCC) recommendation model. Among them, recurrent neural network is used as the basic recommendation model, multi-feature fusion is realized through the back-propagation neural network, and finally the recommendation content is scored through the constructed scoring matrix. The results show that the proposed consumption prediction recommendation model reaches the minimum prediction error when the sequence length is 1000, so the user long-term behavior sequence length is set as 1000. Compared with the model before improvement and the baseline model 1-gram, MF, HMM, 2-gram, the RBMCC recommendation model can maintain higher prediction accuracy when predicting user consumption behavior, and the average log-likelihood loss of the prediction results is only 3.55. The above results show that the designed RBMCC recommendation model for traditional German culture children's book recommendation can accurately predict user consumption behavior, thereby making the recommendation effect better.

articleTitle: Genetic Risk Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease Based on CNN Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the genetic risk of Alzheimer's disease, a genetic risk prediction method based on CNN network is proposed. According to the additive effect and interaction of SNP, a two-branch CNN risk prediction model is constructed. Experiments show that the risk prediction model of CNN has the best prediction effect on the genetic risk prediction of Alzheimer's disease. Compared with the combinatorial polygenic and epistatic genetic risk evaluation method CRSs, the predicted values of various indicators of the risk prediction model of CNN are further improved. In terms of the accuracy (ACC), the ACC of the proposed prediction method increases by 0.9% compared with CRSs, and is 1.4% and 1.5% higher than that of the risk prediction model based on machine model XGBoost and MLP, respectively, showing the best prediction effect and worthy of being used in future studies on the genetic risk prediction of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: The Brain Activities under Real Crisp Cutting Sound: An Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response (ASMR) Study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: ASMR which can be evoked by many ways, is one of the sensory phenomena that has been noticed recently. Its mechanism is still obscure. Real sound which contains abundantly wide-frequency information is one of the most popular evoked ways. This study aims to explore the ASMR’s mechanism evoked by real crisp cutting sound. The brain activities under real sound stimulus, white noise stimulus and no stimulus are analyzed. A quantized index is proposed to evaluate the effects evoked by these stimuli. A significant enhancement of alpha 1 frequency is disclosed on parietal lobe and occipital lobe under the real crisp cutting sound. The results prove that ASMR owns similar mechanism to compare with attention reduction. This study is favorable to further uncovering the mechanism of ASMR, and thus helpful to explore how the human brain works.

articleTitle: Study on Moisture Content Prediction of Tobacco Leaf Based on Near Infrared Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to realize rapid nondestructive testing of moisture content of fresh tobacco leaves, near infrared spectroscopy was used to collect fresh tobacco leaves.The effects of four pretreatment methods, Multiple scatter correction (MSC), Standard normal variate (SNV), Normalize and Autoscales, on the accuracy of the model were compared.It was found that the model established after pretreatment with MSC had the best effect, Model R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was 0.8145 and RMSE was 0.1185.Two feature band screening methods, continuous projection method (SPA) and competitive adaptive weighted weight algorithm (CARS), were selected for wavelength selection based on the spectral data pretreated by MSC.The results showd that the established MSC-CARS-SVM model has the best effect, with the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was 0.8381 and the root mean square error was 0.1158.It was proved that the near infrared spectroscopy technique could be used to detect the moisture content of fresh tobacco leaf rapidly and nondestructively.

articleTitle: PWM Wave-Based Cooperative Vector Control of Multiple Stepper Motors for Unmanned Surface Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper studies the control system of multiple stepper motors. Four stepper motors are selected to design the vector control system for the actual application scenario of the unmanned surface vehicles. This paper designs a PWM wave-based motor control algorithm taking into account the characteristics of stepper motors. We proposes a closed-loop control algorithm incorporating magnetic encoders. The system applies CAN bus to realize the communication among stepper motors, enabling distributed cooperative control four stepper motors of the unmanned surface vehicles. In this paper, the multiple stepper motor system is modeled and finally simulated and experimentally verified to achieve cooperative vector control of multiple stepper motors for surface vehicles.

articleTitle: PD-REAL: A 3D Anomaly Detection Dataset with Play-Doh and RealSense
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: We present PD-REAL, a novel dataset for unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) in the 3D domain. It is motivated by the fact that 2D-only representations in the AD task may fail to capture the geometric structures of anomalies due to uncertainty in lighting conditions or shooting angles. PD-REAL consists entirely of Play-Doh models for 15 object categories and focuses on the analysis of potential benefits from 3D information in a controlled environment. Specifically, objects are first created with six types of anomalies, such as dent, crack, or perforation, and then photographed under different lighting conditions to mimic real-world inspection scenarios. To demonstrate the usefulness of 3D information, we use a commercially available RealSense camera to capture RGB and depth images. Compared to the existing 3D dataset for AD tasks, the data acquisition of PD-REAL is significantly cheaper, easily scalable and easier to control variables. Extensive evaluations with state-of-the-art AD algorithms on our dataset demonstrate the benefits as well as challenges of using 3D information.

articleTitle: Partially Fake Audio Detection Based on MOSNet with Pretraining Models
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of speech synthesis and voice conversion related technologies, many potential risks have been brought to people’s information security and privacy. Therefore, it is important to build techniques to identify manipulated regions in audios. In this paper, we propose a novel partially fake audio detection system based on MOSNet, a speech quality assessment network, and pretraining models. Comparisions between features extracted by pretraining models and Mel-spectrogram are made. Experimental results show that the proposed system combining MOSNet and XLS-R-300m pretraining model has the best performance on both evaluation set and test set, and has good generalization ability. The final score of the proposed system on test set is 5.97% higher than that of the baseline system based on RawNet.

articleTitle: Research on Software Design of Monitoring System Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: A pier monitoring model based on GA-MIV-BP neural network is designed to solve the problem that the traditional pier monitoring method has low accuracy in predicting current scour depth, which leads to the deterioration of bridge safety. Firstly, genetic algorithm (GA) was used to optimize the BP neural network to construct the GA-BP neural network model. Then, mean impact value (MIV) was added based on the constructed model, and the input factors of the network model were screened by MIV. Finally, the pier scour depth was accurately predicted. The results show that the prediction correlation coefficient of the GA-MIV-BP model is 98.7%, which is 4.1% and 1.2% higher than that of the traditional BP model and the MIV-BP model, respectively. It shows that the model can realize BP neural network optimization after adding MIV factor screening and GA algorithm, and the prediction accuracy of current scour is significantly improved, which further proves that the model meets the software design requirements of the monitoring system.

articleTitle: An Advanced Method for Extracting Fixture Parameters and Its Engineering Application
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the changing market demand, using existing vector network analyzer for fixtures, such as adapters, probes, etc., the accurate extraction of parameters has become a challenge. Based on the existing vector network analyzer function, this paper proposes an advanced fixture parameter extraction method. Using the technology presented in this article for fixture parameter extraction is very convenient. Only one primary calibration (coaxial end) and one secondary calibration (fixture end) need to be performed on the port where the fixture is located to obtain all characteristic parameters of the fixture. Finally, the correctness and engineering value of the proposed method are verified by using the advanced vector network analyzer (CEYEAR CNA) as the experimental platform.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Mortar Compressive Strength Based on Feature Analysis and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of concrete compressive strength, a prediction model of mortar concrete compressive strength based on convolutional neural network is proposed. Among them, the interpretable features related to the mortar concrete compressive strength are analyzed, 9 features are selected as input features of CNN convolutional neural network, and then the compressive strength is predicted by convolutional neural network. The experimental results show that the prediction model of convolutional neural network can achieve accurate prediction of the mortar concrete compressive strength and can accurately describe the change of compressive strength in various scenarios. Compared with the standard method, the prediction accuracy of concrete compressive strength by convolutional neural network is higher, reaching 9.63, 13.84 and 8.53 respectively on the three evaluation indexes of RMSE, MAPE and MAE. The above results show that the designed concrete compressive strength prediction model based on convolutional neural network can predict the concrete compressive strength with high precision and high reliability, and it can be applied to practical engineering scenarios.

articleTitle: MixLoss: A Data Augmentation Method for Sequence Generation Tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose MixLoss, a simple and effective data augmentation method for sequence generation tasks like machine translation, speech recognition, etc. MixLoss works by mixing two inputs and two losses with two corresponding outputs using the same weights, which can also be applied in the hidden space. Concretely, when the loss takes the form that we agreed, we prove that MixLoss is theoretically equivalent to Mixup and thus has an adequate theoretical foundation. We corroborate our theoretical analysis with experiments that support our conclusions. Experimental results on the EnglishGermany dataset reveal that MixLoss achieves the best performance compared with other data augmentation methods, and can integrate well with other technologies. Specifically, the BLEU can be improved from 27.10 to 28.41 on the MT task, and the WER can be decreased from 18.9% to 15.1% on the ASR task. Moreover, MixLoss has stronger robustness to resist noisy data.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Recommendation Model for ELT Resources Combining Improved LFM Model and Parallel CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To tackle the issues of the cold start and data scarcity in existing recommendation systems, this study presents an intelligent recommendation model for resources in English teaching, which merges an enhanced hidden semantic model with parallel convolutional neural network. In the conventional latent semantic model, the application of a Transformer-based bidirectional encoder representation together with the BM25 algorithm leads to a notable reduction in space complexity and training time. Meanwhile, the integration of a convolutional neural network efficiently tackles the cold start issue, thus enhancing both the accuracy and stability of the model, especially in data-scarce environments. The results of the experiment indicate that the suggested model requires only 26 iterations to achieve optimal performance, while the other models remain unstable. To summarize, the proposed model can effectively tackle the cold-start and data scarcity issues that are common in traditional recommendation models, and it also exhibits exceptional accuracy in practical situations.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based CT Image Classification Model with Application to COVID-19 Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the computed tomography (CT) images, a deep learning (DL)-based classification model is proposed, which is applied to realize the accurate diagnosis of the novel coronavirus disease COVID-19. In particular, the ResNeXt is adopted as the backbone, where the grouped convolution facilitates the extraction of discriminative features, and the residual structure can effectively address the gradient vanishing problem. Moreover, by improving and introducing the residual block in ResNet-D, the network can flexibly pay attention to features with different importance. Named as ResNeXt-vd, the proposed model is proven competitive in COVID-19 diagnosis task, which outperforms some other classic DL models by yielding the highest accuracy of 0.975, thereby showing the potential application values in providing reliable diagnostic references for the clinicians.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Analysis Method for Online Learning of Preschool Education Based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that resource matching and resource content of online learning of preschool education are the good and bad are intermingled, an intelligent analysis model for online learning of preschool education based on optimized K-means clustering algorithm is proposed to evaluate and analyze the quality of online education resources. Where, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and weight-based optimized initial centroid selection were introduced to improved the clustering algorithm. The results show that the clustering accuracy of the optimized clustering algorithm has been greatly improved.
