Compared with the original K-means algorithm and density-based K-means algorithm, the accuracy of the optimized clustering algorithm is 7.47% and 4.16% higher, and the clustering effect is better. Experiments show that the intelligent analysis model for online learning of preschool education based on the optimal clustering algorithm can effectively evaluate the quality and situation of learning resources, and has a high promotion value in the online learning of preschool education according to learner behavior statistics and resource defect analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Fuzzy Predictive Control Algorithm in the Recommendation of Ideological and Political Education Teaching Resources in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the utilization rate of ideological and political education resources, this paper proposes a recommendation model of ideological and political education resources based on fuzzy predictive control algorithm. Where, the fuzzy predictive control algorithm is taken as the basic recommendation algorithm, and it is combined with the user-teaching resource feature matching model to realize the recommendation of ideological and political education teaching resources. The results show that the model can maintain the stability of the recommendation effect under different recommendation lengths and quantities. When conducting recommendation on the ideological and political education teaching resources, the recommendation accuracy of the designed recommendation model is always stable at more than 85%, and the accuracy will not be affected when the user characteristic value changes. Therefore, the designed recommendation model can accurately recommend ideological and political education teaching resources, has good stability, and can be applied to the recommendation of teaching resources in actual scenarios.

articleTitle: Human-Robot Interaction Control Based on the RBF Neural Network for Upper Limb Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Radical basis function (RBF) neural network is proposed for the upper limb rehabilitation robot driven by series elastic actuator (SEA). The human-in-charge (HIC) mode and the robot-in-charge (RIC) mode are performed via the devised interaction control algorithm, where in the different control modes can be switched smoothly to avoid human-robot confrontation and improve the rehabilitation effect. On the basis of the RBF neural network with nonlinear mapping property, the human-robot interaction control modes can be dynamically adjusted via utilizing human-robot interaction force, which realizes the human-robot collaboration and adaptive control. The simulation results prove that the advised control method has a excellent performance different control modes.

articleTitle: Research on Control Optimization Method of Grinding System Based on PLC and Swarm Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the control effect of material grinding process, a grinding particle size prediction model based on improved BP neural network is proposed. Among them, BP neural network is taken as the basic prediction model, and it is improved by the improved Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA), so as to further enhance the prediction precision of BP neural network. The simulation results show that compared with other types of optimization algorithms, the improved SSA algorithm can converge to a lower error faster and has better stability. Compared with the prediction model before improvement, the ISSA-BP-based prediction model obtained by improvement has higher accuracy, and the absolute value of prediction error is always within 0.5. In summary, the designed grinding particle size prediction model can achieve high precision particle size prediction, thereby helping managers to achieve better grinding control. The reliability of the designed model is high, and the model can be applied to actual processing.

articleTitle: Research on Power Information Network Attack Detection Method Combining Multiple Kalman Filter Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the attack detection level of power information network, this paper proposes an attack detection method based on improved cubature Kalman filter (ICKF) to detect false data injection attacks. Among them, the cubature Kalman filter algorithm (CKF) is selected as the basic detection algorithm, and it is improved to further improve its detection performance. Simulation results show that compared with other state estimation algorithms, ICKF can estimate the state of power information system more accurately, and its average absolute error is only 2.0124%. In addition, the attack detection method based on ICKF can effectively detect the false data injection attacks. Therefore, the designed detection method based on ICKF can effectively detect false data injection attacks, which further ensures the security of power information, and has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Assembly Screw Automatic Tightening Algorithm Based on Multi-Objective Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve screw tightening quality in industrial assembly process, based on torque control method as screw tightening algorithm, an improved elite retention strategy fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA2) is proposed to optimize tightening parameters. Among them, the torque control method is used as the basic screw tightening algorithm, and the improved NSGA2 algorithm is used to optimize the tightening parameters of the screw tightening process controlled by the torque control method, so as to improve the tightening quality. The simulation results show that the screw tightening algorithm optimized based on the improved NSGA2 algorithm has high tightening accuracy, and the error mean and mean square error are only 0.187 and 0.002. In addition, it can maintain high tightening efficiency and effectively improve the assembly quality when applied to the actual assembly scene, which indicates that the optimized screw tightening algorithm has high feasibility.

articleTitle: Self-Expressive Based Multi-View Clustering Via Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In the past decade, deep learning has made great progress in Multi-view Clustering (MvC). MvC utilizes deep neural networks to explore and exploit complex relationships among multiple views in an unsupervised manner, aiming to learn compact data clusters. Numerous studies have utilized diverse loss functions to direct the learning process of the network, including the minimization of reconstruction loss. Contrastive learning has been applied to train models on unlabeled data, which can improve the performance and generalization ability of the models. The objective of contrastive learning is to minimize the distance between samples of the same class while maximizing the distance between samples of different classes. The core idea behind contrastive learning is to learn feature representations by leveraging the inherent structure of the data. In this paper, we introduce a model named self-expressive based multi-view clustering via contrastive learning(SMC-CL) . The first loss, referred to as the contrastive loss, extracts individual sample features from multiple views considering the relationships between samples. The second loss is used to measure the effectiveness of the fused features from different views.

articleTitle: Underwater Target Detection by Side-Scan Sonar Based on Yolov7-Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Side-scan sonar plays a crucial role in underwater exploration, and autonomous detection of side-scan sonar images is vital for detecting unknown underwater environments. However, due to the complexity of the underwater environment, few highlighted areas of the target, blurred feature details, and difficulty in collecting data from side-scan sonar, achieving high-precision autonomous target recognition in side-scan sonar images is challenging. This article solves this problem by improving the You Only Look Once v7 (YOLOv7) model to achieve high-precision object detection in side-scan sonar images. Firstly, Since the side-scan sonar image has a large useless area, the paper introduces Swin-Transformer for dynamic attention and global modeling, which improves the model’s weight on the target region. Secondly, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is used to further improve feature representation and enhance the accuracy of the neural network model. Experiments on the side-scan sonar image dataset (SSS) show that the improved YOLOv7 model has 85.32% and 53.32% in its average accuracy (mAP0.5) and (mAP0.5:0.95), respectively. These results are 4.65% and 4.98% higher than the YOLOv7 model. The improved YOLOv7 algorithm proposed in this paper has great potential for object detection and recognition of side-scan sonar images.

articleTitle: Research on Artistic Style Transfer of Chinese Painting Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the artistic style transfer effect of traditional painting, this paper proposes an artistic style transfer method of Chinese painting based on generative adversarial network. Where, the cyclic generative adversarial network (CycleGAN) is selected as the basic style transfer algorithm, and the loss function in the network is improved, so as to further enhance the style transfer effect. The experimental results show that compared with the CycleGAN before improvement, the improved CycleGAN has better stability. Compared with other transfer algorithms, the designed Chinese painting artistic style transfer algorithm based on improved CycleGAN has better transfer effect, and the FID score, PSNR and SSIM of the designed algorithm are 162.09, 99.61 and 0.7, respectively. In conclusion, the transfer effect of the designed style transfer algorithm is good, and the designed style transfer algorithm can be applied to the actual Chinese painting artistic style transfer with high reliability.

articleTitle: Tourism Route Management Planning of the Belt and Road Cities Based on Greedy Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The study proposes a tourism route management planning design based on greedy optimisation algorithm, combining hotel attraction rating recommendation and tourism route planning algorithms to construct a tourism system. The experimental results show that the average F1 value of the hotel attraction rating recommendation model is 0.91, the average F1 value of the fuzzy neural rating recommendation model is 0.82, and the average F1 value of the review text recommendation model is 0.85. The running time of the dynamic planning-based algorithm is stable at 0.21 s, and the running time of the greedy optimisation-based algorithm is finally stable at 0.19 s. The intelligent management of tourist routes proposed by the research Planning system accuracy, stability, user satisfaction and a comprehensive score are higher than 0.9 points, especially the user experience and satisfaction score is 0.93 points, to meet user needs.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Library Management System Based on Hybrid Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to optimize the personalized recommendation of books, a hybrid-based book resource recommendation method is proposed. Firstly, the method utilizes the global score item between users to improve the similarity calculation method based on Jaccard coefficient, which avoids the situation that the algorithm only considering the user score collection and ignoring the score content cause the misjudgment of the user's preference, and the high similarity between users causes no book to be recommended. Then, the similarity calculation method based on improved Jaccard coefficient is combined with the user-based collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm to generate the user score prediction results, so that the model can still maintain the recommendation performance in the case of the data sparseness. After that, the linear regression model is adopted to mine the user history score data and the item history score data, and then a user score prediction results are generated from the perspective of users and items respectively, so that the model can learn the relationship between users and items more comprehensively. Finally, the score results of the three models are linearly weighted using a hybrid strategy, and users' final score prediction results are obtain. According to the users' predicted scores for different items, personalized recommendation of book resources is achieved. Experiments show that compared with the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on Jaccard coefficient, the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on improved Jaccard coefficient and the improved collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on penalty coefficient, the proposed hybrid recommendation algorithm can grasp user preferences more accurately. In the evaluation using the F1-measure method, the F1 value of the proposed algorithm is always the highest among the four algorithms under the condition that the similarity threshold is the same as the number of nearest neighbor users. When the similarity thresholds are 0.4 and 0.5, the F1-Measure of the proposed algorithm is 0.153, 0.330, as well as 0.166, 0.378 and 0.125, 0.102 higher than that of the other three algorithms. In the evaluation using RMSE method, the root-mean-square error of the proposed algorithm remains the smallest among the three errors as the number of the nearest neighbor user increases. When the number of users is 100, the error result is only 0.87, which means the proposes method has more advantages in achieving accurate book recommendation, and proves the effectiveness of the proposed weighted hybrid method in improving the model performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Improved Apriori Algorithm in College English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper utilizes the improved Apriori algorithm to mine the information of college English teaching. Firstly, in view of the limitation of traditional Apriori algorithm, weighted impact factor is used to prune the candidate item set, so as to reduce the scanning times of transaction database and solve the problem that the candidate item set is too large. Then, the improved Apriori algorithm is used to mine the information data of college English teaching. Finally, the effect of Apriori algorithm before and after improvement in mining the information of English teaching is compared. The results show that the improved Apriori algorithm can be used to mine the information of college English teaching, and the mining performance is better than the classical ID3 algorithm. The confidence of the improved Apriori algorithm in mining the association rules of teaching information mining is between 78% and 83%, and the accuracy is between 80% and 85%, which is higher than the traditional ID3 algorithm. Therefore, it is concluded that the improved Apriori algorithm can more accurately mine the association between information and data of college English teaching, so as to provide data reference for the improvement of English teaching quality.

articleTitle: A Model-Level Fusion-Based Multi-Modal Object Detection and Recognition Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a model-level fusion-based multi-modal object detection and recognition method. This method employs various modalities to process images, speech, videos, etc., and fuses their results to improve the accuracy of object detection and recognition. Specifically, the Faster R-CNN model is used for object detection and recognition in the image modality, an ML-LSTM-based model is used for speech, and an optical flow estimation model is used for video processing. Since these models operate in different modalities, their results need to be fused. Several model-level fusion methods are proposed in this paper, including average fusion, weighted fusion, cascade fusion (weighted), and model fusion (stacking). By fusing the outputs of different modalities, more accurate object detection and recognition results can be obtained. Experimental results demonstrate that this method achieves more accurate object detection and recognition, particularly in complex environments.

articleTitle: Overview of RS-422 Communication Fault Classification and Causes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The RS-422 communication standard is widely used in industrial automation and communication fields, but in actual use, various communication faults are often encountered. This study aims to classify and analyze RS-422 communication faults to better understand the causes of the faults and provide corresponding solutions. By carefully analyzing common faults such as cable faults, environmental interference, signal attenuation, equipment faults and circuit design defect problems, the reliability and stability of RS-422 communication systems can be effectively improved.

articleTitle: A New High-Precision DZNN Model for Motion Control of Redundant Manipulators with Obstacle Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the motion control and obstacle avoidance of redundant manipulators in practical applications, a continuous zeroing neural network (CZNN) model is first developed. For convenient digital computation, a new high-precision discrete zeroing neural network (DZNN) model is put forward on the basis of a three-step Adams-Bashforth formulation, which is termed fourth-order discrete zeroing neural network (FDZNN) model. Meanwhile, some conventional discrete models are also presented for comparison. The effectiveness and superiority of the FDZNN model are verified by conducting simulation experiments on the platform of planar six-axis manipulator.

articleTitle: A Gait Recognition of EMG Signal Method Based on Bat Algorithm Optimized KNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To improve the accuracy and safety of the electromyography (EMG) control of lower limb rehabilitation robots, a gait recognition method based on bat algorithm optimized KNN is proposed. Firstly, a 3D motion capture device is combined with an EMG acquisition device to synchronously collect gait and lower limb EMG signals. The collected EMG data is divided into five gait phases according to the output of the 3D motion capture system, and then denoised using wavelet transformation and Butterworth filter. Secondly, time-domain and frequency-domain features of the EMG signals are extracted. Finally, the bat algorithm is a heuristic optimization algorithm that simulates the flight and tracking behavior of bats, and searches for the optimal solution according to the fitness iteration of KNN. The bat algorithm is used to optimize KNN classification recognition of the five gait phases: support early, support mid, support late, swing early, and swing late. The recognition accuracy reaches 96.83%. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of bat algorithm optimized KNN is significantly improved compared with traditional BP neural network and KNN.

articleTitle: The Control System of Intelligent Drug Delivery Car Based on Vision Guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In response to the "contactless delivery" problem in hospitals, the control system of intelligent drug delivery car was designed based on vision guidance. The system takes raspberry pie as the control core and completes font recognition through high-definition camera; It determines the position and direction of the car through the OpenMV scanning marker line to complete the tracking and obstacle avoidance; It detects whether the drug is put down through the HX711 pressure sensor; It completes human-computer interaction through Bluetooth communication; It combines PID algorithm to realize closed loop control of speed, and controls the moving and changing direction of the car through DC motor module. The test results show that the system has high stability and good robustness, which has certain reference value for the intelligence of public medical service industry.

articleTitle: Speech Function Design and Human-Computer Interaction System Framework of an English Teaching Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This As the world's most widely spoken language, English has become a popular topic of research for better teaching models. The study introduces a Deep Belief Network (DBN) algorithm for the speech recognition system improvement, and designs the speech function and human-computer interaction of the teaching robot for better application in real-life English teaching. The results showed that in the performance verification of DBN, the maximum test root mean square error of the DBN model was reduced by 0.67% compared to the ReLU belief network. Compared to the Discrete Hidden Markov Model (DHMM), its recognition rates have been improved by 8.33% and 10.07%, respectively. In addition, in experiments testing the effectiveness of the educational robot's English teaching function, the robot-taught students improved their pronunciation indicators by 14 and 10 points respectively compared to traditional teaching, and also improved their speech speed by 22 and 13 points respectively compared to traditional teaching. This indicates that the teaching robot incorporating the DBN algorithm has excellent performance and provides an effective technical support for the improvement of modern English teaching models.

articleTitle: Multi-Prototype Clustering Algorithm Based on Density Peak Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The popularity of k-means algorithm as a prototype-based clustering algorithm is due to its simplicity and efficiency. However, it uses only one prototype to model each class of data, which makes it less effective when dealing with non-convex unbalanced datasets. To overcome this issue, researchers have proposed multi-prototype clustering algorithms. However, it remains a challenging problem to determine the number of prototypes and estimate the final number of clusters. In response to this issue, we propose a novel multi-prototype clustering algorithm called MP-DPS, which is based on density peak sampling. First, we design an incremental sampling method that utilizes reconstruction criterion to automatically determine the number of prototypes. Then, we design a subcluster merging method based on the convex clustering model that does not require a priori k. The effectiveness and superiority of the MP-DPS algorithm are demonstrated by experimental results on both synthetic and real datasets.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Discrimination Method for Track Deception Jamming
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: For radar active deceptive jamming, a deep learning method for radar signal track discrimination is proposed based on end-to-end data processing mode, which can fuse target track information detected by multiple radar architecture. Meanwhile, the method combines convolutional neural network, bidirectional long and short-term memory network with attention mechanism, which can effectively extract multidimensional features of track while adaptively adjusting the weights of attention regions. Compared with the traditional point information processing method, using multidimensional track features can analyze the motion pattern and spatial characteristics for the target more comprehensive, leading to a better identification effect. Simulation result shows that the proposed method can be effectively applied to both active and passive radar architecture, and the discrimination effect of jamming based on track can reach over 99%. The discrimination ability and generalization performance of radar system are effectively improved. It will have high application value in information fusion center of multi-architecture radar on complex battlefields, which provides a new solution for practical implementation in the field of deception jamming countermeasures.

articleTitle: Multi-View Graph Attention Embedding for Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Multi-view attribute graph clustering is a hot research topic in recent years. However, research on multi-view clustering is still relatively scarce, and all of them use graph convolution networks to process a single view, only obtaining insufficient feature representation. Since the data sources in real life are diverse, we propose a model that can handle multi-view data. Our proposed method can filter out high-frequency noise of views, process the features and correlations of multiple view nodes through attention networks, and form a comprehensive representation containing multi view information features and structural features. Then, by reconstructing the topology structure of each view through inner product, we ensure that the generated consistent representation contains the structural information of each view. Finally, we combine node embedding and clustering into one learning process through a soft clustering method. Experimental results have shown that our proposed model has better performance than the current state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Operation and Maintenance of Rail Transit Based on Improved DCGAN Data Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a rail fastener detection method combining improved DCGAN and improved YOLOv5 to improve the detection accuracy of rail transit fastener. On the one hand, the method expands the sample size by DCGAN, and optimizes the network structure by adding deconvolutional layers, so as to improve the recognition effect as a whole. On the other hand, the method replaces the YOLOv5 backbone network with GhostNet and adds the CA attention mechanism, so as to make YOLOv5 can retain the detection accuracy on the basis of lightweight. The results show that improving DCGAN can expand sample data, and the SSIM value is 0.9756 when the training reaches 15000 times. By analyzing the detection results of the same detection network on the improved DCGAN expansion data set, it can be seen that the mPA is increased by 28.65% and 25.92% compared with the original sample and the traditional data enhancement method. By adopting the proposed improved YOLOv5 track fastener detection method on the same data set, the mPA is increased by 11.65%, 19.83% and 4.52% compared with the current mainstream detection methods YOLOV5-Tiny, Faster-RCNN and Shuffle R-CNN. Although it is slightly lower than YOLOv5, the memory is reduced by 90.39% compared with YOLOv5, showing the best overall performance. It has higher practical value.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection and Identification of Rail Vehicle Faults Based on Chaos Theory and Duffing Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: A model of intelligent detection and identification of rail vehicle faults based on chaos theory and Duffing oscillator is proposed for the fault phenomena in rail transportation. In order to solve the problem of accurate recognition of fault signals, chaos theory is chosen as the basis of this study, and the Duffing oscillator is chosen to filter out the noise interference in the detection signal in order to further exclude the noise influence in the detection process. In order to solve the problem of the adaptability of the method in the face of different frequency detection signals, a time-scale-based improvement is made to effectively improve the adaptability of the method in practice. The test results show that the proposed method has the best adaptation in the iterative test, its convergence speed is fast and its adaptation performance is excellent; In the test for the response speed of the actual detection results, it has the fastest response time, and it can find the fault in a more timely manner in the actual application; its fit in the experiment reaches 98.2%; in the actual recognition accuracy test, its average In the actual recognition accuracy test, the average accuracy reached 98.9%. In summary, the method proposed in this study has a very fast response time and accuracy performance in the actual rail vehicle fault detection, which can promote the safety of rail transportation extremely effectively and has a strong practical significance for the healthy development of rail transportation.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Layout of Interior Furniture Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to realize fast automatic layout of interior furniture, an automatic layout method of interior furniture based on reinforcement learning is proposed by imitating and learning the existing layout scheme and combining with ResNet network model to predict the type, position, orientation and size of furniture. Firstly, the method preprocesses the basic layout of interior furniture. Then, an automatic layout prediction model for interior furniture based on ResNet is constructed, and multiple automatic layout schemes for indoor furniture are generated. Finally, all the generated layout schemes are evaluated by utilizing room utilization rate, wall utilization rate and lighting performance, and the optimal automatic layout scheme for interior furniture is determined. The simulation results show that compared with the common automatic layout methods for indoor furniture, the proposed method can quickly obtain the automatic layout scheme for interior furniture with high room utilization rate and wall utilization rate, and can flexibly and automatically layout interior furniture, which has certain effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: The Application of Unicode in Cultural Heritage Databases
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Unicode sets the encoding for every character in various languages in the world, and the set character encoding is unified and unique. Unicode can standardize the rare and variant characters of cultural heritage databases, and has strong compatibility, and can be integrated with digital methods such as IIIF standards and visualization.

articleTitle: Learning Control of Compliant Robots Using Singular Perturbation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Rehabilitation exoskeletons can effectively assist the elderly and patients with nerve loss in their activities of daily living, but traditional rigid rehabilitation exoskeletons may impede the normal movement of the body’s joints and add additional motion constraints, which may result in injury to the wearer.With the introduction of serial elastic actuators (SEA), the flexible rehabilitation exoskeleton has a more natural human-machine interaction and can improve the wearer’s safety and mobility during rehabilitation.However, the introduction of SEA greatly increases the complexity of the control system. The paper presents a learning control strategy for a rehabilitation exoskeleton robot with serial elastic actuators and modeling uncertainty. Using singular perturbation, this controller converts the fourth-order underperturbed dynamics of the robot into a second-order slow-varying subsystem and a second-order fast-varying subsystem. The fast-varying subsystem is then stabilized using a derivative controller. To achieve an efficient estimation of the modeling uncertainty, and to make this subsystem globally asymptotically stable, a concurrent learning (CL) approach is used to design a concurrent learning controller for the slow-varying subsystem. The control stability is analyzed using Hoppenstead’s theorem and the Krasovskii-LaSalle invariance principle, and the control effectiveness is validated by simulations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Question Generation with Syntactic Details and Multi-Level Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Generating questions is a pervasive task in natural language generation that utilizes sequence-to-sequence models based on recurrent neural networks. However, these models face a significant challenge known as the "long-term dependence" problem, which hinders their ability to capture long-term dependencies in sequences effectively. Therefore, the generated questions may not be related to the original answers or follow the correct grammar rules, making them less fluent. This paper proposes a question-generation model that combines syntactic details with an enhanced multi-level attention mechanism. Incorporating syntactic information vectors into the model’s input and using a multi-level attention mechanism to capture sequential contextual information effectively alleviates the above problems. Experimental evaluations show that the proposed model outperforms commonly used models on the SQuAD dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Financial Sequence Analysis and Forecasting Based on LSTM Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Current methods for digital financial time series analysis and prediction have defects such as low efficiency and large error, so the study proposes an optimization model for digital financial time series analysis and prediction by integrating the whale optimization algorithm, seasonal trend decomposition, and long and short-term memory network for this kind of problems, and verifies its effectiveness. The experimental results show that the average absolute error value of the research model is 0.013 and the value of the coefficient of determination is 0.975 in the comparison between the research model and other models, which are better than the comparison model. In the comparison of trend prediction of different models, the trend fitting effect of the comparison model a is better, but the predicted value has a large fluctuation; model b has a better nonlinear ability, but does not have the ability of long-term memory, so it is difficult to capture and learn the potential information in a long time series. Model c with the addition of Baidu index has a lower prediction error, but is significantly worse than the research model. In the actual RMB exchange rate prediction, the average absolute error value of the research model is 0.001 and the root mean square error value is 0.002, which is better than the comparison model. Taken together, the research model possesses effectiveness in analyzing and forecasting the time series of RMB exchange rate in digital finance, which can effectively enhance the actual digital finance time series forecasting ability.

articleTitle: Study on All-Optical Logic Circuit of Semiconductor Optical Amplifier Based on Nonlinear Polarization Rotation Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous progress of all optical signal processing technology, all optical networks have gradually developed towards high capacity, high speed, and high reliability. Semiconductor Optical Amplifier (SOA) has become a key instrument in all-optical signal processing technology because of its merits of easy integration, large nonlinearity and low power consumption. In order to improve the all-optical switching rate, the study proposes an all-optical logic circuit of the Semiconductor Optical Amplifier grounded on the nonlinear polarization rotation effect according to the correlation between the polarization principal state of the SOA and the Bonga sphere, and experimentally verifies the all-optical switching operation. The results show that when the control optical power is 20 mW, the 250-μW signaling optical power achieves a maximum NPR angle of 70°, which is increased by 21.4% and 28.6% compared with the maximum NPR angles of 55° and 50° for the 150-μW signaling optical power and 50-μW signaling optical power, respectively. The study of semiconductor optical amplifier all-optical logic circuits based on nonlinear polarization rotation effect has some reference value in all-optical information processing.

articleTitle: Automated Cardiac Diagnosis Based on Weakly Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Semantic segmentation of medical images is a significant and challenging task, yet traditional fully supervised methods are difficult to achieve satisfactory results due to the scarcity and difficulty of image data annotation. Thus, this paper proposes a semi-supervised semantic segmentation method based on cross-pseudo-supervision and attention modulation. This method uses an EfficientNet as a feature encoder to extract multi-level features for feature fusion; in the encoding stage, it adds an over-parameterized convolution layer with depthwise separable convolution operation, replacing the original convolution method; in the decoding stage, it uses Unet decoder to process the multi-level feature signals, and introduces activation modulation and recalibration mechanisms to enhance the secondary features and suppress the most sensitive and least sensitive feature information. This method trains the model using a cross-pseudo-supervision approach, and achieves a Dice index of 86.7% on the ACDC 1/10 annotated dataset, which is 6% higher than the CPS method; after using 1/3 annotated data, it achieves results similar to the traditional fully supervised semantic segmentation task. Additionally, this method has training friendliness, and when reaching 85% Dice, the training speed is more than ten times faster than traditional fully supervised learning.

articleTitle: AEDD-Net: YOLOv5-Based Aeroengine Defect Detection Model with Robust Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aeroengine defect detection (AEDD) has played important roles in guaranteeing the safety of aircraft, and in this paper, a novel YOLOv5-based AEDD-Net is proposed, which effectively addresses the issues of low efficiency and inaccuracy in the traditional borescope inspection method. In particular, a series of robust strategies are designed to enhance the model performance, including a dual-domain attention mechanism, dense connection structure, and the improved loss function. Evaluation results on a self-build dataset with well-defined annotations show that the proposed AEDD-Net obtains the precision, recall, and mean average precision (at threshold 0.5 of intersection over union) of 97.40%, 97.80% and 98.64%, respectively, which realizes accurate and efficient automated defect detection in high-end equipment inspection scenes.

articleTitle: Research on National Cultural Security Assessment Method in Foreign Language Teaching Based on Improved DSMM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further ensure the security of national cultural data in foreign language teaching and education, a national cultural data security assessment method based on DSMM model and improved analytic hierarchy process is proposed. Among them, the DSMM model is used to construct the evaluation dimension of national cultural data, and then the weight of the index is determined by the improved analytic hierarchy process, and finally the random forest algorithm is adopted for safety assessment testing. The results show that compared with other weight allocation methods, the analytic hierarchy process based on entropy weight is more in line with the current mainstream trend in the weight allocation of national cultural data security indexes. At the same time, in the prediction results of each security assessment algorithm, the weight distribution of the designed security assessment method is very close to the manual allocation result, indicating that the weight allocation meets the actual requirements. Therefore, the constructed national cultural data security assessment method based on DSMN is feasible.

articleTitle: Load Prediction of Charging Station Based on Regression Tree of Cart Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Load forecasting is an important service for the reliable operation and effective management of the smart grid. To achieve this goal, we refine the load characteristics of the electric vehicle charging station according to the actual charging power and weather forecast data of electric vehicle charging stations, and propose a load forecasting method of charging stations based on classification and regression tree, which can enhance the scalability and robustness compared with classical regression models. We evaluate our model with several simulation examples from real data. Experimental results indicate that the proposed model can obtain higher performances than existing models for load forecasting.

articleTitle: Cross-Border E-Commerce Product Selection Method Based on TF-IDF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the Internet technology developing, international trade becomes convenient and fast, while cross-border e-commerce trade has become more common when people's demand of domestic consumers for overseas goods increases. In order to quickly and accurately recommend cross-border e-commerce commodities that consumers want, the keywords are extracted using TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) algorithm, and the commodity data are sentiment classified using the deep learning LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) model, and finally the association rule algorithm is used to classify the extracted keywords. Finally, the extracted keywords are analyzed using an association rule method, so as to study the consumer's online shopping preference. For the cross-border e-commerce product selection method on the foundation of TF-IDF, the results show that TF-IDF in the cosmetics category has the highest accuracy rate of 90.8%. TF-IDF in the health care category has achieved the highest recall rate of 82.6%. The model achieved the highest classification accuracy of 90.20%, the average accuracy of 86.47% and the lowest accuracy of 83.20%. In summary, the researched cross-border e-commerce product selection method on the foundation of TF-IDF is able to recommend suitable products for consumers in a targeted manner.

articleTitle: Research on the Damping Effect of Seismic Isolation Structures Based on Fuzzy Control Algorithm Under Near-Fault Ground Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the damping performance of seismic structures in rare earthquakes, a seismic damping method based on fuzzy control is proposed. Firstly, the frog leaping algorithm is adopted to optimize the fuzzy rules, so as to improve the output results of fuzzy control algorithm. Then, by inputting the displacement and velocity of the isolation layer, the output voltage of piezoelectric friction damper is regulated by adopting the optimized fuzzy control algorithm, thereby reducing the structural response of the isolation layer and reducing the structural damage. The simulation results show that the damping effect of the seismic structure under fuzzy control and frog leaping-fuzzy control is improved compared with that without control, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed fuzzy control method based on displacement and velocity. Compared with the seismic isolation structure under fuzzy control, the maximum damping rate of frog leaping-fuzzy control is increased by 4.12% and 8.31% in the response of displacement and velocity, respectively, which proves the improvement effect of the proposed optimization method on the fuzzy control algorithm. The displacement and acceleration of the seismic structure adopting frog leaping-fuzzy control are decreased under different types and different intensity of ground motion, which proves that the optimized control method not only meets the demand of the isolation layer, but also has strong universality, and is worthy of further research and promotion.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Intelligent Recognition for National Languages Based on Acoustic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of speech intelligent recognition for national languages, this paper proposes an acoustic model based on improved TDNN. Firstly, this paper conducts lightweight processing on the TDNN acoustic model by subsampling method, and improves the training efficiency under the premise of ensuring the precision of the model as much as possible. Then, the TDNN structure processed by subsampling is combined with the LSTM structure, and the excellent extraction ability of LSTM for temporal features and the simplification ability of subsampling TDNN for model structure are utilized to achieve fast and accurate recognition of national languages. Experiments show that TDNN processed only by subsampling can maintain the recognition accuracy of the original TDNN under the premise of improving the training speed of the model. In terms of word and sentence recognition, the accuracy of the processed TDNN has only lost 0.58% and 0.39% compared to the original TDNN, which is far higher than baseline models such as GMM-HMM and DNN-HMM, and indicates that it is more suitable for intelligent recognition of national languages. Combined with LSTM structure and TDNN model processed and improved by subsampling, it has high precision in extracting short-term and long-term speech features. The recognition accuracy of the proposed model for word and sentence is 1.32%, 1.11%, 3.79%, 1.9% and 8.32%, 3.87%, 13.99% and 7.41% higher than the original TDNN and LSTM models, as well as the current popular speech recognition acoustic models such as SGMM-HMM and DFSMN, respectively. The recognition speed of the proposed model is second only to that of DFSMN model, and its comprehensive effect is the best, which is worth further research and promotion.

articleTitle: Application of CNN Based on Improved Activation Function in Image Classification Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To address the issue of weak model classification and low accuracy in image classification using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), researchers have proposed a new activation function called LReLU-Softplus. This function combines the Leaky Rectified Linear Unit (LReLU) and Softplus functions. The results demonstrate that LReLU-Softplus outperforms other activation functions on four different datasets. In the self-made women's clothing image database, LReLU-Softplus achieved the highest recognition rate of 97.4%, compared to Softplus at 96.3% and ReLU at 93.2%, within the range of the study's iteration cycles. On the Mnist digit database, LReLU-Softplus had the highest recognition rate of 99.4%, surpassing Tanh at 98.7% and Sigmoid at 98.6%. In the ImageNet image library, LReLU-Softplus achieved the highest recognition rate of 81.2%, higher than LReLU at 80.6%. In the Oxford flowers image database, LReLU-Softplus achieved the highest recognition rate of 95.1%, which is also higher than the comparison functions. Overall, the proposed LReLU-Softplus activation function is effective in improving the recognition rate of image features and has high efficacy in practical CNN image classification processing.

articleTitle: Design of Computer Vision Grasping System Based on Improved SSD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the grasping accuracy of parts with small size, this paper designs a computer vision grasping system based on improved SSD algorithm by analyzing the grasping process of robot. Firstly, the structure and loss function of SSD model are improved and optimized, and Inception network is introduced into the SSD model to improve the accuracy and computing power of the model, and an improved SSD object detection model is constructed. Then, based on the improved SSD model constructed, precise detection of small-sized parts is achieved. Finally, based on the location of small-size parts detected by the SSD model, the robot can grasp the small-size parts accurately. The simulation results show that the success rate of the system for grasping small-size parts reaches more than 98% without interference, and the success rate of grasping small-size parts reaches more than 96% with interference, which has certain accuracy and effectiveness, and provides a reference for realizing the small-size target grasping of robots.

articleTitle: A Spherical Hip Joint Mechanism Design and Control Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In this paper, a spatial two-degree-of-freedom spherical hip joint mechanism is designed on the basis of the human lower limb hip joint structure. The mechanism consists of two motors connected in series, which are controlled by two motors cooperatively. It has two degrees of freedom and can drive the thigh to achieve flexion, extension, abduction, adduction and leg lifting movement to the lateral front. This paper analyses the motion process of the mechanism, establishes a dynamics model, designs a position-based impedance control algorithm, conducts platform experiments, and proves the reasonableness of the platform design and the effectiveness of the algorithm design through the experimental results.

articleTitle: Scheduling Optimization Study of Intelligent Mixing Algorithm for People in Public Places Based on Cross-Infection Risk Consideration
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: As China's sudden public health events step into normalized prevention and control, public places are gradually developed to the public. However, as the virus still continues to mutate, there are still certain difficulties and problems in the management of public places, especially the optimization of personnel scheduling in public places. At present, it is difficult to find a relatively good balance between service quality, labor costs, and employee satisfaction in personnel scheduling arrangements in public places. In order to intelligently optimize personnel scheduling in public places, the main factors affecting the staff scheduling arrangement and the relationships between different factors are studied and analyzed firstly, and then a staff scheduling model for public places is constructed based on the consideration of the risk of cross-infection. In order to solve the personnel scheduling model in public places, the study took different measures and also designed four different algorithms, and better performing algorithms were selected through experiments. The results show that the staff scheduling model constructed by the study can solve the scheduling scheme better, and the gap between the solved value and the exact value of the designed hybrid algorithm on the small-scale problem is 0.40%, and the gaps of the other three algorithms are 1.25%, 5.45%, and 0.44%. At a medium-sized scale, the intelligent hybrid algorithm designed by the research institute converged after nearly 36 iterations, while the other three algorithms began to converge after nearly 42, 142, and 38 iterations, respectively. It can be seen that the intelligent hybrid algorithm designed by the research institute has better performance, solving accuracy and speed. The results of the study can help public places develop a staff scheduling program that considers the risk of cross-infection to protect the lives of the people.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Evaluation System of Environment Art Work Coordination for Education and Teaching Process
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of insufficient coordination of knowledge points in environment art works caused by low efficiency and strong randomness of automatic paper generation in the traditional environment art work online examination system, an environment art work coordination intelligent paper generation and evaluation system based on knowledge graph and improved genetic algorithm is proposed. First of all, a method based on exam point knowledge graph is used for the retrieval of multiple keywords. Then, an improved genetic algorithm is used to automatically generate test papers and optimize knowledge points. Finally, conduct test question management and online exam module design to achieve coordination intelligent evaluation of online examination and environment art works. In the three experiments of generating paper, the maximum number of program iterations and maximum time of generating paper of the improved genetic paper generation algorithm are 137 and 43 seconds, respectively. The average success rate of this algorithm for paper generation is 96.19%, which is higher than that of the particle swarm algorithm. In addition, the paper generation time of the improved genetic paper generation algorithm is shorter. It shows that the improved algorithm has higher efficiency and quality, and the algorithm has stronger superiority. Based on this algorithm, it can realize automatic paper generation and coordination in the online examination of environmental art work, and meet the requirements of software system design.

articleTitle: Hunger Games Search Algorithm Based on Cauchy Mutation and Opposition-Based Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: A hunger games search algorithm based on Cauchy Mutation and Opposition-Based Learning is proposed for the problems that the hunger games search algorithm tends to fall into local optimum and slow convergence in the late iteration. The initial position of the population is mapped using Tent chaos in order to expand the coverage of the search area. It also integrates the Cauchy Mutation and Opposition-Based strategies to generate new solutions by perturbing the change of optimal solution positions to improve the algorithm's ability to jump out of local exploitation. COHGS and three optimization algorithms are tested separately against the 23 benchmark functions announced at the CEC conference. The results show that COHGS effectively improves the ability of HGS in global search and jumping out of local optimums in high-dimensional problems and outperforms other algorithms in four aspects: optimization ability, robustness, convergence ability, and optimization-seeking accuracy.

articleTitle: Zero-Shot Event Detection Based on Prompt and Deep Prototype Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Current event detection methods mainly focus on detecting known event types with annotated data, which are not suitable for detecting new event types in real-world scenarios where a large amount of unannotated information exists. Existing methods for new event detection primarily focus on the contextual information of the current word in a sentence, without fully utilizing the contextual semantic information of the entire event. Furthermore, the boundaries of marginal event types are often blurred and lack clarity, which hampers the effectiveness of new event type detection. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a zero-shot event detection model based on prompt and deep prototype clustering (ZEPC). By incorporating position encoding and prompt learning methods, the performance of trigger word prediction is optimized. Simultaneously, contrastive learning is employed to dynamically adjust the boundaries of marginal event types and combined with a deep prototype clustering network to improve the recognition performance of new event types. Our proposed zero-shot event detection method enhances the capability of representing zero-shot events and achieves good detection performance on both the known event detection and new event detection tasks in the FewShotED and ACE-2005 datasets.

articleTitle: A Motion Planning Approach of Mobile Robots Based on Multi-Task Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Recently, deep reinforcement learning has been applied to various fields, including motion planning for mobile robots. However, when applied to motion planning in dynamic environments, there are still issues such as slow convergence speed and insufficient planning success rate. Besides, during the motion planning process of a robot, conflicts may arise between its goal-oriented task and obstacle avoidance task, resulting in the robot being stuck or having difficulty finding the correct action. In this paper, a motion planning approach based on multi-task deep reinforcement learning is proposed. In the proposed approach, we decompose the motion planning task into two subtasks: goal orientation and obstacle avoidance. Based on the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradient algorithm, we apply the multi-task learning method of projecting conflicting gradients to handle the gradient conflicts between sub-tasks. It assists in finding better optimization directions for the actor network, which avoids overestimating the improvement of the dominant task while underestimating the performance of the non-dominant task. We also improve the policy evaluation method of the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic policy gradient algorithm. In designing the reward function, we incorporate the idea of artificial potential fields to increase the tendency of the robot to move away from obstacles and adapt to dynamic environments. Finally, we design comparative experiments for mobile robot motion planning, demonstrating that the proposed approach can improve the convergence speed of deep reinforcement learning and the success rate of motion planning.

articleTitle: TKFormer: Typed Keypoints Guided Transformer for Human Parsing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Human parsing is a fine-grained image segmentation task for human behavior understanding. We introduce powerful image segmentation Transformers to this task and achieve promising performance. However, current Transformers ignore the explicit modeling of human body structures and prior knowledge of locations of body parts, leading to rough unreasonable segmentation of human bodies. In this work, we attribute the above issues to the lack of human keypoint localization. To this end, we introduce the human body keypoints from pose estimation and propose the Typed Keypoint Image (TK Image) to represent and encode various semantic features for different types of human keypoints. Moreover, a TK guided Transformer (TKFormer) is proposed with a guidance structure based on feature fusion to guide human parsing. To obtain more accurate human keypoints, we further propose a pure TRansformer for bottom-up Pose (TRPose) estimation, which contains independent left and right confidence decoders and an identity decoder for associative embedding. TRPose achieves better performance than OpenPose on CrowdPose and the best results on Pascal-Person-Part without fine-tuning. Extensive experiments show that TKFormer achieves new state-of-the-art results on Pascal-PersonPart (77.69% mIoU) and LIP (61.26% mIoU).

articleTitle: CFedKT: Clustered Federated Learning with Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Traditional federated learning (FL) aggregates the models from individual clients to obtain a globally more generalizable model. In practical scenarios, the effectiveness of aggregating a global model is compromised due to data heterogeneity. Clustered federated learning (CFL) partitions clients into clusters based on the correlations of their held data to mitigate the impact of data heterogeneity. However, the lack of global knowledge sharing limits the generalization ability of the cluster-based models. Therefore, we propose a novel cluster federated learning algorithm with knowledge transfer: CFedKT. The method uses a spectral clustering algorithm to cluster clients according to the weight update vectors of each client model and aggregates multiple cluster models to update the corresponding client model. We introduce a global model to facilitate knowledge transfer among models from different clusters, aiming to strike a balance between the performance of the global model and cluster-specific personalized features. In the experiments, CFedKT demonstrated significant improvements in accuracy and communication efficiency across different tasks and diverse data heterogeneity scenarios. Additionally, CFedKT showed a certain level of robustness and effectiveness under varying degrees of data heterogeneity.

articleTitle: YOLOv7-Aerial: Rotated Object Detection of Aerial Images Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Existing methods for rotated object detection mainly focus on achieving high detection accuracy but often overlook the importance of detection efficiency, leading to slow network execution. Traditional object detection tasks often utilize models from the "You Only Look Once" (YOLO) series, which excel in efficient inference and deliver competitive detection performance. To tackle these challenges, we introduce YOLOv7-aerial, a one-stage object detector that extends the foundations of YOLOv7 [1]. Our approach incorporates two crucial enhancements: an enhanced Adaptive Weight Normalization (AdaWN) module, a novel Tiny-Instance-Aware Detection Branch (TIADB), and the integration of a rotation regression loss [2]. The AdaWN module assigns variable weights to individual inputs, enabling the network to efficiently capture the importance of different input features. The TIADB improves the precise detection of small objects in aerial images. Additionally, by utilizing the Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) loss, our network achieves enhanced localization accuracy for objects in various orientations. Experimental results on aerial image detection datasets validate that our model strikes a harmonious balance between detection accuracy and speed, outperforming existing models in the field.

articleTitle: The Research on Construction Method of Government Procurement Intention Recognition Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Intention detection can effectively extract key information from text, which helps to provide personalized services for government procurement users and improve user experiences. Currently, there is a lack of open datasets in the field of government procurement question-and-answer (Q&A) services. To address this issue, this paper first collected initial data of 2026 pieces and cleaned them. Secondly, to ease the subjectivity brought by manual classification, text clustering algorithms were introduced to group the textual data. Finally, the data in each cluster was checked for rationality and labeled for intention through manual verification. K-Folder cross validation experiments were performed on the obtained dataset using a classification model, and the results showed that the dataset can be used in the practical application of dialogue systems and intention recognition in related fields. It also helps to improve service quality and user experiences more specifically in the context of government procurement Q&A.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Civic Education Achievement Based on the Combination of Artificial Intelligence Features
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Under the situation of continuous expansion of opening up to the outside world, the ideological and political education work in China's colleges and universities is facing new situations and new requirements. In order to understand students' individual stage learning in time, improve the learning efficiency of ideological and political theory courses, and realize the prediction and early warning of students' course learning status, the study combines the disciplinary characteristics of ideological education and integrates the improved gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) algorithm and the improved support vector machine (SVM) for feature combination of feature information for the construction of ideological education grade prediction model. The experiment demonstrates that the fineness of the improved particle parameter seeking model was increased, and the GBDT - SVM model performed optimally in terms of accuracy, precision, recall and F1, where the maximum accuracy was 92.13%, the highest precision was 93.70% and the maximum recall was 85.7%; the area under the curve values of the four algorithms were 0.95, 0.92, 0.81 and 0.73 respectively, and the algorithms have high generalization ability; on different data sets, the algorithms have the smallest average absolute percentage error and root mean square error values, and the comprehensive performance of the models turns out to be better. The research design model can accurately predict students' performance in civic education, which is conducive to teachers' teaching according to their ability.

articleTitle: Data Hybrid Attacks Based on Sensitive Users in Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Recommender systems, which make precise recommendations through historical interaction data of users and items, have been widely used in real life. But at the same time, because of the open nature of the systems, they are vulnerable to malicious attacks. To explore the robustness of recommender systems, researchers have proposed various attack methods and analyzed their adverse effects. Although the current attack methods can make good results on rating-based recommender systems, they lack thinking about an attack for a social recommendation. Social relationships have a non-negligible role in recommender systems, but there is still little related research, which only constructs fake rating profiles and fake relationship profiles with simple rules, without considering the mutual influence of rating and social information. To address the above problem, we study the attack method with deeply hidden features and propose a hybrid attack method based on sensitive users. It can further enhance the hidden features of fake users, and then use social attacks to assist in attacking social recommendation methods. Empirical results on three public datasets show that our method outperforms traditional methods in terms of attack effectiveness and has excellent anti-detection capability. Ultimately, we hope that our method could enable more analysis for such a hybrid attack and guides for investigating effective prevention measures.

articleTitle: Challenges’ Strategies in Virtual Robocup Standard Platform League
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The RoboCup, an international competition, necessitated an innovative approach in 2022 due to its transition to an online format in China, prompted by an epidemic. This shift demanded the development of more specialized algorithms for the competition. In response to this, we devised a unique algorithm for each challenge. For Challenge 1, we implemented a streamlined greedy algorithm, which rounded the target points to minimize the total time expenditure. In Challenge 2, we adopted an automated obstacle avoidance strategy. For Challenge 3, we calculated the kick angle in real-time to enhance the synergy between the two robots, employing the Sector-angle method to select the optimal shot or pass angle. Our algorithm showed excellent results in the competition, ranking first in the country. In the practical test, our cumulative scores for the three challenges remained consistent at 163.18, 33.65, and 4.8, significantly improving from the pre-optimization scores of 196.2, 51.78, and 3.5, respectively. This indicates the precise and reliable nature of our algorithms. In particular, the sector angle method was notably influential in Challenge 3, swiftly calculating the ideal angle with exceptional accuracy. Before improvements, the algorithm in this project only managed to score 3.5, which was substantially improved post-optimization. Moving forward, these algorithms can be further optimized and adapted to meet the demands of future scenarios.

articleTitle: Casgraph: A Cascade Attention Graph Network Using Kernel Density Estimation Based on LiDAR Point Clouds for 3D Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: 3D object detection based on LiDAR point clouds has recently attracted considerable attention, particularly in fields such as autonomous driving. However, LiDAR often collects a smaller amount of point cloud data for distant and small objects, leading to the loss of fine-grained details of the objects. Additionally, existing point-based object detection suffers from the drawbacks of relying on point sampling quality. Moreover, traditional cascade structure design results in a training imbalance of positive and negative samples between previous and current stages. To tackle these problems, we propose a novel 3D detection framework called Casgraph, which utilizes dynamic farthest voxel sampling to select representative points within proposed boxes. Subsequently, we employ centroid-based Kernel Density Estimation to obtain point density features which helps capture fine-grained features of objects. The overall features of sampled points are then aggregated and propagated using a k-nearest neighbor-based graph neural network to capture the geometric features of the objects. Finally, the output features are further fed into a multi-stage cascaded network using the multi-head attention mechanism to balance the proposal quality from different stages. Extensive experiments on the KITTI dataset have illustrated the effectiveness of our Casgraph framework which can obtain more promising results than other state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Deep-Learning System for Few-Shot Bioacoustic Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Human are good at identifying new objects from only a few number of samples. Inspired by the rapid learning ability of humans, few-shot bioacoustic event detection task based on machine learning method has attracted more attention lately. In this paper, we formulated an ensemble deep-learning system to address the task, incorporating an enhanced prototypical network and transductive inference methodology. We have submitted our models to Task 5 of the Detection and Classification of Acoustic Scenes and Events 2022 (DCASE2022) challenge, and got F-measure of 64.8% on the validation set as our best score. In the final competition, our system got F-measure of 44.3% on the evaluation set.

articleTitle: nmODE-MVC: Neural Memory ODE-Based Multi-View Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Deep multi-view clustering (MVC) has recently gained significant interest for its capability to harness complementary information across multiple views through deep neural networks, enhancing clustering performance. However, existing deep MVC methods still have two issues: (1) They separate the feature learning objective and the clustering objective, potentially leading to suboptimal embedding features due to the neglect of the global clustering structure. (2) Most works utilize the target distribution obtained by the clustering objective to supervise feature learning. However, they simply sharpen the soft clustering distribution to obtain the target distribution, lacking the dynamics of the clustering process. To address these issues, in this paper we propose a novel end-to-end self-supervised multi-view clustering approach based on NeuralODEs, namely nmODE-MVC. Our approach operates in two stages: In the first stage, all view-embedded features are extracted, and then unified them into a global feature, facilitating global clustering assignments by exploiting multi-view data’s complementarity. The second stage leverages the dynamic attributes of NeuralODEs to dynamically refine the data features and generate a target distribution that actively drives the clustering decisions. We formulate these learning processes as a unified optimization problem, facilitating iterative training and refinement. The effectiveness of nmODE-MVC is validated through extensive experiments on multiple real-world multi-view datasets.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Adaptive Lesion Segmentation with Similarity Based Cross Pseudo Supervision
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Notable advancement has been made in lesion segmentation based on deep learning. Nonetheless, the effectiveness of deep learning heavily relies on the availability of a substantial amount of high-quality labeled data, which is labor-intensive and expensive to require. Moreover, when applied to a different domain, deep learning-based lesion segmentation methods often experience a decline in performance due to variations in device vendors and patient populations. The unsupervised domain adaptation method is proposed to tackle the domain discrepancy problem. There are certain similarities between semi-supervised learning and unsupervised domain adaptation. From an application perspective, semi-supervised learning models can be used to solve unsupervised domain adaptation tasks.To this end, we introduce the cross-pseudo-supervision mechanism in the semi-supervised field for unsupervised adaptive lesion segmentation. However, the method ignores the similar characteristics in medical images. To fully leverage the semantic similarity between domains, a novel similarity-based cross-pseudo-supervised lesion segmentation model is proposed. The proposed model employs a U-Net encoder, trained on source domain, to extract features from both the source and target domains. Subsequently, cosine similarity is computed based on these extracted features. The obtained similarity scores are then employed to weigh the source samples during the training process. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through cross-domain experiments conducted on two publicly available COVID-19 lesion segmentation datasets.

articleTitle: Sardine: A Threat-Aware Compression and Querying System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Provenance graphs have gained significant attention as valuable tools for conducting attack investigations. They offer a comprehensive representation of long-term system behavior and attack paths, supplying abundant historical information and contextual insights. Nevertheless, as network attacks become more sophisticated and prolonged, the need for thorough and persistent analysis of enterprise systems has escalated. Consequently, effectively managing and storing large provenance graphs has emerged as a pressing challenge that demands immediate resolution. This study introduces a novel approach for compressing provenance graphs by optimizing graph structure and reducing dependency attribute redundancy, thereby eliminating context redundancy in both nodes and edges of the graph while ensuring lossless compression. Moreover, to address the requirement for efficient backtracking in attack investigations, we present a query algorithm for the provenance graph and propose a method for establishing an indexing table based on threat perception to expedite searches. Our system, named Sardine, is developed to support these functionalities. Experimental evaluations are conducted on four datasets, demonstrating that Sardine achieves impressive compression ratios ranging from 4.56x to 17.3x. In summary, Sardine offers a promising solution for enhancing storage and query efficiency in a more compact and time-effective manner.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Early Warning of Power Customer-Side Demand Based on KG Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the development of power system reform and the focus of competition on power customers, customer-side demand early warning is becoming an important research topic of State Grid. In response to the problems of too many factors related to customer-side demand, complex interactions, and difficulties in early warning, researchers in related fields have conducted some research with traditional early warning methods in recent years. However, there are still some difficulties such as long data processing time, low accuracy, and unclear correlation among data. To address these issues, we propose a method of early warning of power customer-side demand based on Knowledge Graph (KG) by exploiting the strong reasoning and analysis capabilities of KG. In the relationship extraction of the accepted content of power customer-side demands, we use Transduction Projection Model (TPM) to realize the simultaneous learning of the projection matrix of the hypernym-hyponym relations and the non-hypernym-hyponym relations.
