The method presents the logical relationships between demand data in figures by establishing the customer-side demand KG, which enables in-depth processing, inference analysis, and early warning management of power customer demand data. Our method can analyze the similarity of customer-side demand and provide early warning of similar demand, which makes an important contribution to further reducing power customer-side demand and improving power customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: A Relation-Aware Network for Defocus Blur Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Defocus blur detection (DBD) is an important task in computer vision that aims to segment clear regions from images. Recently, deep learning based methods have made great progress in the defocus blur detection task based on their powerful learning capabilities. However, most of existing methods often directly predict clear regions without considering the complementary relationship between clear and blur context information, which produce clutter and low confident predictions in boundary areas. To address this challenge, we propose a relation-aware network for defocus blur detection. Specifically, we disentangle the complementary relationship both from region level and pixel level. For region level, we introduce the separated attention mechanism to highlight the contrast between clear and blur areas of an image, where the normal attention is benefit to distinguish the clear region, and the reverse attention helps to focus on blur region. These two-stream separated attention module would generate the segmentation mask with high confidence. Furthermore, we try to uncover the pixel-to-pixel relationship via the connectivity contour in eight directions which can enhance the accuracy of contour detection. To evaluate the superiority of the proposed method, we implement extensive experiments on two two public benchmark datasets, CUHK and DUT. The experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Sparsity Enhanced Correntropy Based Robust Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Although Principal Component Analysis (PCA) find widespread use in many applications, it is sensitive to non-Gaussian noise. Many Robust PCA models have been developed to deal with this issue. However, these methods only can handle one type of noise, e.g. the impulse noise in the feature domain or the outliers in the sample domain. This paper developed a new robust PCA model based on sparsity enhanced correntropy called SCPCA, which is robust against impulse noise and outlier simultaneously. Furthermore, a novel algorithm is proposed to solve our SPCA model based on Fenchel conjugate and accelerated block coordinate update (BCU) strategy to solve SCPCA model. To assess the robustness of our SCPCA method, extensive experiments on background reconstruction and face modelling have been conducted. The findings show that in most cases, our SPCA method outperforms the compared state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: SRViT: A Vision Transformer via Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Vision Transformer is a widely used model in computer vision that can extract and learn useful feature information from images. However, its performance may be limited by low-quality and low-resolution datasets with complex degradation. Therefore, how to improve the accuracy of image classification is a challenging problem. One possible method is to increase the resolution of the input images or the input size of the network model. Both of these can improve the quality of the input, but only the latter has been verified experimentally. Ideally, a high-performance super-resolution network can enhance the resolution of the images and restore the details of the real-world images. To this end, we can use a super-resolution network to increase the resolution of the input images for Vision Transformer. In this paper, we propose a network structure that combines a super-resolution network and a Vision Transformer. First, the input image datasets are fed into a resolution classifier, which is a lightweight CNN and able to choose an appropriate resolution for each images. In this stage, a Gumbel softmax is inferred to keep differentiable. Second, the leveled images are sent to the super-resolution network, and blind super-resolution is performed at different magnification factors according to the level. Finally, the images are fed into Vision Transformer for image classification.

articleTitle: T-EKC: A Novel Ensemble Learning for Classification Application
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Data classification plays a key role in the research area of reducing the rate of patient misdiagnosis and improving the accuracy of equipment fault detection. However, existing most classification methods only pinpoint binary class data, which is unreasonable for practical applications. As a significant machine learning method, ensemble learning addresses classification problems with multiple basic classifiers. In this paper, T-EKC, a new classification method based on ensemble learning is proposed for binary class, multivariate class and imbalanced class datasets. ELM(extreme learning machine), KNN(K nearest neighbors) and CART(classification and regression tree) are employed to obtain initial classification results. The results of each classifier are then combined by EWVE(Entropy weight voting evaluation) to establish the final output. Furthermore, parameter perturbation is developed for the diversity problem of ensemble learning and the Friedman test is adopted to implement the difference significance test of the proposed T-EKC method. A large number of experiments are implemented on 15 different types of datasets, and experimental results indicate that T-KEC is effective and efficient in data classification with classification accuracy of 85.67% on average for different types of datasets.

articleTitle: SHG: Self-Supervised Hypergraph Gate Networks for Enhanced Multi-Modal Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have gained widespread popularity for encoding user-item interaction graphs and have consistently demonstrated strong performance. However, real-world user interaction data often exhibits noise, which can negatively impact the accuracy of GNN-based representations. In response to this challenge, we introduce a novel framework known as Self-supervised Hypergraph Gate Networks (SHG). This innovative approach employs a hypergraph-based encoder to learn hyperedge feature matrices. It utilizes a decoder with a multi-head attention mechanism to map hyperedge features back to entity features. Furthermore, we introduce a self-enhanced learning module that leverages global and local contexts to enhance the overall model performance. In comparison to baseline models, our model demonstrates exceptional performance across two publicly available multi-modal video recommendation datasets: TikTok and Movielens.

articleTitle: Self-Paced Neutral Expression-Disentangled Learning for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The accuracy of facial expression recognition is typically influenced by the following factors: high similarities across different expressions, disturbing factors, and the subtle and rapid micro-movements of the face. One potential solution to overcome these obstacles is to leverage the hidden neutral information present in neutral expression images. In this paper, we propose a Self-Paced Neutral Expression-Disentangled Learning (SPNDL) model, which aims to disentangle the neutral information from facial expressions, facilitating the extraction of crucial features and variations. This approach enables the capture of discriminative details within similar expressions and the detection of micro-facial movements. To enhance the learning of these neutral expression-disentangled features (NDFs) and mitigate the challenges posed by non-convex optimization, we propose a self-paced learning (SPL) strategy based on NDFs during the training phase. SPL learns samples from easy to complex by increasing the number of samples selected into the training process, which enables to effectively suppress the negative impacts caused by low-quality samples and inconsistently distributed NDFs. Experiments on three popular databases (i.e., CK+, Oulu-CASIA, and RAF-DB) show the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Coordinate Classification for Human Pose Estimation Based on Feature Reassembly
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Human pose estimation, as a highly significant research direction in computer vision, predominantly relies on heatmap-based methods and coordinate regression. Recently, coordinate classification-based approaches have gained popularity. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale coordinate classification network based on feature recombination. The network employs a pyramid-structured Transformer to acquire feature maps of varying resolutions. It leverages feature recombination to dynamically generate adaptive kernels for different feature maps, capturing location and keypoint sensitive features. Moreover, it aggregates the sampled (upsampled and downsampled) features to maximize the constraint on feature map quality. In addition, a coordinate-decoupled classification module is employed to classify 1D horizontal and vertical feature vectors, further reducing the network parameters and computational overhead. This approach avoids the expensive post-processing operations and quantization errors associated with heatmap methods, as well as the poor robustness issues of coordinate regression methods. The proposed model was evaluated on the COCO keypoint detection dataset and the MPII multi-person pose estimation dataset, and achieved satisfactory results. The performance of the Feature Recombination And Fusion Module (FRFM) is also demonstrated, emphasizing the significance of capturing detailed features for coordinate regression and classification methods.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling Phone Authentication Technology Based on Deep Learning Voiceprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In voice assistant and human-computer interaction, voice print recognition has high commercial and research value, in order to improve the accuracy of voice print recognition of dispatch telephone. Based on deep learning, the research realizes the recognition and authentication of voice print through noise reduction, framing, feature extraction, modeling and other processing of voice signals, and optimizes and improves the voice print recognition system and designs the authentication model. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy of the security authentication system based on the optimized SVM system is more than 90%. In the voice print recognition system, the simulation effect is excellent. After the source noise test of the voice print recognition system, the accuracy of voice print recognition of the research model is more than 95% under different source noise environments, which is more than 5% higher than other models. After the daily noise test, the feature recognition accuracy of the model is more than 96% in the noisy vehicle noise on the road, and the voiceprint feature recognition rate can still reach more than 90% in other daily noise background. In summary, the research model gives full play to the advantages of deep learning in voice signal recognition, making voice print recognition and authentication more accurate and efficient. The novel feature of this scheme is that SVM is optimized by tabu algorithm, which makes it better able to deal with the influence of recognition errors and noise environment. The technology is designed to improve the accuracy and efficiency of telephone authentication for applications in the corporate, financial and public security sectors.

articleTitle: Research on Rice Pest Detection Method Based on Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high recognition error rate of pest identification, high model complexity and difficult deployment of rice in real field environment. In this study, nine common rice pests such as Cnaphalocrocis medinalis, Chilo suppressalis, Oxya chinensis and Rice planthopper were studied. Based on the YOLOv5 target detection algorithm, an improved YOLOv5-based rice pest identification method was proposed. Firstly, Mosaic-9 data enhancement is used instead of Mosaic-4 data enhancement to improve model performance. Introducing GIoU to replace CIoU in the original network, thus solving the problem of low detection accuracy for rice pests. By replacing NMS with DIoU-NMS, the recognition of overlapping occlusion targets is improved, and the missed detection rate of the model is reduced. Secondly, a lightweight upsampling operator CARAFE is used to further reduce the parameters and calculations while increasing the receptive field. Finally, the BiFPN structure is used in the neck connection part to alleviate the problem of small target information loss caused by multiple convolutions by fusing multi-scale features. From the final results of the experiment, it can be seen that the improved algorithm has better recognition performance in rice pest classification. The future model can be deployed on the relevant software or cloud platform to assist agricultural technicians to carry out field investigations, improve work efficiency, and have good application prospects.

articleTitle: SeqEnhance: A Lightweight Image Processing PipeLine for Low-Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an important task in computer vision, aiming to improve the visual perception or interpretability of images captured in poorly illuminated environments. Recently, deep learning based methods have been extensively explored to address this issue. While many of these methods have achieved significant advancements in various evaluation metrics for LLIE, only a few have made progress in improving inference speed for the resulting images. As a result, achieving both high-quality enhancements and efficient inference speed remains a challenge. To tackle this challenge, we propose SeqEnhance, a fast LLIE method based on a predefined parameterized image processing pipeline. Our approach combines the inference capabilities of deep neural networks for parameter estimation and the efficient processing capabilities of image processing pipelines to generate enhanced images in an end-to-end manner. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive performance on image quality evaluation metrics such as PSNR and SSIM with a fast inference speed.

articleTitle: WATNet: A Wavelet-Aware Lightweight Hybrid Model for Fast Low-Light Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Low-light enhancement task is an essential component of computer low-level visual tasks, which involves processing images captured under dim lighting conditions to make them appear as if they were taken under normal illumination. Currently, deep neural networks have become the mainstream approach for image processing. However, recent works have devoted considerable efforts to designing high-performance models, which often come with high computational complexity and inference time, making real-time processing unfeasible. We observed that some convolutional methods are due to the need for deep layers which results in a large number of parameters. Moreover, enhancing details and removing noise in low-light images remains an open challenge. In order to solve the above problems, we propose a lightweight baseline that combines CNN and sparse grid attention transformer blocks to enable the model to capture a global receptive field at an early stage. Specifically, we propose a High-Frequency Wavelet-aware Block(HFWB) that focuses on processing high-frequency information in the wavelet domain to refine details and suppress noise. With a processing time of only 10.6ms, the performance of our model outperforms that of the current state-of-the-art lightweight models on benchmark low-light datasets. Compared to state-of-the-art models in the LOL dataset, our model achieves a reduction in inference time of over 90% and requires only about 1% of the FLOPS.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Logistics Industry Knowledge Graph Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the development of the national economy and society, the domestic logistics industry has also experienced unprecedented prosperity, at the same time data volume is also constantly increasing. How to accurately analyze the multi-source and heterogeneous data in the logistics system is an important problem facing the logistics industry at present. The emergence of knowledge graph provides new ideas for these issues. The knowledge graph is a new method of knowledge representation, which has the advantages of precision, structure, and clarity. It can help reflect the relationship between industries and industrial chains, assist in event driven, important industrial events, and so on. For the logistics field, building a knowledge graph of the logistics industry can help logistics enterprises achieve intelligent supply chain management, including upstream and downstream management, knowledge sharing, intelligent logistics, etc. It can provide strong decision-making support for government agencies, industry associations, logistics enterprises, etc. This paper proposes an entity recognition method based on the BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model and a relationship extraction method based on the BERT pre-training model. Research shows that both the BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model and the BERT pre-training model have high practicality in entity recognition and relationship extraction, which can effectively extract relevant entities and relationships from text, and then use the Neo4j graph database to store triplets, and use the constructed logistics industry knowledge graph visualization system to display, providing strong support for the logistics industry brain, upstream and downstream situations of the supply chain, and important industry events.

articleTitle: Course Scheduling in Vocational Education Colleges Based on Improved FA Algorithm Under Multi-Objective Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of society and the increasing importance of vocational education, the problem of curriculum scheduling management in higher vocational colleges is becoming increasingly prominent. In order to arrange courses more reasonably and reduce the difficulty of course scheduling personnel, an improved firefly algorithm was designed to solve the multi-objective optimization problem of course scheduling. By improving the diversity of individuals, the purpose of enhancing the search space and leaping out of the local optimal was achieved, and the flexibility of classroom and schedule of courses was fully considered. The results show that the convergence rate of the multifunctional algorithm is about 5% of that of the hybrid algorithm. In unimodal function, when the number of elite groups is 6, the algorithm can obtain the optimal solution and show high precision. In multimodal information fusion, when the elite population is 6 or 9, the algorithm can obtain better solutions and explore more possible Spaces. The improved firefly optimization algorithm proposed in this paper has obvious advantages in the convergence speed and accuracy of solving problems, and can achieve satisfactory results in course scheduling. This research is of great significance for vocational education colleges to improve teaching efficiency and optimize resource allocation.

articleTitle: A Differential Evolution for Task Allocation for Multi-UAVs with No-Fly Zone
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have significant prospects in military and civilian fields. Multi-UAVs can cooperatively complete tasks more efficiently and economically than a single UAV. As a typical coordination pattern for multi-UAVs, task allocation is a combinatorial optimization problem by which they are allocated to accomplish many tasks. To date, several algorithms have been proposed for varied scenario. In this paper, the task allocation problem for multi-UAVs with no-fly zone is studied. First, the no-fly zone is defined as a circular in 2D surface, and then two accurate and fast approaches are proposed respectively, in order to calculate the flight distance with no-fly zone. The original differential evolution (DE) cannot be directly applied to this optimization problem due to its discrete feasible solution. Therefore, some key operations of DE are modified to suit the needs of this optimization problem as follows: solution coding, mutation operation, crossover operation, etc. To verify the proposed algorithm, some experiments are done on 10 UAVs and 10 tasks. For both simple and complex cases, the experimental results confirm that the mathematical model constructed in this paper is reasonable, and the proposed DE is effective, especially for task allocation problem for multi-UAVs with no-fly zones.

articleTitle: Research on Oral Language Evaluation Method of Business English Based on Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of people for second language learning, this paper proposes a business English oral evaluation and correction method. Specifically, based on the Transform language model, an end-to-end oral evaluation model based on text priori was adopted to evaluate learners' oral English. Then, in view of the non-standard pronunciation in the evaluation, a two-stage correction model of Normalizing Flow was adopted to correct pronunciation, thereby improving the pronunciation quality of spoken business English. The results show that compared with the traditional mainstream evaluation model, the evaluation performance of the designed evaluation model is significantly better, the response is faster and the evaluation effect is more obvious. The F1 score of the designed evaluation model reaches 0.577 in the evaluation of speech with native accent. In addition, the pronunciation correction model in the evaluation method designed in this paper can preserve the speaker's accent features to the maximum extent on the basis of ensuring the correction effect, and can better help the speaker to learn oral language. It can be concluded that the proposed business English oral evaluation and correction method has good evaluation effect, and can assist users to learn oral language through pronunciation correction, which has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Applying Image Classification Model to Spectrograms for Speech Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) aims to enable machines to comprehend the subjective emotions of individuals by analyzing their vocal expressions. The challenge of SER lies in extracting and exploiting the comprehensive sound information effectively. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end SER system that utilizes multiplexed acoustic informations, including visual representations of spectrograms and Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC). Specifically, to capture salient sound signal features effectively, we employ a pre-trained EfficientNet to analysis the spectrogram, and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) network to process the MFCC. Then the extracted features are combined using attention modules. Results of experiments conducted on the RAVDESS database using a five-fold cross-validation strategy demonstrate the competitive performance of the proposed SER system to state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: DGST-Former: Dynamic Graph with Spatio-Temporal Transpose-Transformer for Brain fMRI Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Time-varying brain signals can be well represented in graph-structured latent space. Dynamic Graph Neural Network integrated with Spatio-temporal Attention has been shown to have better ability of encoding meaningful representation from brain fMRI data. Although recent studies have attempted dynamic attention-based GNN model for brain fMRI data, there are still limitations in its power of expressiveness. Here, we introduce Dynamic Graph with Spatio-temporal Transpose-transformer (DGST-Former) model for encoding dynamic features from brain fMRI data. Our DGST-Former is specifically designed to embed and encode spatio-temporal representations from dynamic Functional Connectivity (FC) features. It integrates a transpose-transformer module, tailored on the basis of the transformer encoder, to capture both spatial and temporal information from dynamic graph-based data. Our proposed method has outperformed previous methods on the classification task of schizophrenia (SCZ) based on brain fMRI data. Furthermore, the analysis of encoded spatio-temporal attention are also interpretable and concord with the results of previous studies.

articleTitle: The Principle and Application of Gain Compression Parameters of Amplifier Tested by Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the principle of measuring gain compression parameters of amplifier by network analyzer, and uses vector network analyzer for actual test application, showing test results and analysis, in order to provide convenience for testing and researching the performance of power amplifier.

articleTitle: Research on the Rapid Extraction Method of Overhead Line Laser Point Cloud Based on Fusion Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles equipped with LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) systems can quickly acquire 3D point cloud data of transmission lines and have become a new technical means for intelligent grid inspection. However, the large amount of point cloud data collected by LiDAR and the complexity of the point cloud scene limit the accuracy and speed of the overhead conductor point cloud extraction algorithm. To address this issue, this paper proposes a rapid extraction method for 3D point clouds of overhead lines that integrates visible light structural features. Firstly, an improved DeepLabv3+ network is used to segment the visible light images of overhead lines, successfully locating the overhead line area from a complex background. Secondly, the MCMLSD line detection method is introduced to fill in the completeness of the overhead line area after DeepLabv3+ segmentation, solving the problem of discontinuity in the DeepLabv3+ overhead line segmentation area. Finally, based on the target area of overhead lines in visible light images, the rapid extraction of 3D point clouds of overhead lines in full-scene point cloud data is completed. Experiments have shown that this method has good robustness in scenes such as sky, land, and forests, providing multi-modal information for unmanned aerial vehicle automatic inspection of overhead lines and promoting the development of this field.

articleTitle: Driverless Image Processing Based on Improved YOLOv5l
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In the field of autonomous driving, road information is typically assessed and processed using a combination of 3D and 2D target detection algorithms. Among these, the YOLO series algorithms stand out in the domain of 2D target detection. This paper aims to enhance YOLOv5l and apply it to the field of driverless image processing to improve operational efficiency. Addressing the issues of parameter quantity and operational efficiency in the traditional YOLOv5l algorithm, we propose an improvement strategy. Firstly, we incorporate the lightweight network ShuffleNetV2 to enhance network feature extraction efficiency. Secondly, we introduce the lightweight convolution structure GSConv to reduce the computational load of the model. Lastly, we introduce SIoU loss to optimize the regression model. Experimental results demonstrate that our improved algorithm achieves comparable detection accuracy to the traditional YOLOv5l algorithm on the KITTI dataset, while also exhibiting higher detection efficiency and fewer parameters. These findings validate the effectiveness and practicality of our improved algorithm. This enhancement offers valuable insights for further research on object detection algorithms in the field of autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Design of Latch Implemented by Cellular Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Cellular neural network is a structural form, and this article implements the design of a latch based on cellular neural network. The latch consists of eight misaligned soft error tolerance units (ST) and four input clock controlled C units. The ST unit is designed with transistor stacking based on the voltage reversal polarity of transient pulses, which enables it to have blocking characteristics while reducing the number of sensitive nodes and reducing area overhead. By utilizing clock control technology and high-speed transmission paths, latency has been significantly reduced. Under the 22 nm CMOS process, HSPICE simulation shows that compared to quadruple node upset reinforced latches (QNUTL, LSQNUSR, 4NUHL), the average delay of the latch is reduced by 38.63%, the average power consumption is increased by 58.84%, the average area overhead is reduced by 22.84%, the average power consumption delay product is reduced by 3.77%, and the average area power consumption delay product is reduced by 25.68%. Variation analysis shows that the delay of the latch is not sensitive to voltage and temperature variation. Therefore, com-pared to the existing reinforced latch design, the delay, PDP, and APDP of this latch have significantly improved.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Simulation of a Four-Degree-of-Freedom Shoulder and Elbow Joint Rehabilitation Training Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In this paper, patients with impaired limb motor function caused by stroke, brain trauma, spinal cord injury and other reasons are taken as research objects. Built on human muscle anatomy, the physiological structure and range of motion of human shoulder and elbow joints are analyzed. A four-degree-of-freedom shoulder and elbow joint rehabilitation training device with real-time gravity compensation is proposed. The gravity compensation device and ratchet device are designed to reduce the torque requirement of the shoulder joint drive motor and reduce the shoulder and elbow joint to overcome gravity work; The D-H parameter model of the robot body was established based on the D-H coordinate system method, and the forward kinematics was solved. The Angle values of individual joints were generated based on the random sampling method of Monte Carlo method, and the motion space of the executive mechanism of the rehabilitation robot was solved. The rationality of the robot structure was verified through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Cross-Group Brain Network Topology Propagation Model with Graph Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Most brain diseases are characterized by widespread structural and functional brain abnormalities. Exploring the complex changes in network topology caused by brain diseases has unique advantages in revealing neuropathological disease characteristics. Current brain network analysis methods mainly focus on the low-order association of paired brain regions, ignoring the complicated high-order information among multiple brain regions. In this work, we propose a cross-group brain network topology propagation model with a graph attention mechanism, which constructs a high-order cross-group brain network with group differences. Firstly, we extract the functional brain network topology of healthy subjects and patients and adaptively evaluate the centrality distribution of brain regions by the PageRank algorithm. Secondly, based on the optimal transport, the node centrality propagation model of brain regions from two groups is established. The constructed transmission matrix captures higher-order topological features with group differences among multiple brain regions caused by brain diseases. Then, a Graph Autoencoder model (GAE) based on the Graph Attention Network (GAT) is designed to embed the topological structure of functional connectivity fusing cross-group brain network topology. Structural connectivity is reconstructed after decoding the encoded feature. Finally, the embedding feature is utilized for an individual classification task. Experiments on an epilepsy dataset show that our method is not only capable of identifying biomarkers, but also surpasses several state-of-the-art methods for diagnosing brain diseases.

articleTitle: Hazardous Chemical Vehicles Detection Based on Path Fusion and Multi-Scale Slicing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of highway transportation, hazardous chemical vehicles detection was carried out on vehicles engaged in the transportation of hazardous chemicals. High-speed and diverse scenes of vehicles on the road pose numerous challenges for object detection, as hazardous chemical transport vehicles often appear as small targets within the surveillance field of view. In this paper, we propose a dedicated vehicle detection algorithm based on path fusion and multi-scale slicing methods. This algorithm incorporates a dual path fusion module and a multi-scale image slice detection module to effectively enhance its feature extraction capability and fuse semantic detail information. By conducting experiments on a self-built dataset, we have demonstrated the reliability and superiority of the proposed algorithm over baseline models and mainstream object detection algorithms in terms of detection accuracy and inference speed.

articleTitle: U-Net Based Face Restoration Algorithm for Mask Occlusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In today’s globalised society, epidemic diseases are spreading faster than ever before. To avoid the spread of epide-mic diseases, the public needs to wear personal protective equipment to reduce the risk of disease transmission. However, in some places where people need to be identified, mask masking significantly reduces the number of key facial features available to face recognition algorithms, resulting in a significant reduction in the accuracy of the original face recognition algorithm. Therefore, this paper investigates the removal of mask masked regions, using U-Net with a deep neural network of residual structure to restore faces in masked regions, while retaining the original face keypoint features in unmasked regions. In constructing the dataset, the key point information is used to add masks to the original unmasked dataset. The experimental results show that the restoration results of 600 randomly acquired files in the LFW dataset using the method proposed in this paper improved the accuracy of 4.2% compared to the direct adoption of the ArcFace algorithm for face recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of ROS Intelligent Robot Based on Improved A-Star Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to better realize the dynamic obstacle avoidance of robots, this paper proposes a path planning method of ROS intelligent robots based on improved A-Star algorithm. On the basis of the improved A-Star algorithm, the artificial potential field method is integrated to construct a hybrid path planning method, which makes robots can successfully avoid dynamic obstacles. Experimental results show that the comprehensive performance of the improved A-Star algorithm is improved, and it can be better combined with the artificial potential field method to obtain the global path and local path, and successfully avoid dynamic obstacles to complete path planning, which is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Small Sample Containment Vessel Cracks Detection Algorithm Based the Latent Diffusion Model and Improved Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Nuclear energy is a clean, efficient, and sustainable energy widely used in power generation. In recent years, nuclear power has experienced rapid development worldwide. As a result, the safety of nuclear power, particularly the containment vessel that serves as the final barrier to avoid the release of radioactive materials into the surrounding atmosphere, has received increasing attention. The surface cracks of the containment vessel are an important factor threatening its lifespan. However, the current detection of surface cracks in the containment vessel mainly relies on inefficient and dangerous manual detection. This paper proposes a small samples containment vessel cracks detection algorithm using the latent diffusion model data expansion and improved Faster-RCNN. There are primarily two parts to this approach. the first part uses the latent diffusion model to expand data and constructs the DD training dataset, solving the problem of small samples being difficult to train and easily overfitting in deep learning object detection methods. The other part uses clustering algorithms to obtain anchor boxes that adapt to the geometric features of cracks, improving the detection performance of Faster-RCNN in containment vessel cracks detection tasks. In addition, this article compares different detection methods to evaluate the accuracy of the proposed method. This method has been applied to the detection of containment vessel cracks in practical sites.

articleTitle: Implementation of Arabic Private Education Course Resource Recommendation Method Based on Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of recommendation of Arabic private education course resources, a course recommendation model based on cross-sequence global graph attention network is proposed. Specifically, by constructing the cross-sequence course sequence graph and weighted digraph attention layer from the global perspective, the learning effect of the model on embedding information is improved, thereby improving the performance of the recommendation model. The experiment shows that the proposed method was used to recommend Arabic private education course resources on XuetangX online course dataset. Compared with MF, SR-GNN, FGNN, LightGCN and other commonly used baseline recommendation methods, the proposed method increased by 3.31%, 2.26% and 0.41% in the evaluation indexes such as P value, NDCG and MRR, respectively, which means it has better recommendation effect. Moreover, in the recommendation task of MovieLens video resource data set, it also increased by 0.27%, 0.09% and 2.76% in the three evaluation indexes respectively, which proves that the proposed recommendation model is still suitable for other resource recommendation tasks. The decomposition experiment shows that if the cross-sequence global course sequence graph or weighted directed graph attention layer in the proposed model is removed, the recommendation performance of the model will be significantly reduced, proving that the proposed improvement method is indeed effective and worthy of promotion and research in the recommendation task of Arabic private education course resources.

articleTitle: A Multi-Scale Vehicle Detection Method for Highways Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of vehicle detection model due to complex vehicle driving environment, target vehicle scale changes and occlusion in highway video data, a CCA-YOLOv5 model framework based on YOLOv5 is proposed. The CCA attention module is designed in the framework to enhance the model’s attention to key areas, and it is introduced into the YOLOv5 model to enhance the detection ability to adapt to different scales. It is verified on the public dataset BIT-Vehicle and the self-made highway vehicle dataset. The experimental results show that the detection rate and missed detection rate of the vehicle detection model CCA-YOLOv5 in the self-made highway vehicle dataset are 89% and 18%. Respectively, compared with the YOLOv5 model, the detection the rate increases by 21%, the missed detection the rate reduces by 14%, and the detection time of each picture reaches 3.8 milliseconds. It still maintains strong detection performance under the BIT-Vehicle dataset, so the model has high application value.

articleTitle: AI-Based Design Research on Visual Interaction Design for Virtual Navigation of Cultural Attractions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Digital intelligent tourism is the focus of the current development of tourism industry information construction, with the development of computer technology and artificial intelligence technology, scenic tourism is also gradually developing in an intelligent trend. For the personalization and intelligence of scenic virtual navigation design, the accuracy of scenic tourism navigation and route recommendation, the study designed the interface information such as navigation signs based on the idea of visual communication design, and secondly, the map matching model is designed based on artificial intelligence technology Hidden Markov Model. The simulation experiment results showed that with the increase of the sampling frequency, the working efficiency of the improved Hidden Markov model increased significantly. When the sampling frequency was 10s, the matching length of the improved Hidden Markov model per second was 850m/s, and the maximum difference was 800m/s. The highest matching accuracy value of the model in parallel and intersection sections reached 0.94, and the model accuracy curve had good stability, ranging from 0.80 to 0.90. The model performed best in terms of accuracy, recall, and F1 comprehensive performance evaluation, with values of 0.92, 0.88, and 0.87, respectively, which were higher than the other three models. Based on the design concept of visual communication and the expansion of artificial intelligence technology, this system suitable for scenic spots and route navigation has been designed, which has high practicality and has a promoting effect on creating intelligent scenic spots.

articleTitle: Path Planning Design of Warehouse Handling Robot Based on Dynamic Improved Dijkstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The logistics and warehousing industry is currently encountering novel opportunities and challenges. To address the path optimization problem when dealing with multi-objective storage and handling robots, this study proposes a path planning model for storage and handling robots utilizing a dynamic improved Dijkstra algorithm. The first step involves designing a suspended storage and handling robot system, followed by modeling a storing environment. Then, the traditional Dijkstra method is improved and a multi-objective dynamic path planning model on the foundation of this new method is built. The results indicate that, in the simulation test, the total travel time planned by the Dijkstra algorithm with dynamic improvements is 6.4 seconds less than that planned by the traditional Dijkstra algorithm. The average travel time of the dynamic improved Dijkstra algorithm is 21.27s, 22.1s, and 23.05s for 6, 8, and 10 tasks, respectively. These times are smaller than those of the traditional Dijkstra's algorithm, indicating that this new method can reduce the average travel time of the handling robot with some stability. In summary, the model constructed by the study has a good application effect in the path planning of multi-objective warehouse handling robot.

articleTitle: Emotion Analysis for Music Videos Based on 3D Residual and Decision Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the emotion recognition ability of video characters, a new emotion recognition model for music video characters is proposed based on three-dimensional convolutional neural network and multimodal fusion. Among them, the three-dimensional residual convolutional neural network was used for the emotion recognition of facial expressions. Then, the hierarchical granularity and feature model (HG-FM) was used for the emotion recognition of speech. Finally, the emotion recognition results of the two parts of expression and speech were fused by multi-modal fusion method, so as to obtain the final emotion recognition results. The experimental results show that compared with the single-modal emotion recognition model and the recognition model based on single fusion strategy, the emotion recognition model based on hybrid multi-modal fusion strategy has better recognition performance, and the recognition accuracy can reach 77.03%. In summary, the designed emotion recognition model of music video characters based on hybrid multi-modal fusion strategy has better recognition performance and can be applied to the emotion analysis of music videos, which has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Electromagnetic Spectrum Data Fusion Method Based on RSSI Detection Error Minimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In the field of radio spectrum detection, distributed electromagnetic spectrum detection systems can collect and process data more efficiently and flexibly than one-time mobile tests or fixed-point long-term tests. However, in a distributed system, multiple detection nodes need to be arranged in the monitoring area, each with its own data acquisition module. Due to individual differences between different devices, the measured electromagnetic data can also have errors. When comprehensively analyzing the data collected by each node, it will cause certain errors and affect the final calculation results. This paper proposes a method to normalize Received Signal Strength Indicator(RSSI) features. First, multiple HackRF modules are used to collect a set of energy data for the same signal source in the same environment, and the RSSI curve of the signal source in this environment is fitted by calculation. Next, specify a standard RSSI curve equation, adjust all curves to standard curves through formula transformation, increase the similarity between them, and derive a correction formula for each acquisition device. Then use the same equipment in the same environment for the second round of data collection, use the data of the second round as verification data, and calculate the RSSI curve of the second round. After obtaining the curve equation, the correction formula is used to calibrate, and the error before and after the correction of the verification data is compared. Experiments show that this method successfully increases the similarity of RSSI curves corresponding to different devices, and reduces the measurement differences of different HackRF devices on the same signal source in the same environment.

articleTitle: Construction of Teaching Classroom Quality Evaluation Model of College English Listening Based on SSA-BP
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the teaching quality of college English, this paper proposes a classroom teaching quality evaluation model of college English listening based on SSA-BP neural network. Among them, BP neural network is taken as the basic prediction evaluation model, and its parameters are optimized by sparrow search algorithm (SSA), thus further improving the evaluation effect. Simulation results reveal that the evaluation effect of the designed predictive evaluation model based on SSA-BP neural network is better than the model based on traditional BP neural network and PSO-BP neural network. In addition, the values of the designed model on the evaluation indexes of MAE, MAPE, MSE and RMSE are 6.93, 0.39, 0.89 and 9.49, respectively, and its evaluation accuracy is higher. Therefore, the designed predictive evaluation model based on SSA-BP neural network can carry out better classroom teaching quality evaluation on college English listening, with high accuracy and reliability, which can provide reference for actual teaching quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Multidimensional Tourism Suitability Evaluation Model Based on Scenic Area Information and Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of global tourism, the evaluation of tourism suitability has become an important means to optimize the management and operation of scenic spots. This study aims to improve the prediction accuracy of tourism suitability and provide accurate and effective decision basis for scenic spots. Based on scenic spot information and time series data, this study combines long and short term memory network and dynamic time distortion algorithm to achieve multi-dimensional tourism suitability prediction. The results show that the LSTM-DTW model has the best performance in single dimension prediction, and the optimized model has the best performance in multi-model multidimensional prediction, with RMSE reaching 1.832, MAE reaching 1.362, R2 reaching 0.938, and MAPE reaching 9.92%. It can be seen that the combination of dynamic time distortion and deep learning helps to improve the prediction accuracy of tourism suitability, and provides a new research Angle and method for optimizing scenic spot management and improving tourism service quality.

articleTitle: Research on Comment Data Mining of Cross-Border E-Commerce of Belt and Road Countries Based on Cross-Lingual Sentiment Classification Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: A sentiment recognition model of evaluation aspects based on improved attention mechanism and multi-task learning is proposed to mine the e-commerce review data in cross-border trade more deeply. The emotion recognition model based on Bi-LSTM is taken as the basic emotion recognition model, and the emotion recognition level of the model is further improved by adding attention mechanism to the emotion recognition model and constructing multi-task learning model. The experimental results show that compared with other emotion recognition models, the designed sentiment recognition model based on improved attention mechanism and multi-task learning has higher emotion recognition accuracy. In addition, its average recognition accuracy on each data set reaches 90%, indicating that the model is very suitable for the sentiment recognition of cross-border e-commerce reviews. Therefore, the proposed model can accurately judge the emotions of user evaluations, and help merchants make corresponding sales strategy adjustments, which has certain feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Grammar Error Correction in Business English Teaching Based on Data Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to further improve the text grammar error correction effect in business English teaching, a grammar error correction model based on enhanced multi-head attention is proposed. Among them, the Transformer model is taken as the basic correction model. In addition, the error correction effect is further improved by adding the self-attention module, dynamic residual structure and combining with data enhancement method. The experimental results show that compared with the basic Transformer model, the error correction model obtained through improvement has higher accuracy, indicating that the improvement has a certain effectiveness. Compared with other types of error correction models, the designed grammar error correction model based on enhanced multi-head attention has a better error correction effect. Its accuracy, recall rate and F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf> are 70.4%, 33.1% and 55.2%, respectively. In summary, it can be seen that the designed grammar error correction model based on enhanced multi-head attention has good error correction effect, and it can be applied to text grammar correction in business English teaching and help users to learn business English with better effect, which has high feasibility.

articleTitle: Design of Biomedical Information Acquisition System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In order to realize the accurate monitoring of patients' physiological state information in daily medical treatment, a medical physiological data acquisition system is proposed based on big data technology. Among them, the physiological data acquisition is subdivided into gesture state recognition and physiological state recognition. Meanwhile, GS+SVM model is used as the recognition model. The experimental results show that compared with other recognition methods, the designed GS+SVM recognition model can achieve better recognition effect in the recognition of different gesture states, and the recognition accuracy reaches 98.33%. Compared with the recognition of gesture state and physiological state by using a single physiological feature, using the data after feature fusion for recognition can obtain more accurate recognition results and better stability. The above experimental results verify that the GS+SVM physiological state recognition method designed in this paper can achieve good recognition effect, and can monitor patients' physiological state information in real time and accurately, which has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Semi-Supervised Learning for Individual-Level Functional Parcellation of the Human Precuneus
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Individual-level brain parcellation can help accurately depict individual functional organizations, thereby promoting the development of personalized medical practice. In this study, we developed a semi-supervised learning algorithm for the individual-level parcellation based on resting-state fMRI data, and performed the individual precuneus parcellation on three different subjects. The results revealed that the individual-level parcellation exhibited higher connectivity homogeneity compared with the group template and that obvious differences existed in parcellation boundary between individuals, implying the rationality and superiority of the proposed algorithm. This study provided a new approach for individualized brain area parcellation, which may help to better understand the functional characteristics of the human precuneus.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Robust Control for Dual-UAV Collaborative Aerial Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Quadrotor UAVs have the advantages of high flexibility and mobility, and the use of UAVs for transportation tasks can avoid the restrictions of complex terrain while improving transportation efficiency and reducing transportation costs. However, as the load capacity of a single UAV is very limited, multiple UAVs are introduced for coordinated transport to increase the system’s capacity. Aiming at transporting bar-shaped cargos, this paper studies the dual-UAV cooperative transportation system. However, compared with the single UAV transportation system, the dual-UAV cooperative transportation system has higher degrees of freedom, stronger nonlinearity, and more complex state coupling. Besides, considering the uncertainty and complexity of the actual environment, the system may encounter external disturbances during actual flight. Thus, to overcome the aforementioned challenges, an effective control scheme is urgently needed to ensure precise UAV positioning and cargo swing suppression for smooth cargo transportation. Therefore, this paper proposes a nonlinear robust control scheme based on the finite-time disturbance observer for the dual-UAV collaborative aerial transportation system. Subsequently, the convergence of the equilibrium point is proved by Lyapunov techniques and LaSalle’s Invariance Theorem. Finally, the excellent performance and robustness of the proposed control scheme are verified by groups of simulations.

articleTitle: Evolution of Research Themes in Traditional Chinese Medicine in China-Reflections on Advancing Internationalization of Traditional Chinese Medicine Research
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: To understand the hot spots and changing trends in the field of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) in recent years, and to contribute to the research of TCM and cultural communication. Based on the SCI and SSCI databases, 43458 papers published in 23 Chinese Medicine Universities from 2009 to 2019 were retrieved. With the aid of SCIMAT, co-word analysis and cluster analysis are used to identify the research topics and the dynamic evolution path of universities. The research topics presented 6 evolutionary paths in 4 directions. In recent years, the international influence of Chinese medicine research in China has been increasing day by day, but the research hotspots on Chinese medicine published in domestic and international journals are different, further efforts are needed to promote TCM research to gain broad international recognition.

articleTitle: Towards Object Detection Algorithm Based on LCAS-YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a composite floor defect detection method based on improved YOLOX network, introduces coordinate attention mechanism (CA) and adaptive spatial feature fusion (ASFF) modules to improve the enhanced feature extraction network of YOLOX network, and uses SIoU loss function to replace the original IoU loss function. The improved network is named CAS-YOLOX. Through ablation experiments, it has been proven that all three improvement methods have good improvement effects. Compared with other algorithms, the CAS-YOLOX network model has higher detection accuracy, with an mAP index of 97.19% and a detection speed of 46 FPS. Based on the design concept of deep separable convolution, the BottleNeck module in CAS-YOLOX was improved to obtain a lightweight network model named LCAS-YOLOX. Experiments have shown that compared with other algorithms, the LCAS-YOLOX network can better balance the relationship between detection accuracy, detection speed, and model lightness. The mAP (mean Average Precision) index is 96.84%, the detection speed reaches 53 FPS (Frame Per Second), and the parameter quantity is only 6.72M.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influencing Factors of Individual Internet Behavior in China
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Currently, the impact of Internet use on people is everywhere. Based on the data of CGSS2017, this paper uses descriptive analysis, correlation analysis, variance analysis, regression analysis and other methods to explore the factors that affect individual network usage in the information age. According to research, the stronger an individual is under pressure from society, family, etc., the more inclined they are to escape reality and seek spiritual comfort in the virtual world. The analysis results of this problem can provide individuals and society with positive guidance for healthy development, so that each individual in the midst of major changes can make good use of the Internet as a tool and make it a sharp weapon in their own career development.

articleTitle: Transfer Reinforcement Learning Based on Gaussian Process Policy Reuse
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Transfer reinforcement learning has become one of the hottest topics due to the challenges of low sample efficiency and poor generalization capacity in reinforcement learning. Policy-based transfer reinforcement learning applies the agent’s learnt policy on a source task to help agent learn quickly on a comparable but different target task. However, how to choose a policy on the source task remains a challenging problem. In this paper, we propose a policy reused based transfer reinforcement learning (PRTRL) algorithm, inspired by the fact that the output of stochastic policy is Gaussian distributed. On the source task, Gaussian process model is used to fit the pretrained policy and model the uncertainty. In the target task, the policy with uncertainty lower than the threshold is reused in the target task. It reduces the performance loss caused by inappropriate policy transfer while increasing the ratio of policy reuse. PRTRL reduces the policy search space on the target task through policy reuse. Experimental results carried out in different environments show that PRTRL is superior to the existing soft actor-critic algorithm in terms of sample efficiency and convergence speed, demonstrating good transfer performance.

articleTitle: Classroom Behavior Recognition of Students and Teaching Quality Evaluation Method Based on YOLOv5 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: As education enters the era of intelligence, how to intelligently conduct students' classroom behavior identification and teaching quality evaluation has gradually become an important task. In this context, this paper proposes a student classroom behavior recognition and teaching quality evaluation method based on the YOLOv5 model. First, obtaining students' classroom learning videos and using the trained YOLOv5 model to detect and recognize the student learning behaviors in the videos; Second, statistically analyzing the number of various students' behaviors and establishing the teaching quality evaluation model; Finally, according to the evaluation indicators developed to realize the evaluation of the quality of teaching. The experiment proves that the student classroom behavior recognition method based on the YOLOv5 model can provide timely and accurate feedback on the student's classroom learning situation and can better solve the problems of traditional teaching evaluation, such as time-consuming and subjective limitations.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Methods on Predicting Social Hotspots with Attention Mechanism: A Case Study on Zhihu
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Topic hotspot prediction technology not only allows researchers to know future research hotspots, but allows social organizations to know the issues of public concern. Although deep learning has achieved impressive results in hot spot prediction, there are still some challenges such as the topics popularity of public opinion was greatly affected by external news, it often fluctuates violently at particular times, resulting in insufficiently accurate predictions. To timely and accurately analyze the attention and demands of online topics, an Att-BLSTM model is optimized to cluster the popularity and predict its change trend based on millions of hot topics and their reply information. First, a K-means algorithm is used to cluster the hot topics of the hot topics. with the aim of more accurately describe the detailed features and long-term trends of topic popularity, a prediction model based on attention mechanism Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network is optimized, called as Att-BLSTM model. A large number of numerical experiments were conducted using information on hot topics from the Chinese Zhihu website. Depending on the results of the evaluation metrics, the comparative excellence of the Att-BLSTM model is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv3-Based Image Recognition of Garbage Plastic Bottles
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Refining waste sorting practices for enhanced garbage recycling rates holds the potential to safeguard the environment while conserving valuable resources. With the advancement of deep learning, the YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm has emerged as a promising tool for recognizing beverage bottles amidst garbage. To elevate target detection precision within intricate environmental scenarios, an enhanced approach rooted in YOLOv3 is introduced.This study proposes two pivotal enhancements to augment the capabilities of YOLOv3. Initially, the conventional LeakyReLU activation function is substituted with the Mish function. This replacement leverages Mish's attributes of smoothness and a defined lower bound, surpassing the traits of LeakyReLU. Subsequently, the SE’ASPP module is seamlessly integrated into the convolutional layer. This strategic integration amplifies the network's perceptual scope, thereby fortifying its competence in assimilating multi-scale contexts. This augmentation ultimately propels the model's precision to unprecedented heights.Validation procedures, conducted using a bespoke dataset, substantiate the efficacy of the enhanced YOLOv3 model, which attains an accuracy milestone of 85.26%. This accomplishment signifies a notable enhancement of 2.19% in contrast to the original model's performance.

articleTitle: In-Depth Analysis of Functional Corticomuscular Coupling after Stroke Using UEFD-PTE
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Motor dysfunction is a prominent symptom following stroke, primarily attributed to neural network damage that disrupts motor control. However, the precise mechanism underlying motor control between the cerebral cortex and the muscle system after stroke remains unclear. Elucidating this complex mechanism can provide some scientific basis for rehabilitation treatment after stroke. The aim of this study was to investigate the complex multiband functional coupling between the cerebral cortex and the muscular system based on a novel functional cortical muscle coupling analysis method to shed light on the mechanism of multiband neuromuscular control after stroke. In this study, 64-channel of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and electromyogram (EMG) signals encompassing pectoralis major, upper trapezius, anterior deltoids, middle deltoids, posterior deltoids, biceps, and triceps muscles were collected from 13 stroke patients and 13 healthy controls during the forward extension movement. Brain source localization and clustering methods were employed to identify active cortical regions associated with the movement, then a uniform empirical Fourier decomposition of EEG and EMG signals was performed, followed by the assessment of functional connectivity between active cortical regions and each muscle by calculating the partial transfer entropy. The results revealed significant differences in functional connectivity between stroke patients and healthy controls across different frequency bands, with the most pronounced coupling strength observed in the β band. The proposed coupling analysis method ensured the decomposition of EEG and EMG signals into the same frequency band, mitigating the problem of modal confounding and endpoint effects associated with signal decomposition. Furthermore, it effectively eliminated the adverse effects of indirect coupling on multichannel coupling analysis. Overall, this study’s coupling analysis provides valuable insights into the complex corticomuscular coupling after stroke, facilitating a comprehensive understanding of post-stroke neuromuscular dynamics by unraveling the intricate relationship between brain and muscle.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Weighted Ensemble Learning Model for Enterprises’ Carbon Emission Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Carbon emission reduction has become a major goal of China’s sustainable development. It is increasingly important to classify the carbon emissions of industrial enterprises accurately. The existing carbon emission classification and grading methods adopt the average value and fixed value method, ignoring the differences between different industries and the impact of different production periods on carbon emission classification, resulting in the results of enterprises’ carbon emission misclassification. In this paper, we propose an adaptive weighted ensemble learning model for enterprises’ carbon emissions classification, namely CarbonPortrait. The CarbonPortrait contains an adaptive weight allocator and an ensemble learning component, which composes the four latest classifiers. According to the different carbon emission time series, the weight allocator can adaptively allocate weights to four classifiers. The four classifiers can calculate the classification results, respectively. Then, the ensemble learning component can output the final classification results using a voting mechanism. The experimental evaluation results show that the classification accuracy and recall can be improved up to 22.91% and 27.2% than state-of-the-art methods in different periods and industries, respectively.

articleTitle: Application of Static Gesture Recognition Based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Gesture recognition is a very important technology in human-computer interaction. In classroom teaching, gesture recognition technology can also be used to improve the digital level of teaching, thus replacing the role of the page turning pen. In response to the complexity of the background and individual differences of gestures, and based on the characteristics of gesture interaction in classroom teaching, a static gesture recognition algorithm under a simple background can be selected to effectively detect and recognize the control gestures of multimedia courseware in classroom teaching, thereby achieving the goal of improving the level of classroom teaching informatization. This article proposes a method for controlling the flipping of multimedia courseware using static gesture segmentation and gesture feature extraction techniques. Firstly, a gesture model is constructed using an SVM classifier to classify and recognize gestures. Secondly, coded by the OpenCV Python library, opening the camera, collecting hand images, and fusing the OSTU threshold processing method based on the YCrCb color space, threshold segmentation gesture is selected. Thirdly, based on edge detection, elliptical Fourier descriptors are used to fit edges and extract gesture features. Finally, the SVM classifier is used to determine the gesture type, and then the internal communication mechanism is used to call the interface that controls the flipping of the PPT. The experimental results show that the above methods can be applied in classroom teaching under a simple background, and the average recognition accuracy rate of common gestures used to control multimedia courseware page turning reaches 100%, which can meet the requirements for the accuracy of gesture recognition and the stability of multimedia courseware control.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Document-Level Relation Extraction with Representation Enhance and Counterfactual Analiysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Few-shot document-level relation extraction poses a more complex and challenging task compared to sentence-level relation extraction. It also features a more realistic schema, especially in its NOTA (none-of-the-above) distribution. This paper proposes two improvements to address these challenges: entity pair enhancement and bias distillation. We enhance entity pair representation by incorporating the semantic information of relation labels. An attention mechanism is employed to strengthen the relation representation, resulting in more robust feature embedding. To mitigate biases, we introduce bias distillation using counterfactual analysis. Causal counterfactual intervention is leveraged to alleviate entity bias, label bias, and model bias. By adopting this approach, we aim to reduce the influence of biases on the relation extraction task. Our proposed approaches outperform previous benchmarks for the few-shot document-level relation extraction task, as demonstrated on the DocRED dataset.

articleTitle: Adaptive Weighted Grouping PSO Based Multi-Objective Optimization for Power Dispatch with Power Flow Limits
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the implementation of power dispatch while considering power flow limits, which presents a significant challenge in optimizing power systems due to the inherent conflict between objectives. To address the limitations imposed by power flow in power dispatch, this paper proposes an adaptive weighted grouping particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm based on Pareto front ranking. The algorithm involves grouping particles based on their Pareto front rankings and updating the particles iteratively within each group. During the particle update process, the weight of each particle is assigned by the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) method. The fitness evaluation of each particle incorporates three objectives: cost, emission, and active power loss. The cost objective includes factors such as generation and transmission costs, while emissions consider the environmental impact. The active power loss index reflects the efficiency of the power system. The proposed method is evaluated by the IEEE 30-bus system. Simulation results of the proposed method are compared with those of other methods reported in the literature. The experiments demonstrate that the algorithm outperforms other methods, providing a more comprehensive and flexible solution for addressing power flow limits.

articleTitle: Global Registration Based On Feature Remapping
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Point cloud has been widely used in various industrial areas such as high-precision maps for autonomous driving, structure from motion, and simultaneously localization and mapping, among which registration is a key section for subsequent processing. Traditional registration normally involves two stages, global alignment and local refinement. Global alignment offers an initial pose for local refinement to optimize. However, for point cloud segments containing noise and being partially overlapped, traditional methods are hard to meet the reasonable speed and accuracy standard. To address these defects, this paper presents an enhanced feature-matching-based registration pipeline, consisting of one novel matches filtration module and two improvements. The filtration module suppresses false positive matches in the initial matching set by using metric learning to distinguish false positive matches, hence the closed-form pose solver can provide a more globally accurate solution. The other two improvements include a scatter constraint that suppresses registration falling into local optimal and a matches sampling algorithm reducing the time cost to sample a set of valid matches.

articleTitle: DACGAN-TMS: A Diverse Conditional Image Synthesis Method Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Image synthesis based on generative adversarial networks (GANs) is a hot spot in current computer vision research. The diverse condition image synthesis tasks are necessary to ensure that the generated images still have high diversity while meeting the input conditions. However, conditional GANs (cGANs) excessively rely on the input conditional information and ignore the noise vectors, which can easily lead to the mode collapse problem. Although many methods have been proposed to solve this problem, these methods still have some limitations. In this work, we propose an innovative model called DACGAN-TMS, which is used to generate diverse images without increasing too much training overhead. In DACGAN-TMS, an additional regularization term is added to the loss function of the generator model to encourage the generator to detect more minor modes during training, that is, to stimulate the generator to generate different pictures in the course of training. It effectively improves the problem that the original ACGAN is easy to collapse during training and difficult to generate diversified pictures. In addition, the standard convolution of the generator is completely replaced by dynamic convolution, and the convolution parameters are adaptively adjusted to further enhance the expressive capability of the model. Extensive experiments and statistical comparison results manifest that DACGAN-TMS is superior to the relevant GAN-based models in generating different images.

articleTitle: LTTPoint: A MLP-Based Point Cloud Classification Method with Local Topology Transformation Module
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In recent years, advancements and enhancements in 3D scanning technology have significantly improved the accessibility of 3D data. Three-dimensional data serves a wide array of applications, including augmented reality, autonomous driving, and robotics.
