The precise and rapid classification of 3D point cloud data stands as a fundamental challenge within these domains. Nonetheless, the inherent attributes of point cloud data, such as its unordered structure and non-uniform density, present substantial hurdles in data processing. To tackle these obstacles, we have developed and implemented a point cloud classification model grounded in a residual Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with an integrated local topological transformation module. This module assimilates geometric prior knowledge from the local neighborhood into the point cloud data and employs affine transformations to address the unordered and locally non-uniform density characteristics of point cloud data. The outcome is a succinct yet highly effective method for point cloud classification. Our approach’s competitiveness is demonstrated through experiments conducted on open-source datasets like ModelNet40 and ScanObjectNN, where it surpasses other recently proposed methods for point cloud classification.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of PET/CT Imaging in Lung Cancer Diagnosis: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Lung cancer poses a considerable global health hurdle due to its elevated occurrence and fatality rates. Swift and precise identification of lung nodules hold vital importance in devising effective treatment plans. Routine diagnostic tools encompass X-ray CT and PET scans, supplying structural and metabolic insights, respectively. Nonetheless, depending solely on these techniques might not deliver exact diagnoses. As a result, the emergence of PET/CT systems has arisen, amalgamating PET and CT data. These systems furnish a comprehensive outlook on both metabolism and structure, enhancing the precision of lung cancer diagnosis, disease staging, and prognosis anticipation. The amalgamation of PET/CT technology demonstrates potential in clinical application. It assists in the premature spotting of lung cancer lesions, elevating patient survival rates, and guiding treatment methodologies. Furthermore, it curtails needless surgeries and radiation therapy, mitigating patient encumbrances and treatment hazards. In synopsis, the progression and adoption of PET/CT imaging in lung cancer detection bear immense significance. Therefore, this review briefly introduces the development and application of PET/CT imaging in lung cancer detection, which is of great significance for improving lung cancer treatment and diagnostic strategies and providing scientific evidence for its clinical practice.

articleTitle: Interpretive Clinical Measurements Prediction and Diagnosis in ICU with Multi-Task Attention-Guided Sequential Feature Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: During the outbreak of COVID-19, it is particularly important to improve clinical decision making for critically ill patients in intensive care units (ICU). Machine learning has become increasingly important in healthcare analysis with the wide adoption of Electronic Health Records (EHR). Many deep learning algorithms, such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), have been developed to deal with clinical time series data to predict the health status of patients, such as mortality, ventilation, and phenotype, etc. Despite RNN being successful in medical tasks, the special traits of data, such as long temporality, high dimensionality, existence of missing values, and multi-labels, have brought challenges to either shallow or deep learning algorithms. Motivated by the fact that the progress of diseases may vary over time, to address these challenges, we proposed a multi-task attention-guided recurrent neural network for learning sequential features (MASFL) model, which employs recurrent units and an attention mechanism. The recurrent units can memorize the past progressive information of patients after entering ICU, while the attention mechanism can selectively utilize this information for different prediction tasks. Meanwhile, the attention also helps to interpret the relationship between the clinical time series data and the prediction result. Furthermore, in order to solve undesirable local solutions for the patient’s length-of-stay task, we develop an ordinal regression loss to address the issue. According to the experiments on MIMIC-III, we demonstrate that the proposed model can improve the prediction performance over state-of-the-art prediction approaches.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Management of Coal Mine Accidents Based on Information Extraction and Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Currently, the experience and knowledge of coal mine accident description and disposal are mainly in electronic documents and other unstructured forms, which are complicated, seriously fragmented, and poorly shared and cannot meet the demand for digitization of case knowledge for emergency response. The emergency of natural language processing and Knowledge Graph technology reorganize texture knowledge, improve data utilization efficiency, and explore information utilization value. With the goal extracted from automatic accident reporting entity, relationship and event information, a rule-based approach is used to match long-tail entities, a unified text-to-structure generation system is constructed using the Universal Information Extraction model, and the target structure of information extraction is generated adaptively to achieve unified extraction of entities, relationships and events. According to the experiment, the ontology model proposed in this paper can better digitally represent coal mine accidents. By pre-training and parameter adjustment of the UIE model, the extraction from entity relationship achieves 60.7% accuracy, 62.3%recall, and 61.5% f1 value in the case of the small-scale sample labeling. The construction of the knowledge graph about the coal mine accident provides a basis for intelligent search and Q&A, knowledge inference and accurate analysis, and intelligent recommendation and decision-making, which is of great significance to improve further the digitalization and intelligence level of emergency management in a coal mine field.

articleTitle: Robust 2D Visual Localization Under Indoor Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Robot localization technology is an important research hotspot in robotics. The usual robot localization technology aims to estimate the six degree of freedom pose of the robot itself, including orientation and position. However, in certain specific scenarios, such as indoor sweeping robots, the robot is only limited to move on a single plane, so only three degrees of freedom, i.e. 2-D pose, and a yaw angle need to be estimated. Most of the existing 2D scene pose estimation methods use LiDAR, but this sensor has drawbacks such as high cost and difficulty in installation. The existing visual-based localization schemes are mostly performed in 3D space, which increases the computational complexity when used in 2D scenes. In this article, we designed an indoor robot 2D pose estimation system that includes mapping and localization functions, using a visual stereo camera and a combination of wheel odometry. Through extensive experimental results, our designed system has achieved the best performance in 2D scenes compared to existing visual odometry algorithms.

articleTitle: Clara: Semi-Automatic Annotation Algorithm for Medical Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of artificial intelligence. With the help of artificial intelligence, various fields are developing rapidly. This paper discusses the potential of the combination of artificial intelligence and medical image to realize accurate medical image annotation and analysis. The accuracy of medical diagnosis depends on the accuracy of image recognition. In order to optimize image recognition, this paper proposes a semi-automatic image annotation method, which improves the professionalism of data through human-computer interaction and expands data rapidly. Our contribution is to improve the edge aliasing and imprecision of Live-Wire dimensions. It reduces the use of medical resources in the labeling process, improves the accuracy of data labeling, and ensures the accuracy of medical image recognition. This is a portable algorithm, and it can also improve the accuracy of image recognition in other fields. Image recognition experiments are carried out by using LabelMe and Live-Wire methods. The results show that Live-Wire method has a better recognition effect than LabelMe method, and the stability of the tag is more than 99%. To sum up, the combination of semi-automatic marking and medical image recognition provides a new possibility for medical application, and is expected to play an important role in the early diagnosis and treatment of diseases.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Feature Mining Algorithm for GPR Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Ground-penetrating radar is an important nondestructive technical means in bridge and tunnel defect detection, and the intelligent analysis of its signal is a research hotspot. The method of radar image interpretation widely used in the industry has the problem of insufficient mining of radar data information. In this paper, convolution and time sequences token are used to extract the time sequences features and spatial features of the radar signal respectively, and the Transformer module is introduced into the network to effectively fuse the spatial-time features. Experiments on rebar recognition on measured tunnel data show that the accuracy of our method reaches 99.5%, and it is robust and has good industrial application value.

articleTitle: Improving Sailfish Optimizer with Population Switching Strategy and Random Mutation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: We propose two novel search strategies to further boost the performance of the standard sailfish optimizer (SFO) and present an enhanced SFO with advanced capabilities. Specifically, the first strategy, named the population switching strategy, takes into account the fitness consumption cost of the sardine population. It enables individuals from two different populations to switch, resulting in improved search efficiency. The second strategy, referred to as the random mutation strategy, assists the stagnant individuals in escaping from localized areas where they are trapped and facilitates their search for other potential regions. To evaluate the performance of these strategies, we conducted experiments using three SFO variants: SFO with the population switching strategy, SFO with the random mutation strategy, and SFO with both strategies. Additionally, we compared these variants with the standard SFO on 29 benchmark functions from the CEC2017 test suite. Each benchmark function consists of various dimensions, and each dimension was independently run 30 times. Moreover, we applied the improved algorithm to two classical engineering design problems and compared its performance with three other evolutionary computation (EC) algorithms, including the conventional SFO. The experimental results confirmed that the improved SFO exhibited superior convergence accuracy and provided improved solutions for the two engineering design problems.

articleTitle: Polyp Segmentation Based on Boundary Supervision and Temporal Association
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Automatic segmentation of endoscopic polyps plays a crucial role in the prevention and treatment of colorectal cancer. However, achieving accurate polyp segmentation poses significant challenges due to the low contrast and blurred boundaries of polyps, as well as the dynamic nature of endoscopy, which often leads to the neglect of valuable temporal cues. To address these issues, we propose an innovative endoscopic polyp segmentation model that combines boundary supervision and temporal association. Our model includes a boundary-supervised module designed to extract precise boundaries and provide additional supervision specifically targeting the polyp boundary region. This module enhances the segmentation performance by effectively addressing the challenges associated with low contrast and blurred boundaries. Additionally, we introduce a temporal association module that leverages memory to store the polyp segmentation results as prototypes. These prototypes are then utilized to facilitate subsequent polyp segmentation, leading to superior performance in video polyp segmentation. To evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method, we conducted comprehensive experiments on widely recognized datasets, namely CVC-300, CVC-612, and SUN-SEG. The results of these experiments demonstrate the superior capability of our proposed method compared to other state-of-the-art methods and baseline models in terms of polyp segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-View Outlier Detection Based on High-Order Neighbor Information
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In recent years, the analysis and mining of multi-view data has become a new research hot spot. As an important branch, multi-view outlier detection has achieved some success, but there are still some problems to be solved. Most existing outlier detection methods assume that the instances conform to a clear clustering structure, while outliers exhibit unusual clustering characteristics in multiple views, and often apply some off-the-shelf clustering methods to discover the clustering structure. However, in real world applications, the structure of data is often complicated and the data may not reveal such a clear clustering structure. These methods are difficult to handle such complicated data. To address this issue, in this paper, we propose a simple yet effective method, named the multi-view outlier detection based on High-order Neighbor Information (HoNI), which makes full use of the high-order neighbor information of the data to better detect outliers. With the help of the high-order neighbor information, we do not need any assumptions of the clustering structure and thus do not need to apply any clustering methods. We conduct extensive experiments to verify the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method in terms of performance and running time on some benchmark data sets. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Fast Transfer-Based Adaptive Recurrent Neural Network Model for Enterprise Carbon Emission Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Predicting enterprise carbon emissions quickly and accurately has become a key focus in achieving the "carbon peak and neutrality" goals. However, existing deep learning models have high computational costs, hindering their ability to accurately and efficiently make real-time predictions of enterprise carbon emissions, thus failing to meet the current demand. To address this problem, we propose a fast transfer-based adaptive recurrent neural network model named SEER. This model significantly improves training accuracy and expedites the training process. SEER integrates attention mechanisms and weight allocation to extract features from input sequences and adaptively adjust the weights of different time series, improving the model’s ability to handle distribution shifts. Furthermore, we incorporate an adaptive learning rate mechanism that dynamically adjusts the learning rate based on gradient information to enhance the training efficiency of the model. Experimental results indicate that SEER outperforms state-of-the-art techniques in terms of performance, exhibiting superior prediction accuracy and a training speed that can speed up to 66% than other models when evaluated on diverse real-world datasets. Additionally, our evaluation proves the capability of SEER to rapidly and accurately predict enterprise carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Mixed Transformer for Temporal 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation from Monocular Video
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Accurate and smooth reconstruction of human motion sequences is critical for 3D human pose and shape estimation from monocular video. Image-based human reconstruction methods are difficult to achieve smooth results on videos. Existing video-based methods either use recurrent neural networks or convolutional neural networks to model temporal information, or use attention mechanisms to capture global human-related information. Although they have achieved better results, they did not consider modeling both temporal information and extracting global human-related static information at the same time. In this paper, we propose a Mixed transformer-based Human Mesh Recovery network (MixformerHMR), which can model temporal information and extract global static information simultaneously. Specifically, we design a GRUformer by using GRU as the token mixer of MetaFormer to model the temporal information and use a transformer-based feature extractor to extract global static feature from an input video. Our MixformerHMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and achieves competitive results in smoothness on the Human3.6M, 3DPW, and MPI-INF-3DHP benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Medical Image Super-Resolution: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Medical image super-resolution (SR) reconstruction technology has a wide range of scenarios and important values in medical diagnosis. The use of SR reconstruction algorithms can enhance low-resolution (LR) medical images into high-resolution (HR) medical images, thus overcoming the problems of low spatial resolution caused by the limitations of physical equipment conditions of image acquisition and the own limitations of imaging principles, and can present the details of human organs or tissues more clearly, especially making the local feature information of lesion points, thus assisting doctors to make a more accurate diagnosis in the clinic. This paper reviews the research on medical image SR reconstruction methods at home and abroad, firstly introduces the performance indexes for evaluating image SR reconstruction methods, then systematically describes the medical image SR reconstruction technology based on deep learning methods, and finally analyzes the problems that still exist in this field and points out the future research directions.

articleTitle: CR-VAE: Contrastive Regularization on Variational Autoencoders for Preventing Posterior Collapse
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The Variational Autoencoder (VAE) is known to suffer from the phenomenon of posterior collapse, where the latent representations generated by the model become independent of the inputs. This leads to degenerated representations of the input, which is attributed to the limitations of the VAE’s objective function. In this work, we propose a novel solution to this issue, the Contrastive Regularization for Variational Autoencoders (CR-VAE). The core of our approach is to augment the original VAE with a contrastive objective that maximizes the mutual information between the representations of similar visual inputs. This strategy ensures that the information flow between the input and its latent representation is maximized, effectively avoiding posterior collapse. We evaluate our method on a series of visual datasets and demonstrate, that CR-VAE outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in preventing posterior collapse. Code for this project is available at https://github.com/ligerfotis/crvae.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Learning Facial Expression Recognition Based on Monte-Carlo Dropout
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Significant progress has been made in Face Expression Recognition (FER) through deep learning techniques. However, FER in wild scenes still encounters challenges. When expression data containing noise is fed into Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), it inevitably affects the quality of network model parameters. The model exhibits epistemic uncertainty, but lacks uncertainty measurement of prediction results in its network architecture, leading to decision-making errors caused by overconfidence in practical applications. To address these issues, we conducted an in-depth study of FER methods for uncertain data. Specifically, we propose a deep Bayesian model based on the MC (Monte Carlo) Dropout algorithm, referred to as MC-FerNet, which approximates model uncertainty without altering the neural network structure or optimization techniques. Experimental results demonstrate that the deep Bayesian model with the efficient MC Dropout algorithm can avoid overfitting problems due to the randomness of model parameters. Furthermore, with an increase in running times, the improved model exhibits robust performance.

articleTitle: Soft Shared Multi-Task Convolutional Network Based on the Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Rolling bearings are widely used and related to production safety, so bearing health status management is very important. In the bearing health management, fault diagnosis is the core problem, and residual lifetime (RUL) prediction is also very important. However, in the traditional single-task learning (STL) method, it is necessary to build a model for each task in which the training time is long and the efficiency is low. In addition, the traditional hard shared multi-task learning (MTL) method cannot be characterized according to each task characteristic, resulting in low generalization. Aiming at the problems of low efficiency of single task and low generalization hardware-shared multi-task capability, this paper proposes a soft shared multi-task convolutional network (SMTCNN) method based on attention mechanism and dynamic task weight to achieve accurate bearing fault diagnosis and RUL prediction. A shared feature extraction module convolutional neural network is established for joint training to improve efficiency. Then, an adaptive feature extraction module based on attention mechanism is built for different tasks to enhance the feature extraction ability of the model. Meanwhile, task weights are set dynamically based on uncertainty to enhance the model's generalization ability. Finally, compared with the STL and traditional hard sharing MTL, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results in terms of the fault diagnosis accuracy with 98.68% and the RUL prediction RMSE with 0.22, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed model in prognostics and health management.

articleTitle: Automatic Bone Metastasis Diagnosis Framework via Lightweight Transformer-Based Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Bone metastasis is one of the main cancer complications whose diagnosis is mainly based on bone scintigraphy. As an assistance for the diagnosis of bone metastasis, researches based on convolutional neural networks have achieved impressive performance. However, due to the absence of relevant dataset, most existing methods could only diagnose whether metastasis occurred without indicating the general location of its occurrence or make diagnoses of only few specific organs. Such models may lose the insights of regional information and deviate from clinical practice. To address this issue, we construct the first bone scintigraphy dataset where whole body images in the anterior view are segmented into 13 distinct body parts and all subsets of body parts are carefully annotated according to formal diagnoses. With comprehensively annotated dataset, we propose an automatic diagnosis framework via lightweight transformer-based network with early convolutions and spatial dimension reduction to make detailed diagnoses for all body parts. The results reveal that our overall diagnosis achieves higher recall, satisfying accuracy and with fewer parameters compared to popular models for medical image classification. Dataset and code would be made public upon acceptance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Urban Vehicle Destination Prediction Through Trajectory Metadata Integration and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Urban traffic management and scheduling demand precise vehicle destination predictions to gain insights into traffic flow dynamics. Existing prediction methods predominantly leverage coordinate information from trajectory sequences, often overlooking crucial metadata, leading to diminished accuracy. In this study, we present an innovative approach to enhance urban vehicle destination prediction by integrating trajectory metadata. Our method employs trajectory clustering for classification, semantic description of trajectories through word embedding, and enhancement of metadata dimensions using embedding technology to extract valuable information. Subsequently, we integrate the mined information into a deep neural network to predict destination coordinates. Comparative analysis against methods relying solely on raw coordinate data reveals a significant 7% reduction in distance error. Our approach contributes to the evolution of traffic management systems, fostering excellence in urban mobility.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation of Sodium-Ion Batteries Based on N-BEATS Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy sources in the grid and the deficiencies of lithium batteries in terms of storage capacity have necessitated the use of sodium batteries as large scale energy storage devices in renewable energy systems. Accurate estimation of the State of Charge (SOC) of such batteries is of great significance. In this paper, we fabricated the CR2032 sodium-ion batteries and propose a novel method for the estimation of SOC of sodium-based coin cell using a Neural Basis Expansion Analysis for Time Serious (N-BEATS). The advantage of this method is that it does not require the input features to estimate the SOC, instead, the historical information of time series is used to predict the future information. Therefore, there is no need to collect external observations to achieve battery management system (BMS) cost savings. Experimental results show that the proposed method can substantially reduce the estimation error, with a mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) of less than 0.3669 % and 0.4549 %, respectively. This improved reliability of the BMS under the energy storage system (EES) is of great significance.

articleTitle: PRAB: A Pre-Relation Aware Bidirectional Framework for Relational Triple Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Extracting relational triples from unstructured text is one of the key tasks in information extraction. In terms of extraction methods, the existing entity-relation joint extraction models are mainly divided into two categories, namely entity-guided and relation-guided. Although considerable progress has been made in research of joint extraction methods, they still have shortcomings. The entity-guided model is susceptible to entity identification and the model is highly sensitive to the results of entity identification, while the relation-guided model suffers from relation redundancy. To this end, this paper proposes a new relational triple extraction structure, namely Pre-Relation-Aware Bidirectional Framework (PRAB). Specifically, a Pre-Relation component is designed to identify the potential relations set in a sentence, then obtain the features representation of the relations set for subsequent entity recognition. It should be noted that the feature representations of the set of these relations are only used as an aid to identify entities, rather than as the final result of relation extraction. In this way, it is possible to use relations for entity extraction, while avoiding redundancy of relations by rashly extraction. In addition, a parallel structure for extracting subject and object simultaneously is used in this paper, where the components in both directions can share the code, thus the feature representations of both components can communicate with each other. Similar to the idea of pre-relation, we design dual entity recognition components in both directions to perform entity recognition filtering to improve the sensitivity of subsequent components to entity recognition results. The extensive experimental results show that the proposed model achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Medical Image Segmentation of Intracranial Hemorrhage: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) is a common clinical emergency that can lead to brain damage or death in a serious situation with extremely high disability and mortality rates. In order to obtain effective treatment for patients timely, the rapid and accurate detection of ICH is crucial. Considering that different subtypes of bleeding correspond to different treatment strategies in clinical practice, it is necessary to quickly diagnose ICH at the early stage. Computed tomography (CT) is one of the most effective ways to detect ICH. For quantifying the lesions and facilitating the subsequent treatments, the segmentation of ICH based on CT images is an extremely important step. The paper presents a review of the task of ICH segmentation, elaborates on the properties of ICH data and the available datasets for research, provides a detailed introduction to the traditional and deep-learning methods, and outlines various improvement schemes for deep-learning models. Finally, the current research achievements in this field are summarized, some urgent problems are proposed, and future research development is foreseen.

articleTitle: A Social Recommendation Algorithm Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In recent years, because social relationship data mostly exist in the form of graph structure, it is found that there is a strong topological relationship between data points of graph data, and there may be some similar attributes between connected nodes. It has become a powerful tool to process this kind of data by using graph neural network (GNN). We find that the traditional social recommendation algorithm considers the interactive information of users based on homogeneity theory and does not combine the interactive information and social information of users well, resulting in low recommendation efficiency. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a social recommendation algorithm based on graph neural networks. In this paper, the algorithm performs linear learning on the user-project bipartite graph and social graph respectively to obtain more representations of users and projects. At the same time, the embedding vector is fully obtained, and the information extraction of the target node is strengthened by integrating attention network and feature transfer network (FTN). Secondly, graph neural networks are introduced to dynamically aggregate and learn representations with social information and update the preference representations of target users. Then, the interaction of users' high-order semantic information is realized through MLP. Finally, the user's hidden factors in different spaces are combined to make recommendation prediction. Through experiments on public data sets, we verify that our algorithm is more efficient than other baselines.

articleTitle: FCM-BRB Health State Prediction Model for Industrial Robot Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Accurate prediction of the health state of industrial robots is essential to guarantee their proper functioning and determine safe maintenance strategies-. However, in practice, modeling multiple characteristic parameters of industrial robots can cause problems such as greatly increasing the complexity of the model, excessive response time, and the explosion of the established model combinations. Therefore, this paper proposes an FCM-BRB (Fuzzy c-mean-belief rule base) health state prediction method for predicting the health state of industrial robotic systems. BRB is not only flexible in health state prediction but can also handle a variety of predictive models with semi-quantitative information. The method firstly uses PCA feature dimensionality reduction to screen out the feature parameters that can express the health state of industrial robots, then uses fuzzy C-means to optimize the reference values of premise attributes of the BRB model, which is used to overcome the uncertainty of the expert knowledge in the engineering domain, and secondly, uses the Projection Covariance Matrix Adaptive Evolution Strategy (P-CMA-ES) as the optimization algorithm, which improves the prediction accuracy. Finally, the validity and reasonableness of the method are verified by using an ABB IRC5 industrial robot of a certain type of body-in-white welding production line as an example.

articleTitle: Clustering PBFT Improvement Based on Trusted Lists
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Blockchain has great application value in the field of finance, Internet of Things, digital copyright, decentralization is the most fundamental feature of blockchain. Decentralization increases the fault tolerance and security of the whole blockchain network, ensuring that the data cannot be tampered with, but decentralization greatly increases the amount of message communication in the whole system, so the whole blockchain network is very inefficient in the case of consensus of multiple nodes. The consensus algorithm is the core technology for implementing decentralization.In this paper, we propose a CG-PBFT consensus algorithm based on credit list grouping hierarchy, which aims to solve the problems of wasteful communication resources and inefficiency caused by too many broadcast messages in PBFT (Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance algorithm). The implementation of the CG-PBFT algorithm is divided into three main steps: First, by selecting nodes with higher credit value as group leader nodes, the harm of malicious nodes to the whole consensus system can be significantly reduced. Second, the optimal grouping according to the communication delay between nodes can improve the efficiency of the whole consensus system. Finally, the intra-group consensus is performed first in the consensus phase, followed by the global consensus, which can significantly reduce the network overhead. Experiments demonstrate that the CG-PBFT consensus algorithm has lower network overhead, lower network latency, and higher Byzantine node fault tolerance.

articleTitle: Research on DouDiZhu Model Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Computer game is the carrier of artificial intelligence (AI) research. DouDiZhu is a multi-player imperfect-information game, which has problems of enormous hidden information, high complexity, and coexistence of competition and collaboration. In this paper, a DouDiZhu AI based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is designed to solve the above problems. First, a heuristic-based DouDiZhu agent is developed and generates training data by self-play. Second, the DouDiZhu model is trained by supervised learning (SL) method. In this process, the role information is innovatively encoded, and the game strategies of various roles can be learned by only one model. This approach solves the problem of tedious training process and high model complexity caused by multi-modeling. Finally, the decision-making ability of the SL model is further enhanced by DRL method, where a new node reward function is designed to enrich reward signal. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method is feasible and effective. The runner-up agent of the 2022 IEEE Conference on Games is defeated by the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Learning Local-Global Feature Representation for Pedestrian Detection and Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In recent years, exploration of pedestrian detection and Re-identification technology with the important goal of building intelligent monitoring systems has made good breakthroughs with the development of deep learning. However, in the constantly changing and complex real-world scenarios, this task still faces many challenges such as image resolution, size, perspective, pedestrian posture, etc. The algorithms are far from practical application. In this paper, we propose a deep learning-based pedestrian detection and re-identification algorithm that focuses on improving feature extraction and similarity measurement. We attach importance to the extraction and utilization of local features and train both local and global branches together. At the same time, through repeated comparative experiments, we improve the design of the metric loss function, so that the model performance compared to the initial model on Market-1501: rank-1 reaches 0.91 and mAP reaches 0.78, a relative improvement of 10.22%. In addition, our approach demonstrates competitive performance on the challenging MSMT17 dataset.

articleTitle: ConvCCpose: Learning Coordinate Classification Tokens for Human Pose Estimation Based on ConvNeXt
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Human pose estimation plays a vital role in real-world applications. In academia, 2D HPE has achieved excellent performance, but its application in the industry is challenging due to issues such as a large number of model parameters and high latency. To address this, this paper presents an efficient human pose estimation model called ConvCCPose, based on a convolutional neural network architecture. ConvCCPose tackles the challenge by separating the coordinate localization task into a classification task for horizontal and vertical coordinates, eliminating the need for additional post-processing and facilitating easier deployment. The ConvNeXt serves as the backbone for feature extraction, while a spatial bias module is introduced to enhance the backbone's feature extraction capability. Additionally, a contextual feature aggregation module is designed to enable multi-scale feature fusion. This module aids in extracting human structural representations that are valuable for accurate pose estimation. Specifically, on the MSCOCO validation dataset, ConvCCPose obtains 73.8% AP with 2.8 GFLOPs. It achieves a balance between computational efficiency and accuracy, making it more suitable for practical applications.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Alignment Framework for Batch Effect Removal and Cell Type Classification in ScRNA-seq
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Cell type annotation plays a crucial role in scRNA-seq data analysis, but traditional manual annotation approach is time-consuming and susceptible to subjective factors and errors. While supervised classification methods alleviate this problem, there are risks associated with this label transfer strategy. For example, the sensitivity of batch effects may affect the classification results of the target data. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage alignment framework(TAF) based on domain adaptation, which aims to address batch effects in scRNA-seq data and perform cell type classification. First, the nonlinear features with the highest correlation between each source domain reference dataset and the target domain query dataset are extracted using deep generalized canonical correlation analysis (DGCCA). Second, the first stage of alignment is achieved by domain-specific feature extraction, in which the distribution of each source domain reference dataset and the query dataset in the target domain are aligned, and the domain-invariant feature representation is learned. Then, the second stage of alignment is performed by domain-specific labeled classifiers, and the output probability matrices of the query datasets are aligned using virtual adversarial training (VAT) and inconsistent loss constraint, which adjusts the prediction results of target samples near the category boundaries to achieve aligning the outputs of different classifiers. Finally, weights are assigned to the classifiers’ output probability matrices based on the reference dataset’s sample size to obtain more accurate prediction labels. Experimental results on four human pancreatic datasets demonstrate that the TAF method outperforms some state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition of Medical Records Combining Confrontation and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Named entity recognition for Chinese electronic medical records is the key step of data mining and information extraction, so how to improve the accuracy of related named entity recognition model is very important. Based on the baseline model BiLSTM-CRF, a named entity recognition method for Chinese electronic medical records (EMRs) is proposed, which incorporates antagonistic training and attention mechanism. In this method, perturbation factors are added into the model embedding layer through adversarial training to generate adversarial samples for model training. In the feature extraction layer, BiLSTM module and multi-head self-attention module are combined to capture the temporal features, context information and global feature representation of text sequences more comprehensively. Experiments on the CCKS 2019 dataset show that the proposed method can effectively improve the recognition performance and robustness of the model.

articleTitle: Fitting Curves with Fractional Implicit Polynomials: A PSO-Assisted Monomial Combination Optimization Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Implicit polynomial can efficiently represent the object contour for the curve fitting, and fractional implicit polynomial (FIP) is capable of describing complex objects at lower degree. However, both of IP and FIP based curve fitting methods suffer from the problem of insufficient fitting accuracy because of spurious zero sets. In this paper, we propose a particle swarm optimization (PSO)-assisted monomial combination optimization framework to fit curves based on FIP. In the proposed PSO-FIP framework, we adopt a monomial combination optimization strategy to remove redundant monomials and reduce spurious zero sets accordingly. And then, we solve the combinatorial explosion problem by using PSO in the monomial combination optimization. We further propose a geometric distance metric to serve as the fitness function in PSO which overcomes the trivial solution problem of algebraic distance. We conduct extensive experiments to validate the PSO-FIP framework and the results demonstrate that our approach can achieve higher accuracy with fewer coefficients in curve fitting.

articleTitle: Multi-View Multi-Label Learning Based on Improved Fusion Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In multi-view multi-label classification task, each sample is described by features from multiple views and contains multiple semantic information. Previous methods established a separate classifier for each view and combined the prediction results and contribution weights of all classifiers to make the final prediction. However, these methods tended to overlook possible interactions among multiple views and did not consider the shared information among multiple views. Therefore, we propose Multi-view Multi-label Learning based on Improved Fusion Strategy (MMIFS). Firstly, we learn a shared subspace and utilize it as a supplementary view. Then we construct a separate classifier for each view and learn the corresponding contribution weights. We introduce digital labels instead of logical labels and maintain label co-occurrence dependency based on the smoothing assumption. Finally, we improve the performance of MMIFS by converting linear model to non-linear model. Based on extensive experiments with five datasets, MMIFS exhibits favorable performance and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Review of Data-Driven Approaches for Malicious Website Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The detection of malicious websites has become a critical issue in cybersecurity. Therefore, this paper offers a comprehensive review of data-driven methods for detecting malicious websites. Traditional approaches and their limitations are discussed, followed by an overview of data-driven approaches. The paper establishes the data-feature-model-extension pipeline and the latest research developments of data-driven approaches, including data preprocessing, feature extraction, model construction and technology extension. Specifically, this paper compares methods using deep learning models proposed in recent years. Furthermore, the paper follows the data-feature-model-extension pipeline to discuss the challenges together with some future directions of data-driven methods in malicious website detection.

articleTitle: Attention-Guided CNN-Transformer Hybrid Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Hyperspectral image classification has always been a task of great concern in the field of remote sensing. Transformer networks have demonstrated their powerful ability to capture global relationships and have achieved success in image analysis. However, when faced with the task of hyperspectral image classification, conventional image preprocessing methods lead to the loss of spectral information, failing to retain complete spectral-spatial information. To better solve this problem, this paper proposes an Attention-Guided CNN-Transformer Hybrid Network (AGCTHN). This network combines the strengths of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformer networks in feature extraction while exploring the spectral and spatial information of large-scale and complex remote sensing images. A multi-level attention guidance mechanism is designed from shallow to deep at different scales, where convolutional features guide the self-attention module of the Transformer to focus on key details in the spectral bands of the image. Extensive experiments on hyperspectral image classification datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed AGCTHN. The experimental results illustrate that the network outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Multi-View Clustering via View-Specific Representation and Global Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Multi-view clustering can improve clustering performance by leveraging the complementary information from multiview data and has garnered growing interest. Despite significant advancements has been established in this field, most existing methods primarily concentrate on learning the latent representation, neglecting the latent graph that typically reveals relationships between different instances. To address this limitation, this paper presents a new framework of Deep Multi-View Clustering via View-specific Representation and Global Graph (DVGMVC) to address the aforementioned issue. Our method leverages the latent graph of each view to enhance representation quality and incorporates a global graph that combines discriminative information to enhance the performance of deep embedded clustering. Specifically, we employ autoencoders to learn embedded features and construct latent graphs from each view. Subsequently, a weighted two-layer plain residual network refines the latent feature using topological information derived from the latent graphs. As various views adhere to the same foundational cluster structure across multiple views, DVGMVC merges the embedded features of all views to create a unified feature. By leveraging the Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) module, which exploits information from both the latent graphs and the global graph generated from the global feature, a unified embedded feature is generated to capture comprehensive topological information among samples. This unified embedded feature is then employed to generate pseudo labels in a self-supervised manner, guiding unified embedding learning and clustering. In a self-supervised manner, such pseudo-label information guides unified embedding learning and clustering. In-depth experiments on public datasets has proven the state-of-the-art clustering effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Triplet Graph Attention Network for EEG-Based Cross-Subject Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: As the correlation between emotion and brain activities has been gradually investigated, it is promising to objectively model the brain mechanism of human emotion with EEG in medical applications, such as the diagnosis of dysthymic disorder and brain disease. However, the huge individual variation of EEG may lead to the failure of recognition, and most existing studies cannot effectively exploit the complex topological information between channels. In this paper, a triplet graph attention network jointly trained from both local and global features is proposed to address the above problems. Specifically, we preliminarily explore topological connectivity by fusing both physical connections and functional connections between electrodes. To alleviate the effects of subject variation and capture the most essential emotional neural patterns, we design a mechanism that can dynamically select samples to form triplets to improve the class discriminability and weaken the subject discriminability in the high-order feature space. In addition, our model can obtain rich node features and effective graph features at the local and global levels, respectively, to capture emotion-related neural patterns. The experimental results on the SEED dataset show the effectiveness of our method in EEG-based cross-subject emotion recognition, and the visualization of the data distribution significantly illustrates that our model can enhance the discriminability of the emotion class.

articleTitle: Security Processing of Street View Image Information
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In the era of cyber-physical-social service convergence, the applications of image scenes have become more and more complex, leading to serious image security problems. In order to realize the security processing of street scene image information, this paper designs a single-level face and license plate detection model based on YOLO v5x to realize the automatic recognition and detection of faces and license plates in street scenes, and then erases the recognition region to realize the desensitization of street scene image information at the pixel level. On this basis, an image restoration model based on atrous deformable convolution is proposed to accomplish the restoration of street scene images. In this paper, we use the self-made Hong Kong street view dataset for model training. Compared with the YOLO series of target detection models and the classical image complementation model, better performance is achieved, and the secure processing of the information in the actual scene map of Hainan is also realized.

articleTitle: Encrypted Differential Privacy Protection Based Distributed Energy Management of Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the integration of a large amount of distributed energy as microgrids into the main power grid for energy interaction, inadequate protection of data may lead to the leakage of user privacy. By considering differential privacy and data encryption, this paper focuses on analyzing the impact of adding truncated Laplace noise to its differential privacy properties in the consistency algorithm. The selected noise is added during the encryption process, and an encrypted differential privacy consistency algorithm is proposed. Finally, a distributed energy management method for microgrids based on encrypted differential privacy protection is presented. The effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through simulations conducted on the IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: NWD-YOLOv5: A Mask Detection Algorithm for Complex Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Since the outbreak of covid-19 in early 2020, it has become a human consensus to effectively prevent infection with the covid-19 by wearing a mask. Therefore, it is significant to propose an object detection model that can accurately detect whether a face is wearing a mask or not in real time. However, in some complex public scenarios, some tiny target faces may be captured due to the distance of the camera from the target, which leads to great challenge of object detection. For most conventional object detection models, small targets are often missed. To solve the issue mentioned above, we make improvements to YOLOv5, which is called NWD-YOLOv5. First, to make our model much more focused on targets, we integrate the convolutional block attention model(CBAM) into YOLOv5. Then one more prediction head is additionally added to detect Tiny targets. At last, we replace the commonly used intersection over union(IoU) metric with the normalized gaussian wasserstein distance(NWD) metric to improve the accuracy of small target detection. After extensive experiments on mask dataset, the NWD-YOLOv5 has better performance than before. Based on the slightly improved AP results, the recall of the model is substantially improved. Compared to YOLOv5, NWD-YOLOv5 improves about 4.2% of recall. The link to the algorithm code is as follows: github.com/KartRiderZoey/nwdyolov5

articleTitle: GSFNet: A Lightweight Global Semantic Fusion Pose Estimation Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Multi-person pose estimation is an important research direction in the field of computer vision. Traditional top-down and bottom-up methods divide this task into two stages for pose estimation, leading to additional computational overhead. Therefore, this paper proposes an end-to-end lightweight multiperson pose estimation network called GSFNet based on YOLO-Pose. This network maintains lightweightness while improving the accuracy and speed of pose detection. To address issues such as redundant convolutional feature maps and low accuracy in detecting small-sized objects in the network, we first construct a C3P module using Partial Convolution (PConv) as the feature extraction module, which effectively alleviates the redundancy of network feature maps while reducing the number of parameters and computations. Then, we propose gsBiFPN (global semantic bidirectional feature pyramid network) for multi-scale feature fusion to enhance the detection capability of small-sized objects, thereby improving the overall performance of the model. Experiments demonstrate that compared to the original YOLO-Pose baseline method, this approach achieves a 7.4% increase in Average Precision (AP) accuracy on the COCO 2017 validation dataset while reducing the network parameters and computational load.

articleTitle: Concrete Crack Identification Method Based on Improved SSA in the Engineering Management Program
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: A Concrete structures are widely used in engineering construction, but their cracking problems have an important impact on structural safety and durability. Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA) is a new type of intelligent optimization algorithm, which has the advantages of simple structure, small number of parameters and easy to operate, and is often used in the fields of image processing and path planning. The study investigates the use of a concrete crack recognition method based on improved SSA in engineering management and creates an improved SSA image segmentation algorithm by combining the area growth image segmentation method with the improved SSA algorithm. The improved SSA image segmentation algorithm is then used to create a GUI-based crack recognition algorithm by combining computer vision technology with the GUI. A crack recognition system based on GUI is constructed. Seams are a common quality hazard in concrete engineering, and traditional detection methods are not only inefficient, but also have the problem of subjectivity. To solve this problem, using machine vision technology in computer technology for crack recognition has become an effective method. Through machine vision technology, crack features can be quickly extracted, reducing manual detection errors, and improving detection efficiency and accuracy. In computer vision technology, the image segmentation algorithm based on the bottle sea scabbard swarm algorithm is an excellent algorithm. This algorithm has the advantages of small computational volume, short time consumption, and good segmentation effect. In order to further improve the accuracy of concrete crack identification, a concrete crack identification method based on improved SSA has been proposed. The main difference between this method and recently published related works is that simple image recognition methods are only suitable for simple crack recognition, while in practical engineering, crack images are complex and variable, and improved crack recognition algorithms are needed to achieve more accurate recognition. The results show that the horizontal coordinates of crack projections are concentrated in the interval of 200~270, the maximum number of pixels in the horizontal direction is about 220, the column positions of cracks are concentrated in the interval of 1~450, and the number of pixel values in the vertical direction is distributed in the interval of 4~18 . In summary, it can be seen that the concrete crack recognition method based on improved SSA has high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Tri-Modalities Fusion for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The purpose of human multimodal sentiment analysis is to use data from multiple modalities to more accurately identify sentiment and emotion. Since the data between different modalities is usually heterogeneous. The main point of this research is to efficiently extract and fuse the data in each modality that is relevant to the other modalities. To better achieve this, this paper proposes the Tri-modalilties Fusion Network(TFN), a novel fusion network to fuse the tri-modalities representations. The model takes three pairs of modality groups as input, and in order to fully use the information of all modalities, each group has three modalities, one modality as the primary modal and the rest as auxiliary modalityies to enhance the primary modal. Experimental results on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI datasets for multimodal sentiment analysis demonstrates the superiority of our approach.

articleTitle: An Auto-Focus Method Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning for Microendoscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Auto-focus is essential for microendoscopy by achieving clear vision to screen for and prevent cancer. Conventional auto-focus methods utilize the rule-based search algorithm to maximize the sharpness metric across a range of focus distance, but they always stuck in a local optimum due to image distortions in real-world environments. To address this challenge, we propose a novel auto-focus method for microendoscopy, which treats the auto-focus procedures to be Markov Decision Process (MDP) based on deep reinforcement learning. Then we introduce an enhanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, called PPO-SOFT, which encourages the agent to adapt to different exploration strategies by clipping constraints, which makes reinforcement learning more stale to the complicated auto-focus environment. We evaluate our method on our auto-focus environment for microendoscopy, the experimental results show that our algorithm outperforms other approaches in terms of average cumulative reward and focus accuracy rate for the auto-focus task. Additionally, we also evaluate the proposed clipping constraint on the MuJoCo benchmark, our method demonstrates robust and stable than other improved PPO methods.

articleTitle: Contrastive Laplacian Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: In unsupervised feature selection, the quality of the similarity graph plays a crucial role in measuring the similarity or distance between data samples. The quality of the similarity graph depends on the choice of similarity measure and parameter settings. If the similarity graph is inaccurate or inappropriate, it can significantly impact the results of feature selection. This can lead to the selected feature subset failing to accurately capture the underlying structure of the data or effectively discriminate between different data classes. The improvement of similarity graph quality is currently an important research direction in unsupervised feature selection. Most existing unsupervised feature selection algorithms primarily focus on constructing similarity among samples within the same class. However, placing excessive emphasis on positive similarity can compromise the robustness of the algorithms. To enhance the robustness of feature selection methods, it is necessary to adopt a more effective graph construction approach that takes into account both positive and negative similarities between samples. Considering the distribution of positive and negative samples, contrastive learning has proven to be an effective learning method. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised feature selection method called Contrastive Laplacian Feature Selection (CLFS), which leverages contrastive learning to optimize the selection process. CLFS constructs a similarity graph based on the contrastive Laplacian matrix, which captures the contrastive information between different features. To promote the robustness and sparsity of the selected features, the L2,1-norm regularization is applied to the projection matrix. This helps retain discriminative features while mitigating the influence of noise in the data. We devise an iterative algorithm to solve the optimization problem associated with CLFS. We evaluate the performance of CLFS on eight benchmark datasets and compare it with several state-of-the-art unsupervised feature selection methods. The experimental results demonstrate that CLFS consistently outperforms the comparison methods. It achieves superior performance in terms of clustering accuracy (ACC), normalized mutual information (NMI), and purity.

articleTitle: Add Anchor to the Anchor-Free Object Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Anchor free framework is more in line with the principle of visual semantics, but it falls into the problem of visual regression of the target shape (width, height and rotation angle) directly, with low accuracy. In this work, we propose a method to improve the accuracy of anchor-free frames by using anchor techniques. On the basis of object location information estimation, only a few anchor-assisted target shape regressions are generated. The method integrates preset boxes into anchor-free framework skillfully and avoids the huge number of anchors in anchor-based scheme. In addition, we have implemented two detection algorithms for horizontal and rotating frames. Compared with the existing anchor-based and anchor-free schemes, our scheme achieves an optimal balance between detection accuracy and computation. The experiments on the two public data sets, MS COCO and HRS2016, fully showed that the precision of our AP reached state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Aspect Extraction from E-Commerce Reviews Based on Word-Word Relationship Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Aspect-level sentiment analysis of e-commerce reviews helps companies to understand customers' feedback and needs. However, the current unsupervised and sequence-annotation-based supervised aspect extraction methods do not fully utilize contextual information and cannot solve the problem of the multi-sense word ambiguity of aspect words. To address this issue, a new scheme is proposed to model aspect extraction as word-word relationship classification (WWRAE). WWRAE architecture fully exploits textual information by effectively modeling the next-word relationship and the last-first-word relationship between aspects. A neural network framework is designed based on the WWRAE scheme, where aspect words are modeled as a two-dimensional word-word lattice. Additionally, a multi-granularity two-dimensional convolution is proposed to enhance the lattice representation, and joint prediction is used to fully reason about the word-word relations. Experiments were conducted on the Restaurants and Laptop of SemEval-2014 and Restaurants of SemEval-2015 datasets, and F1 values reached 86.93, 82.99, and 75.51, respectively, outperforming the current baseline model.

articleTitle: Coreference Resolution Method Integrating Textual Information and Semantic Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The coreference resolution refers to the task of identifying and clustering different expressions that refer to the same entity. In natural language processing, it is a critical task that provides effective support for other NLP tasks. To address issues such as unclear referential information, weak feature vector correlations due to long distances between pronouns, this paper proposes an end-to-end coreference resolution model that integrates Bi-LSTM and multi-head self-attention mechanisms, combined with text similarity calculation to improve the coreference scoring function. The model was tested on the OntoNotes 5.0 dataset and compared with the c2f-coref+spanBERT model. The results show an Avg.F1 score improvement of 0.3% under the CONLL evaluation standard, with an Avg.F1 score of 79.7%, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: FORTRESS: Shortest Feature Weighted Path System for Attack Investigation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: The use of provenance graphs for network attack investigation is common, but large audit data logs pose challenges for security analysts. To address this, we propose FORTRESS, a system that computes feature weights for edges and nodes to conduct attack investigations. We assign weight features to graph edges and nodes to represent their importance. These weight features are converted from those attributes that are highly related to the attack behavior through algorithmic computation. By retracing the shortest path starting from the Point of Interest (POI) event and organizing the paths based on their lengths, we ascertain the point of entry for the attack. Forward analysis based on distance thresholds generates the attack investigation graph. FORTRESS significantly reduces provenance graph size, improves investigation accuracy through node and edge feature fusion, and enhances computational efficiency with edge compression pruning. Evaluating FORTRESS using a real-world dataset and attacks demonstrates its advantages over other techniques in reducing graph size and accurately identifying entry points.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-Based Model for Predicting Breast Milk Flora Ethnicity
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Maternal milk is a significant source of nutrients for the infant and is rich in microbial resources, and the maternal microbiota is now considered an essential determinant of infant health that specific perinatal factors may influence. As a social group distinguished from other populations based on the perception of common ancestry, common culture, and common history, different ethnic groups have their local characteristics, living habits, diets, and cultures, so there may be some differences in the human breast milk microbiota of each ethnic group. Based on this, this paper proposes using machine learning and data mining to construct a model to predict ethnicity. We first obtained more convincing sample features by annotating and merging Operational Taxonomic Units (OTU), constructed four machine learning-based ethnicity prediction models using these features and the best model parameters obtained by the grid search method, We established a baseline model to compare the models. The results show that after fivefold cross-validation and comparative analysis, the random forest can effectively predict ethnicity based on breast milk flora with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 of 0.852, 0.82, 0.836 and 0.823, respectively, which is better than other machine learning models. Therefore, the method proposed in this paper can accurately predict ethnicity, proving the variability of breast milk microbiota among ethnic groups, and providing a solid theoretical basis for future precision diet and precision medicine.

articleTitle: Polyp Segmentation with Multi-Scale Guidance and Multi-Level Supervision
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Colorectal endoscopy is an effective method for detecting and treating colorectal polyps before they evolve into colorectal cancer. However, accurately segmenting polyps in endoscopic images is challenging due to their diverse appearance in terms of size, color, texture, and indistinct borders with their surroundings. Existing methods usually first employ a single complex encoder to handle all polyps, ignoring the differences in size and shape; each decoding step only uses output from adjacent layers, ignoring important global information; and they only provide supervision to the final output, which results in inefficient segmentation of challenging samples with obscure visual characteristics. These issues lead to poor performance as data-set diversity increases. In order to address these limitations, we propose a multi-scale attention detector that can handle various polyp types and sizes. The detector employs a semantic express module to capture crucial global information and a multi-level and multi-view supervision mechanism to segment polyps. Experiments are conducted on diverse datasets including complex SUN-SEG and smaller Kvasir and CVC, and the results demonstrate that our proposed model achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Region Guided Transformer for Single Image Raindrop Removal
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Raindrops can significantly degrade image quality by introducing unwanted reflections and occlusions. Although deep learning-based methods have shown promise in removing these artifacts, they often struggle to completely eliminate raindrop traces and restore the original scene. To address this challenge, we propose a novel Region Guided Transformer Network (RGTN) for single-image raindrop removal. Our RGTN incorporates a unique attention mechanism called Mask-Window Multi-head Self-Attention (MW-MSA), which utilizes a degraded region mask to selectively process the degradations and focus on clean background information. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark raindrop removal datasets demonstrate the superiority of our RGTN network over existing methods. Our approach achieves more detailed and realistic results. To further validate the generalization ability and robustness of our network, we also evaluate its performance on other related tasks, such as snow removal, using datasets like Snow 100K. The results indicate that our network outperforms the latest methods in this domain as well.

articleTitle: DeCo-DETR: Densely Packed Commodity Detection with Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Commodity object detection (COD) plays a significant role in the development of smart unmanned supermarkets. Due to the dense arrangement of items, COD is more challenging than classic object detection. Traditional object detection methods often require intricate hand-designed steps and predefined anchors. These steps increase the difficulty of detecting objects arranged densely. In this paper, we present a DEnsely-packed COmmodity DEtection TRansformer (DeCo-DETR) framework for commodity object detection. Firstly, we propose an adaptive positional prior generator module, which uses anchor box sizes to adjust cross-attention. This enables the cross-attention module to concentrate on local regions corresponding to the target objects. A density-map-guided ranker assignment strategy is introduced to prevent incorrect associations between ground truth boxes and predicted boxes. This strategy treats the object box as a Gaussian distribution and computes the Gaussian Wasserstein distance based on that distribution. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the largest dense product dataset, SKU-110K.

articleTitle: An Attention-Based Reinforcement Learning Approach For Electric Vehicle Charging Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Efficient electric vehicle (EV) charging management is crucial for sustainable energy utilization and smart grid operation. To overcome charging inefficiency and system load imbalance, we propose a deep-reinforcement-learning-based approach to learn the optimal charging control strategy. The conundrum is expounded as a Markov decision process characterized by obscure state transition functions. The principal objective encompasses the determination of the supreme sequential charging stratagem capable of harmonizing the dual imperatives of charging efficacy and charging station expenditure. We provide an overview of EV charging management and related work and describe the principles of the Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm and its application in charging management. By integrating Long Short-Term Memory, the algorithm use the past state information to predict future trends. Meanwhile, Squeeze-and-Excitation Network dynamically adjusts channel weights to capture important information, improving charging efficiency and load balancing. Finally, the simulation results verify that this method can significantly improve charging efficiency and load balance compared with traditional method.

articleTitle: Co-Teaching Learning from Noisy Labeled FMRI Data for Diagnostic Classification of Major Depression
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Brain imaging provides an effective tool for identifying brain abnormalities, and functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) is widely used due to its non-invasive nature and high spatiotemporal resolution. However, low signal-to-noise ratio, large inter-subject differences, and high cost of manual labeling may lead to noisy labels in fMRI-based diagnostic classification of neuropsychiatric disorders. In this study, we developed a co-teaching learning framework to address the issue of noisy labels in the fMRI-based diagnostic classification of Major Depression Disorder (MDD), in which a sample selection strategy based on loss value of predicted labels and true labels was realized through the dual-network collaborative architecture, dynamically screening out samples that may have noisy labels. Then the screened samples were used to update the parameters of the two networks. Experimental results revealed that our proposed method could achieve accuracy improvements of 2.2~3.2% in the classification between MDD patients and normal controls, suggesting that our method is helpful to address the issue of noisy labels in image-based diagnostic classification of neuropsychiatric disorders.

articleTitle: Research on Instance Segmentation of High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Increasingly, high-resolution remote sensing images are being used in real life as a result of the continuous advancement of high-definition remote sensing imaging technology in recent years. They play a crucial role in urban planning, agriculture, oceans, ecological protection, and other fields. A growing amount of remote sensing image data has led to a growing interest in using image instance segmentation to decode remote sensing images by automatically extracting valuable information. The present paper examines and analyzes a large number of instance segmentation methods on remote sensing images. It begins with an explanation of the classification and research progress of natural image instance segmentation techniques, which are categorized into two-stage instance segmentation, single-stage instance segmentation, multi-stage instance segmentation and weakly supervised instance segmentation, and also analyzed in terms of their advantages and shortcomings. And then we discussed it in more detail of remote sensing image instance segmentation using deep learning, and it is explained that each of these methods can be classified into three types based on its technical characteristics: methods that combine multiscale feature fusion, methods that combine dilated convolution and methods that combine attention mechanisms, as well as the benefits and limitations of each method.
