The results of classical experiments on different datasets are presented, along with an explanation of the commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics in instance segmentation. This paper presents an overview of the current problems and challenges associated with remote sensing image instance segmentation, as well as future trends and developments.

articleTitle: A Sentiment Analysis and Knowledge Graph-Based Integral Course Resource Recommendation Model for Super Star "Liberal Studies Plaza"
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Although the search function can complete the task of matching target courses, users usually need to select them twice to obtain the matching target courses. To improve user learning efficiency, personalized recommendation of courses is a feasible method. This study is based on emotional tendencies and knowledge graphs, and calculates the predicted scores of emotional tendencies and knowledge graphs for the target course and users respectively. Moreover, a collaborative filtering algorithm based on user ratings is supplemented to enhance the precision of the integrated course recommendation model. Using the Superstar Integral course module as the experimental objective, the feasibility of the course recommendation model is evaluated through measures like accuracy. The outcomes demonstrated the higher accuracy of the sentiment analysis model used in this study, reaching 98.96% and a loss value of about 0.0015. The mean absolute error of solo course recommendation models based on sentimental direction is greater, while the MAE value of the course recommendation models constructed on the collaborative filtering algorithm is smaller. After the incorporation of the collaborative filtering algorithm, the mean absolute error decreased by 0.03 and the coverage amplified by 6.37%. The above results endorse that the blended algorithm proposed in this study meets high-precision intelligent course resource recommendation and can deliver a superior reference for the course recommendation models in educational platforms.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Optimization Method for Radar Deployment Based on an Improved NSGA-II Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: For the resource allocation optimization problem of anti-deception jamming for networked radar, a population-adaptive improved NSGA-II algorithm based on hierarchical clustering truncation strategy is proposed. By minimizing the probability of networked radar being deceived and maximizing its coverage range, the optimal resource utilization method is obtained. The station deployment optimization method utilizes theoretical analysis of data fusion to determine the anti-jamming capability of networked radars. Theoretical values of the probability of being deceived at different spatial locations are calculated and used as inputs for the improved NSGA-II algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed method can determine the optimal deployment locations under different conditions. This comprehensive approach addresses the resource optimization problem for anti-jamming in networked radar and enables effective deployment of networked radar systems.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Network Based on Attention Mechanism for Nested Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Named entity recognition has received a lot of attention as a fundamental task in natural language processing, but somewhat less attention has been paid to the task of nested named entity recognition. In previous work, many approaches have been proposed to deal with the task of nested named entity recognition. For example, region-based approaches, hypergraph-based approaches, and transformation-based approaches, etc. The more popular approach is currently the span-based approach. Most of the previous span-based approaches were done by separating the nested named entity recognition task into two subtasks independently, first identifying entity boundaries and then classifying them. However, most of such methods suffer from error propagation, large computational cost, and inability to recognize long entities. So we borrowed the idea of two stage in target detection to generate a seed entity and then go through an iterative refinement process to obtain the final boundary and category. First, in the seed entity generation stage, high quality entities are generated by Iou and filters, which are fed to the seed entity refinement module. Let the richer semantic information be aggregated in the seed entity refinement module through the attention mechanism. In addition, we improve the attention mechanism in order to enhance the dependency between inputs and reduce the computational cost. It is experimentally demonstrated that our model achieves better performance than the previous model on the benchmark nested model.

articleTitle: Algorithm Analysis for Large-Scale Object and Background Element Extraction Based on Sentinel-2
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: High-resolution satellite remote sensing images are rich in feature information, which makes it possible to extract complex features of features. Sentinel-2 satellite (Sentinel-2) is a group of Earth observation satellites operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) with high resolution, multispectral, global coverage, high revisit period, and open data. It provides important data support for Earth observation and environmental monitoring and valuable information for scientific research and decision-making. Semantic segmentation plays an important role in remote sensing image analysis, which classifies and segments remote sensing images at pixel level to achieve accurate recognition and extraction of features. In this paper, feature extraction of large objects and background elements is performed based on Sentinel-2 satellite images, and semantic segmentation of satellite images is performed based on the extracted features. In this paper, three different semantic segmentation models are established, including U-Net model, DeepLabv3+ model, and DenseASPP model, so as to compare the effects of different network structures on the extraction of large objects and background elements. Combining with model performance evaluation metrics for reasonable analysis to improve the performance of the large object and background element extraction system.

articleTitle: Research and System Design of Input-Output Hybrid Teaching Based on Feynman Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: With the development of online education, numerous intelligent online teaching systems and educational platforms have emerged, proposing blended teaching and advocating an intelligent instructional approach that combines online and offline learning. However, the current methods of blended teaching lack supervision, and teachers are unable to instantly grasp students’ learning statuses. This paper proposes an innovative blended teaching system that integrates the Feynman theory, a hybrid teaching model, and facial expression recognition technology to enhance instruction. The new teaching methodology consists of three stages: Pre-class Online Learning, In-class Offline Learning, and Post-class Online Learning. The novel system comprises six modules. The integration of the Feynman theory, facial expression recognition, and blended teaching model represents a significant reform approach for future instructional systems.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Method Based on Improved Feature Vector
publicationTitle: 2023 7th Asian Conference on Artificial Intelligence Technology (ACAIT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is an important task in the field of natural language processing. The purpose of this article is to combine manually organized sentiment dictionaries with deep learning techniques to improve the accuracy of sentiment analysis. This article proposes a method based on improved feature vector for text sentiment analysis, which combines the semantic vector outputted by the deep learning model with the sentiment vector outputted by the emotional dictionary algorithm. Additionally, this article provides two combination schemes. The first solution is to combine in the sentence dimension. It involves calculating the sentiment score of the text through the emotional dictionary algorithm, converting it into a One-Hot vector, multiplying it with an Embedding matrix, and then converting it into a sentiment vector. The output of the deep learning model was concatenated with the semantic vector and then input into the decision layer. The second solution is to combine in the word dimension, filter out emotional words in the text, encode and preprocess emotional words, and assign a marker vector based on the type of emotional words. After combining the two vectors, input them into a deep learning model to generate an sentiment vector, and then concatenate them with the output vector of deep learning for decision-making. After validation through dataset experiments, the two models proposed in this article have demonstrated varying degrees of improvement across four key performance metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
